title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
title_zh: EnvOS：当世界发生变化时审计计算机使用智能体：基于现象的任务构建、认证与循证评估

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents built on large language models (LLMs) work in software that can change while they act: an appointment moves, a policy is revised, a record is updated. Testing agents under such changes is harder than it looks. When an agent fails, the cause may be the agent, but it may also be a change that did not fire as intended, an update the agent never received, or a grader that scored the episode wrongly. We introduce EnvOS , a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task. Before any agent runs, EnvOS checks that each change fires correctly, that the task remains solvable, and that the grader separates correct from incorrect behavior; after each run, separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的计算机操作智能体在它们执行动作的同时可能发生变化的软件中工作：预约被移动、政策被修订、记录被更新。 在此类变化下测试智能体比看起来更难。 当智能体失败时，原因可能出在智能体身上，但也可能是变化未按预期触发、智能体从未收到更新，或是评分器对整个过程作出了错误的评分。 我们提出 EnvOS，一个用于构建和认证会在任务中途发生变化的环境的框架。 在任何智能体运行之前，EnvOS 会检查每个变化是否正确触发、任务是否仍然可解、评分器能否区分正确与错误的行为；在每次运行之后，独立的代码会根据归档的证据重新核查判定结果。

paragraphs.en: We apply it to stale information , where a value the agent has already seen changes before the agent acts on it. In clinic booking, Claude Opus 5 succeeds on 0/16 tasks when nothing extra is shown, 2/16 when reminded to re-check the source, and 15/16 when the updated value is shown; the gain over the reminder holds after correcting for all tests ( p = 0.00293 p=0.00293 ). In insurance-claim approval, Opus 5 re-checks on its own and succeeds on 10/10, whereas Claude Sonnet 5 rises from 1/10 to 9/10 when the current policy is shown again, a gain significant in its pre-registered test but not after correcting for all tests. Whether an agent caught a change thus varied with the model and the interface. We also stress-test the grading itself: on corrupted episodes designed blind from the rules, the EnvOS pipeline accepted none of 26 as clean, and on an externally generated set it caught 25 of 39, against 4 for simple log checks. Because every EnvOS environment is generated from a seed and graded by an audited automatic verifier, the same environments are natural candidates for training agents with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将其应用于陈旧信息场景，即智能体已经看到的某个值在智能体据此行动之前发生了变化。 在诊所预约任务中，Claude Opus 5 在不显示任何额外信息时完成 0/16 个任务，在提醒其重新检查来源时完成 2/16，而在显示更新后的值时完成 15/16；在针对所有测试进行校正后，其相对于提醒的提升仍然显著（p = 0.00293 p=0.00293）。 在保险理赔审批任务中，Opus 5 会自行重新检查并在 10/10 上成功，而 Claude Sonnet 5 在重新显示当前政策后从 1/10 提升到 9/10，该提升在其预先注册的测试中显著，但在针对所有测试进行校正后不再显著。 因此，智能体能否发现变化取决于模型和界面。 我们还对评分本身进行了压力测试：在根据规则盲设的受损回合上，EnvOS 流水线将 26 个中的 0 个误判为干净；在外部生成的集合上，它检出 39 个中的 25 个，而简单的日志检查仅检出 4 个。 由于每个 EnvOS 环境都由种子生成并由经过审计的自动验证器评分，这些相同的环境自然是使用基于可验证奖励的强化学习来训练智能体的理想选择。

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents increasingly execute multi-step workflows over stateful applications, but evaluation commonly treats the application state as fixed once an episode begins. In deployed workflows, an appointment can move, a reimbursement policy can be revised, or a selected resource can become unavailable independently of the agent’s actions. These changes are not merely visual perturbations: they modify the authoritative records against which later actions are judged. Existing work has expanded interactive evaluation to long-horizon tasks, temporal disruptions, and evolving environments ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Hui et al., 2026 ; Froger et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2026 ) . A complementary methodological problem remains: how can such changes be instantiated as valid test cases and how can one establish that an observed failure belongs to the agent rather than to the benchmark machinery? The question is sharper when the same environments supply a training signal: reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards trains agents against programmatic checkers ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2026 ) , so an intervention that silently fails or a checker that accepts a corrupted episode yields a wrong reward, not only a wrong benchmark number ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 计算机操作类智能体日益在有状态应用上执行多步骤工作流，但现有评估通常将应用状态视为在回合开始后即固定不变。 在部署的工作流中，一个预约可能被改期，一条报销政策可能被修订，或一个被选定的资源可能在独立于智能体操作的情况下变得不可用。 这些变化并非仅是视觉上的扰动：它们修改了后续操作据以评判的权威记录。 已有研究将交互式评估扩展到长程任务、时序干扰和演化环境（Yuan et al., 2026; Hui et al., 2026; Froger et al., 2026; Zou et al., 2026）。 一个互补的方法学问题仍然存在：如何将这类变化实例化为有效的测试用例，以及如何确立所观察到的失败属于智能体而非基准测试机制本身？ 当同样的环境还提供训练信号时，这个问题变得更加尖锐：可验证奖励的强化学习让智能体针对程序化检查器进行训练（Wang et al., 2026; Wei et al., 2026），因此一次静默失败的干预或一个接受了受损回合的检查器会产生错误的奖励，而不仅仅是错误的基准测试数字（Zhu et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The question involves two different sources of uncertainty. Intervention validity concerns whether the environment underwent the intended state transition, at the intended point in the workflow, without unintended side effects or an impossible endpoint. Evaluation validity concerns whether the policy received its assigned observations, whether attempted rollouts were classified under fixed rules, and whether the scorer’s verdict is supported by archived evidence. A terminal pass/fail label alone cannot resolve these distinctions. For example, a booking agent may appear to use an outdated clinic location even when the update occurred before it saw the original value, or when the promised review information never reached the model. Either case invalidates the intended interpretation without requiring a failure of the agent’s decision policy.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题涉及两种不同的不确定性来源。 干预有效性关注环境是否在工作流程的预期节点上经历了预期的状态转换，且没有产生意外的副作用或到达不可能的终点。 评估有效性关注策略是否收到了分配给它的观测结果，尝试的执行是否按照固定规则进行了分类，以及评分器的判定是否有存档证据支持。 仅有终端的通过/失败标签无法厘清这些区分。 例如，即使更新发生在智能体看到原始值之前，或者承诺的审查信息从未到达模型，预订智能体也可能表现为使用了过时的诊所位置。 这两种情况都会使预期的解释失效，而无需智能体的决策策略本身失败。

paragraphs.en: We present EnvOS , a phenomenon-based framework linking task construction with executable certification and auditable outcome analysis (Figure 2 ). A phenomenon specifies an application-independent class of changes to authoritative state. An executable perturbation implements one instance of that class, defining the state operator, triggering condition, observation channel, and single-execution guard. The resulting task, seeded world, perturbation, endpoint criteria, and verifier form a candidate evaluation artifact. EnvOS admits that artifact for model evaluation only after scoped tests of the state transition, observation consistency, feasibility, behavioral discrimination, and checker robustness. Prospective experiments additionally freeze their design and counting rules, isolate the policy from evaluator data, and reconstruct supported verdict terms through separate implementations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 EnvOS，这是一个基于现象的框架，将任务构建与可执行的认证和可审计的结果分析相联系（图 2）。 现象规定了一类与应用无关的权威状态变更。 一个可执行的扰动实现该类的一个实例，定义状态算子、触发条件、观察通道和单次执行保护。 由此产生的任务、初始世界、扰动、终点标准和验证器共同构成一个候选评估工件。 EnvOS 只有在对状态转换、观察一致性、可行性、行为区分度和检查器稳健性进行范围化测试之后，才允许将该工件用于模型评估。 前瞻性实验还会额外冻结其设计与计数规则，将策略与评估者数据隔离，并通过独立实现来重建受支持的判定结论。

paragraphs.en: The principal empirical analysis focuses on stale authoritative information : the agent is first served a task-relevant value, the underlying application state changes on a later eligible request, and the agent subsequently makes a consequential decision. The timing is important: changing a value before it is served does not establish that the agent’s earlier observation became stale. Figure 1 separates the mutation of the authoritative record from the later interfaces through which its updated value may be disclosed. A recorded page serve, a delivered model observation, and the agent’s comprehension are distinct events; the first two can be audited, whereas comprehension cannot be assumed from either.
paragraphs.zh: 主要的实证分析聚焦于过时的权威信息：智能体首先被提供一个与任务相关的值，随后底层应用状态在一次后续的合格请求中发生变更，之后智能体做出一个具有重大影响的决策。 时机非常重要：在一个值被提供之前就改变它，并不能证明智能体先前的观察已经过时。 图 1 将权威记录的变更与之后可能披露其更新值的各个接口区分开来。 一次被记录的页面提供、一次传递给模型的观察以及智能体的理解是三个不同的事件；前两者可以被审计，而理解则无法从其中任何一方推定得出。

paragraphs.en: For clarity, we retain the preregistered condition codes throughout. In the clinic experiment, OFF-A denotes no additional information at confirmation; CUE-A denotes a verification reminder and a link to the original record, with the updated location withheld; and LIVE-A denotes the same reminder and link with the current location shown. In the insurance experiment, OFF-A provides no additional policy information, whereas ON-A presents the current policy at approval. In both workflows, these conditions change the information presented to the agent, not the underlying state transition.
paragraphs.zh: 为清晰起见，我们在全文中保留预注册的条件代码。 在临床实验中，OFF-A 表示在确认时不提供任何额外信息；CUE-A 表示提供核对提醒和原始记录的链接，但隐藏更新后的位置；LIVE-A 表示提供相同的提醒和链接，并显示当前位置。 在保险实验中，OFF-A 不提供任何额外保单信息，而 ON-A 会在批准时展示当前保单。 在这两个工作流中，这些条件改变的是呈现给智能体的信息，而非底层的状态转换。

sents.zh: 在保险实验中，OFF-A 不提供任何额外保单信息，而 ON-A 会在批准时展示当前保单。

sents.en: In both workflows, these conditions change the information presented to the agent, not the underlying state transition.
sents.zh: 在这两个工作流中，这些条件改变的是呈现给智能体的信息，而非底层的状态转换。

paragraphs.en: We investigate two applications of this evaluation design: clinic booking, where a session location changes, and insurance-claim approval, where a policy limit changes before the agent calculates an approved amount. In the principal paired comparisons the application-side change occurs in every condition; the manipulated variable is what appears at the review step. In clinic booking the agent receives either no additional review display, a review display pointing to the source page, or the current location itself. In insurance-claim approval the experiment compares review-time policy re-exposure with no additional disclosure. The original source remains accessible throughout. Consequently, the experiments estimate within-configuration review-information effects , not the effect of making a static environment dynamic. Source revisits are reported as observed behavior, not automatically treated as a task instruction or a success criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了这一评估设计的两个应用场景：诊所预约（会话中的就诊地点发生变化）和保险理赔审批（在智能体计算核准金额之前保单限额发生变化）。 在主要配对比较中，应用侧的变化在所有条件下都存在；被操纵的变量是审查步骤中呈现的内容。 在诊所预约任务中，智能体会收到以下三种情形之一：没有额外的审查展示、指向来源页面的审查展示，或直接展示当前地点本身。 在保险理赔审批任务中，实验将审查时的保单再次呈现与没有额外披露进行比较。 原始来源在整个过程中始终可以访问。 因此，这些实验估计的是同一配置内审查信息的效果，而不是把静态环境变为动态环境的效果。 来源重访被报告为观察到的行为，而不会自动被视为任务指令或成功标准。

paragraphs.en: The evidence also exposes important differences across the tested configurations. In clinic booking, directly presenting the updated location improves Opus 5’s success over providing a source link, including after paper-wide correction. In insurance approval, Opus 5 succeeds on the tested silent-change instances, while Sonnet 5 shows a block-local benefit from policy re-exposure that does not survive the retrospective paper-wide multiplicity adjustment. These results cannot be pooled into a controlled model ranking because task conditions and configurations differ. Separate archive challenges evaluate whether the same pipeline can detect deliberately corrupted records; their misses qualify, rather than disappear from, the reported evaluation claims.
paragraphs.zh: 这些证据还揭示了各受测配置之间的重要差异。 在诊所预约中，直接呈现更新后的地点比提供来源链接更能提升 Opus 5 的成功率，即使在整个文档层面更正之后依然如此。 在保险审批中，Opus 5 在受测的静默变更实例上均取得成功，而 Sonnet 5 则表现出政策重新暴露带来的块内局部收益，但该收益在回溯性的整篇多重性调整后不再保留。 由于任务条件和配置各不相同，这些结果无法合并为一个受控的模型排名。 独立的归档挑战用于评估同一流程能否检测被蓄意篡改的记录；其漏检对所报告的评估结论构成限定，而不是使其失效。

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. (i) A phenomenon–perturbation formulation that connects application-independent state changes to executable, exposure-conditioned task instances without conflating world state with model-visible notices. (ii) A certification and evidence pipeline encompassing intervention and feasibility checks, frozen execution rules, observation-delivery evidence, validity-first outcome scoring, independent reconstruction, and adversarial evaluator challenges. (iii) An evidence-bounded empirical study of two controlled stale-world workflows, together with evaluator challenge results that delineate what the outcome claims do and do not establish. Because instances are seeded and procedurally generated and outcomes are scored from committed application state, the certified environments and their verifiers are reusable as verifiable-reward environments for agentic RL, and the evaluator challenges show where such verifiers could mis-reward an episode. Supplementary phenomenon families are reported separately in Appendix S1 and are not pooled with the principal experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献有三个方面。 （i）一种现象—扰动形式化，它将与应用无关的状态变化连接到可执行的、受暴露条件约束的任务实例，而不将世界状态与模型可见的通知混为一谈。 （ii）一个认证与证据流水线，涵盖干预与可行性检查、冻结的执行规则、观察交付证据、以有效性优先的结果评分、独立重建，以及对抗性评估器挑战。 （iii）一项对两个受控陈旧世界工作流的、有证据边界的实证研究，以及评估器挑战结果，这些结果划清了结果主张所确立与未确立的边界。 由于实例是种子化并程序化生成的，且结果是从已提交的应用状态中评分的，这些经认证的环境及其验证器可作为智能体强化学习（agentic RL）的可验证奖励环境复用，而评估器挑战则展示了此类验证器可能在何处对回合错误地给予奖励。 补充现象族在附录 S1 中单独报告，不与主实验合并。

paragraphs.en: The remainder of the paper defines the framework and its intervention semantics, specifies the tasks and evaluation protocol, presents the prospective results and evaluator challenges, and discusses limitations. Implementation-level traces, generated evidence tables, and exploratory phenomenon-family analyses are retained in the appendices.
paragraphs.zh: 本文其余部分将定义该框架及其干预语义，说明任务与评估协议，给出前瞻性结果与评估者面临的挑战，并讨论局限性。 实现层面的轨迹、生成的证据表格以及探索性的现象族分析保留在附录中。

paragraphs.en: The upper row of Figure 1 traces the authoritative state: a recorded v 0 v_{0} serve precedes the one-time mutation to v 1 v_{1} , which determines the correct committed outcome. The lower row traces the information available to the policy, including the original delivered frame and the optional review disclosure. A review display does not cause or prove the state mutation, and a served page does not by itself establish that the model received or understood it. This distinction defines the evidence required for a legitimate stale-information episode.
paragraphs.zh: 图1的上排展示了权威状态：一条已记录的 v 0 v_{0} 服务先于对 v 1 v_{1} 的一次性变更，该变更决定了正确的提交结果。 下排展示了策略可获得的信息，包括原始送达的帧以及可选的审查披露。 审查展示既不会引起也无法证明该状态变更，而已服务的页面本身并不能确立模型已接收或理解了它。 这一区别界定了合法的陈旧信息事件所需的证据。

paragraphs.en: EnvOS couples the construction of state-changing evaluation instances with executable assurance of their experimental validity. Its workflow has three stages (Figure 2 ): constructing a candidate task and intervention, certifying the candidate against specified obligations, and executing admitted instances with independently auditable outcomes. The distinction is consequential. A functioning state mutation does not establish that a task remains solvable, that the assigned observations reach the agent, or that an endpoint checker correctly classifies the resulting behavior.
paragraphs.zh: EnvOS 将状态变更评估实例的构建与其试验有效性的可执行保证相耦合。 其工作流程包含三个阶段（图 2）：构建候选任务与干预措施，依据指定义务对候选实例进行认证，以及执行被准入的实例并获得可独立审计的结果。 这一区分至关重要。 一次有效的状态变更并不能证明任务仍然可解、分配的观测能够到达智能体，或者端点检查器能够正确分类由此产生的行为。

sents.en: EnvOS couples the construction of state-changing evaluation instances with executable assurance of their experimental validity.
sents.zh: EnvOS 将状态变更评估实例的构建与其试验有效性的可执行保证相耦合。

sents.en: Its workflow has three stages (Figure 2 ): constructing a candidate task and intervention, certifying the candidate against specified obligations, and executing admitted instances with independently auditable outcomes.
sents.zh: 其工作流程包含三个阶段（图 2）：构建候选任务与干预措施，依据指定义务对候选实例进行认证，以及执行被准入的实例并获得可独立审计的结果。

sents.en: The distinction is consequential.
sents.zh: 这一区分至关重要。

sents.en: A functioning state mutation does not establish that a task remains solvable, that the assigned observations reach the agent, or that an endpoint checker correctly classifies the resulting behavior.
sents.zh: 一次有效的状态变更并不能证明任务仍然可解、分配的观测能够到达智能体，或者端点检查器能够正确分类由此产生的行为。

paragraphs.en: A task specification determines the environment, initial state, user objective, and endpoint requirements. An associated phenomenon describes an application-independent class of environmental change relevant to that objective. EnvOS instantiates the phenomenon through an executable perturbation whose state operator, trigger, disclosure channel, and once-only guard are fixed with the task. The seeded world, perturbation, permitted observations, registered success invariants, and scorer jointly define a candidate evaluation artifact . Author-specified task semantics are distinguished from automated instance construction, execution, and checking: the experiments do not claim unrestricted autonomous generation of new task objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 任务规范确定环境、初始状态、用户目标和终点要求。 关联现象描述与该目标相关的一类与应用无关的环境变化。 EnvOS 通过一个可执行的扰动来实例化该现象，其状态操作符、触发器、披露通道和一次性守卫均随任务固定。 播种的世界、扰动、允许的观测、注册的成功不变量和评分器共同定义一个候选评测工件。 作者指定的任务语义与自动化的实例构建、执行和检查相区分：实验并不声称能够不受限制地自主生成新的任务目标。

sents.zh: 任务规范确定环境、初始状态、用户目标和终点要求。

sents.zh: 关联现象描述与该目标相关的一类与应用无关的环境变化。

paragraphs.en: Candidate instances undergo tests of five related properties. Intervention validity checks the intended state transition, trigger boundary, and absence of unintended changes. Observation consistency compares permitted disclosures with authoritative state and verifies the specified delivery path. Feasibility requires a successful scripted route through the task. Behavioral discrimination uses deliberately limited scripted policies to check that the constructed instance can expose the targeted deficiency. Scorer robustness tests known corruptions, near-misses, and valid controls. Where applicable, scripted feasibility and discrimination checks are repeated on frozen generated instances rather than inferred from the template alone.
paragraphs.zh: 候选实例需要通过五项相关属性的检验。 干预有效性检查预期的状态转换、触发边界以及不存在非预期变更。 观察一致性将允许的信息披露与权威状态进行比较，并验证指定的传递路径。 可行性要求存在一条通过任务的成功的脚本化路线。 行为区分使用刻意受限的脚本化策略来检查所构建的实例能否暴露目标缺陷。 评分器稳健性测试已知的损坏、近似错误的情况以及有效的对照。 在适用的情况下，脚本化的可行性与区分检查会在冻结的生成实例上重复进行，而不是仅从模板推断。

sents.en: Candidate instances undergo tests of five related properties.
sents.zh: 候选实例需要通过五项相关属性的检验。

sents.en: Feasibility requires a successful scripted route through the task.
sents.zh: 可行性要求存在一条通过任务的成功的脚本化路线。

sents.en: Behavioral discrimination uses deliberately limited scripted policies to check that the constructed instance can expose the targeted deficiency.

sents.zh: 评分器稳健性测试已知的损坏、近似错误的情况以及有效的对照。

sents.en: Where applicable, scripted feasibility and discrimination checks are repeated on frozen generated instances rather than inferred from the template alone.

paragraphs.en: Each check returns pass , violation , or monitor error ; an unassessable obligation does not count as a pass. Admission is conditional on the declared checks, not a proof that every future model trajectory will be correctly handled. The certification criteria and examples of their failure targets are specified in Section 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 每项检查的结果为通过、违规或监控错误；无法评估的义务不算作通过。 准入仅以所声明的检查为条件，并不证明未来每条模型轨迹都会得到正确处理。 认证标准及其失效目标的示例在第 6.4 节中规定。

sents.zh: 认证标准及其失效目标的示例在第 6.4 节中规定。

paragraphs.en: Admitted configurations are evaluated with task instances, action budgets, validity criteria, outcome invariants, and analysis rules fixed before rollout. EnvOS archives application events, model-facing observations, agent actions, and committed state. A source page having been served is recorded separately from an observation actually delivered to the model; neither event establishes that the agent understood or used the information.
paragraphs.zh: 准入的配置在任务实例、行动预算、有效性标准、结果不变量和分析规则事先固定的情况下进行评估。 EnvOS 归档应用程序事件、面向模型的观测、智能体行动以及已提交的状态。 来源页面已被提供这一事实与观测实际交付给模型是分开记录的；这两个事件都不能证明智能体理解或使用了该信息。

sents.zh: 准入的配置在任务实例、行动预算、有效性标准、结果不变量和分析规则事先固定的情况下进行评估。

sents.en: EnvOS archives application events, model-facing observations, agent actions, and committed state.
sents.zh: EnvOS 归档应用程序事件、面向模型的观测、智能体行动以及已提交的状态。

sents.en: A source page having been served is recorded separately from an observation actually delivered to the model; neither event establishes that the agent understood or used the information.
sents.zh: 来源页面已被提供这一事实与观测实际交付给模型是分开记录的；这两个事件都不能证明智能体理解或使用了该信息。

paragraphs.en: Run-level adjudication first determines whether the episode satisfies the registered validity conditions. Only valid episodes are assessed against applicable task invariants using the authoritative application state at the agent’s consequential commit. This ordering prevents faulty interventions or missing model inputs from being counted as agent failures. Conversely, valid unsuccessful episodes, including those that exhaust the action budget, remain failures under the registered protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 运行级裁决首先判定该回合是否满足已注册的有效性条件。 只有有效的回合才会依据智能体在关键性提交时的权威应用状态，针对适用的任务不变量进行评估。 这种排序方式防止将有缺陷的干预或缺失的模型输入计为智能体的失败。 相反，有效的失败回合，包括那些耗尽动作预算的回合，在已注册协议下仍被判定为失败。

paragraphs.en: After the rollout, separate implementations reconstruct supported validity and endpoint terms from the preserved evidence. Unresolved terms remain unresolved when the archive lacks sufficient information. Sealed, rule-only, and externally constructed archive challenges then test whether the operational evaluator detects deliberately corrupted evidence and retains valid controls. Such challenges test evaluator reliability rather than agent capability; disagreements and false acceptances are reported alongside successful detections (Section 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在上线后，各分离的实现会从保留的证据中重建受支持的效度与端点术语。 当归档缺乏足够信息时，未决术语保持未决状态。 随后使用密封的、仅含规则的以及外部构造的归档挑战，来检验操作性评估器能否检测出被故意破坏的证据并保留有效对照。 此类挑战检验的是评估器的可靠性而非智能体的能力；分歧与错误接受会与成功检测一并报告（第 9 节）。

paragraphs.en: The division of evidence is summarized in Table 1 . Pre-run certification asks whether a proposed test meets its declared contract; run-level verification asks whether one realized episode and its score are supported by the archive. These are complementary, not interchangeable, claims.
paragraphs.zh: 证据的划分总结于表1中。 运行前认证询问一个提议的测试是否满足其声明的契约；运行级验证询问一个已实现的回合及其得分是否有归档支持。 这些是互补而非可互换的主张。

paragraphs.en: A versioned instance manifest connects the initial world, task, intervention, disclosure conditions, and evaluator. It preserves the distinction between obligations checked before rollout and evidence collected from a particular model episode. Operationally, it encompasses admission checks, policy isolation, frozen decision rules, validity-first counting, independent reconstruction, and evaluator challenges. The supplementary phenomenon corpus uses the same general assurance categories but is not assumed to share every implementation detail with the prospective experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 带版本的实例清单将初始世界、任务、干预、披露条件与评估者连接起来。 它保留了在上线前检查的义务与从特定模型回合收集的证据之间的区分。 在操作层面，它涵盖准入检查、策略隔离、冻结的决策规则、有效性优先计数、独立重建以及评估者挑战。 补充现象语料库使用相同的总体保证类别，但不假定它与前瞻性实验共享每一个实现细节。

paragraphs.en: An environmental phenomenon specifies a class of changes to authoritative application state, independent of any particular application or interface. A task defines the agent’s intended outcome; the phenomenon defines an external event that may alter the state relevant to achieving that outcome. This separation prevents a model-visible notification from being treated as the underlying environmental event. In the two prospective workflows, the same broad phenomenon takes the form of a session-location update and a reimbursement-policy-limit update. Both affect application-owned records, rather than altering the user’s request or inserting adversarial instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 环境现象规定了权威应用状态的一类变更，独立于任何特定应用或界面。 任务定义智能体的预期结果；现象定义可能改变与实现该结果相关状态的外部事件。 这种分离防止模型可见的通知被视为底层环境事件。 在两个前瞻性工作流中，同一广义现象分别表现为会话位置更新和报销政策额度更新。 两者都影响应用拥有的记录，而不是改变用户的请求或插入对抗性指令。

paragraphs.en: A specification identifies the affected state variable, permitted transition, task relevance, admissible timing, and feasible post-change outcome. Its implementation is an executable perturbation , which can differ across applications even when the phenomenon is conceptually shared. The prospective instances are generated within one synthetic workplace scaffold; they do not constitute evidence of portability to unrelated production applications.
paragraphs.zh: 规范需指明受影响的状态变量、允许的转换、任务相关性、可接受的时间安排以及变更后可行的结果。 其实现是一个可执行的扰动，即使现象在概念上是共享的，不同应用中的实现也可能不同。 前瞻性实例是在同一个合成工作场所脚手架中生成的；它们并不构成可迁移到不相关生产应用的证据。

paragraphs.en: where δ \delta is an operator on authoritative state, τ \tau identifies the triggering event, c c governs subsequent disclosure through permitted observation channels, and g g ensures that the intervention fires at most once. The state transition and its disclosure are distinct operations: the latter must reflect the former but does not constitute it. Researchers specify the task semantics, legally admissible changes, success criteria, and comparisons; EnvOS executes and checks the resulting configuration.

paragraphs.en: The focal stale-information intervention requires a task-relevant value to have been served before a later, exposure-conditioned mutation supersedes it. The original serve arms the trigger; a subsequent eligible application request applies the update. Thus an update occurring before the old value was served would not establish the intended stale-world exposure. The harness additionally records the frame delivered to the model, because server-side service alone does not prove delivery. Figure 1 illustrates this temporal distinction.
paragraphs.zh: 核心的过期信息干预要求某个与任务相关的值已被送达，之后由暴露条件触发的变更才会取代它。 原始的送达武装了触发器；随后符合条件的应用请求才执行更新。 因此，若在旧值被送达之前就发生更新，将无法建立预期的过期世界暴露。 该测试工具还会记录交付给模型的帧，因为仅凭服务器端的送达并不能证明已交付。 图 1 展示了这一时间上的区别。

sents.zh: 核心的过期信息干预要求某个与任务相关的值已被送达，之后由暴露条件触发的变更才会取代它。

sents.en: Figure 1 illustrates this temporal distinction.
sents.zh: 图 1 展示了这一时间上的区别。

paragraphs.en: The intervention contract requires four properties. First, the intended record must change at the specified request boundary, after the original-value serve and at most once. Second, the mutation must remain confined to the declared state scope; matched irrelevant-record controls test whether the machinery can run without changing the target answer. Third, observations must follow the assigned disclosure condition while the authoritative source remains accessible. Fourth, the post-change task must remain feasible, as witnessed by the registered reference policy on each admitted instance.
paragraphs.zh: 干预契约要求满足四个性质。 第一，目标记录必须在指定的请求边界处发生变化，即在提供原始值之后，且至多变化一次。 第二，变更必须始终局限于所声明的状态范围内；匹配的无关记录控制用于检验该机制能否在不改变目标答案的情况下运行。 第三，在权威来源保持可访问的同时，观察必须遵循所分配的披露条件。 第四，变更后的任务必须保持可行，这由已登记的参考策略在每个被接受的实例上加以印证。

sents.zh: 干预契约要求满足四个性质。

sents.zh: 第三，在权威来源保持可访问的同时，观察必须遵循所分配的披露条件。

sents.en: Fourth, the post-change task must remain feasible, as witnessed by the registered reference policy on each admitted instance.
sents.zh: 第四，变更后的任务必须保持可行，这由已登记的参考策略在每个被接受的实例上加以印证。

paragraphs.en: These requirements define a controlled state-changing task rather than an instruction to the agent to anticipate a hidden update. In both prospective workflows, the authoritative transition is held fixed across the principal paired conditions. Consequently, their comparisons identify differences associated with review-time information, not the causal effect of introducing the environmental change itself.
paragraphs.zh: 这些要求定义的是一个受控的状态变更任务，而不是要求智能体去预期某次隐藏更新的指令。 在两种前瞻性工作流程中，权威的变迁在主要配对条件下保持固定。 因此，它们的比较识别出的是与评审时信息相关的差异，而不是引入环境变化本身产生的因果效应。

paragraphs.en: The clinic task requires the agent to combine information from mail, calendar, and a booking portal to select and confirm a compatible appointment. The portal initially serves a session location; on a later eligible booking request, the authoritative session record is updated without an immediate announcement. The source record remains accessible. Success requires a correctly committed booking satisfying the applicable task invariants, rather than a particular source-revisiting action.
paragraphs.zh: 该诊所任务要求智能体结合邮件、日历和预订门户中的信息，选择并确认一个相容的预约。 门户最初提供一个会诊地点；在后续符合条件的预订请求中，权威的会诊记录被更新，但不会立即发布公告。 该来源记录仍可访问。 成功要求正确提交的预订满足适用的任务不变量，而不是执行某个特定的重访来源的动作。

paragraphs.en: The review-time policy record provides the current limit, not the computed answer. Some instances cross a calculation threshold, so a policy lookup alone is insufficient to guarantee correct approval. Unlike the clinic instructions, the claims task explicitly refers to the policy in force at approval; this difference is relevant when interpreting observed source revisits.

paragraphs.en: The registered condition codes are defined in Table 3 . The suffix -A indicates a task-relevant state change, -I an irrelevant-record change at the matched trigger, and L0 a no-change control. In each principal paired contrast, the task-relevant record changes in both conditions; only the information provided before the final action differs. The authoritative source remains available throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 注册的条件编码定义见表 3。 后缀 -A 表示与任务相关的状态变化，-I 表示在匹配触发点处的无关记录变化，L0 表示无变化的对照。 在每个主要的配对对比中，两种条件下的与任务相关的记录均发生变化；只有在最终动作之前提供的信息有所不同。 权威来源在整个过程中始终可用。

sents.zh: 注册的条件编码定义见表 3。

sents.en: The suffix -A indicates a task-relevant state change, -I an irrelevant-record change at the matched trigger, and L0 a no-change control.
sents.zh: 后缀 -A 表示与任务相关的状态变化，-I 表示在匹配触发点处的无关记录变化，L0 表示无变化的对照。

sents.en: In each principal paired contrast, the task-relevant record changes in both conditions; only the information provided before the final action differs.
sents.zh: 在每个主要的配对对比中，两种条件下的与任务相关的记录均发生变化；只有在最终动作之前提供的信息有所不同。

sents.en: The authoritative source remains available throughout.
sents.zh: 权威来源在整个过程中始终可用。

paragraphs.en: In clinic booking, LIVE–CUE measures the effect of directly showing the current location beyond a verification reminder and source link. CUE–OFF measures the effect of supplying that reminder and link rather than no additional information. In insurance approval, ON–OFF compares re-exposure to the current policy record with no additional policy information. These are intervention-assignment effects under the action budget: they may jointly reflect salience, contradiction with an earlier value, and reduced verification effort.
paragraphs.zh: 在门诊预约场景中，LIVE–CUE 衡量的是在验证提醒和来源链接之外，直接展示当前所在位置所带来的效应。 CUE–OFF 衡量的是提供该提醒和链接、而非不提供任何附加信息所带来的效应。 在保险审批场景中，ON–OFF 将重新呈现当前保单记录与不提供任何附加保单信息进行比较。 这些都是在行动预算下的干预分配效应：它们可能共同反映了显著性、与先前取值的矛盾，以及验证成本的降低。

sents.en: In clinic booking, LIVE–CUE measures the effect of directly showing the current location beyond a verification reminder and source link.
sents.zh: 在门诊预约场景中，LIVE–CUE 衡量的是在验证提醒和来源链接之外，直接展示当前所在位置所带来的效应。

sents.en: CUE–OFF measures the effect of supplying that reminder and link rather than no additional information.
sents.zh: CUE–OFF 衡量的是提供该提醒和链接、而非不提供任何附加信息所带来的效应。

sents.zh: 在保险审批场景中，ON–OFF 将重新呈现当前保单记录与不提供任何附加保单信息进行比较。

sents.en: These are intervention-assignment effects under the action budget: they may jointly reflect salience, contradiction with an earlier value, and reduced verification effort.
sents.zh: 这些都是在行动预算下的干预分配效应：它们可能共同反映了显著性、与先前取值的矛盾，以及验证成本的降低。

paragraphs.en: A task instance is a generated booking or claim scenario; an episode is one model rollout under one experimental condition. A commit is the agent’s consequential application action, distinct from EnvOS’s earlier state mutation. Outcome measures are computed from the committed application state and registered invariants. Separate trajectory measures capture source revisits, link following, and policy re-queries. Such behaviors may help characterize the observed path but are not standalone success requirements. In particular, a correct outcome without revisiting the source is possible when the current value was supplied directly, and revisiting alone does not guarantee task success.
paragraphs.zh: 任务实例是一个生成的预订或理赔场景；回合（episode）是模型在某一个实验条件下的一次执行。 提交（commit）是智能体产生实际后果的应用操作，与 EnvOS 此前的状态变更不同。 结果指标基于已提交的应用状态和已注册的不变量计算得出。 独立的轨迹指标用于捕捉源信息的回访、链接的跟进以及策略的重复查询。 这些行为可能有助于刻画所观察到的路径，但并非独立的成功要求。 特别地，当当前值是被直接提供时，即使不回访源信息也可能得到正确的结果；而仅凭回访并不能保证任务成功。

sents.zh: 任务实例是一个生成的预订或理赔场景；回合（episode）是模型在某一个实验条件下的一次执行。

sents.zh: 结果指标基于已提交的应用状态和已注册的不变量计算得出。

sents.zh: 独立的轨迹指标用于捕捉源信息的回访、链接的跟进以及策略的重复查询。

sents.zh: 这些行为可能有助于刻画所观察到的路径，但并非独立的成功要求。

sents.en: In particular, a correct outcome without revisiting the source is possible when the current value was supplied directly, and revisiting alone does not guarantee task success.
sents.zh: 特别地，当当前值是被直接提供时，即使不回访源信息也可能得到正确的结果；而仅凭回访并不能保证任务成功。

paragraphs.en: The two workflows probe distinct decision requirements. Clinic booking primarily tests selection under a superseded record value; insurance approval requires calculating a derived value from the updated policy. Their results are therefore analyzed by workflow and model configuration, not combined into a cross-model ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个工作流探测的是不同的决策需求。 诊所预约主要测试在被取代的记录值下的选择；保险审批则需要根据更新后的政策计算一个派生值。 因此，它们的结果按工作流和模型配置分别进行分析，而不是合并为一个跨模型的排名。

sents.en: The two workflows probe distinct decision requirements.
sents.zh: 这两个工作流探测的是不同的决策需求。

sents.zh: 诊所预约主要测试在被取代的记录值下的选择；保险审批则需要根据更新后的政策计算一个派生值。

sents.zh: 因此，它们的结果按工作流和模型配置分别进行分析，而不是合并为一个跨模型的排名。

paragraphs.en: In each stale-information episode, the application first serves the original task-relevant value and the harness records the observation delivered to the agent. The next eligible request, after that serve, triggers the authoritative mutation once. The assigned review-time information is then rendered from the updated state, and the agent continues under the fixed action budget. The same mutation occurs in all principal paired conditions, independently of whether the agent receives additional disclosure. Source revisiting remains possible in each condition.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个过期信息情节中，应用程序首先提供原始的任务相关值，框架记录传递给智能体的观察结果。 在该次服务之后的下一个符合条件的请求，会触发一次权威变更操作。 随后，分配的评审时信息从更新后的状态中渲染出来，智能体在固定的动作预算下继续运行。 相同的变更操作在所有主要配对条件下都会发生，与智能体是否收到额外披露无关。 在每种条件下，重新访问来源仍然是可能的。

sents.en: In each stale-information episode, the application first serves the original task-relevant value and the harness records the observation delivered to the agent.
sents.zh: 在每个过期信息情节中，应用程序首先提供原始的任务相关值，框架记录传递给智能体的观察结果。

sents.zh: 在该次服务之后的下一个符合条件的请求，会触发一次权威变更操作。

sents.zh: 随后，分配的评审时信息从更新后的状态中渲染出来，智能体在固定的动作预算下继续运行。

sents.zh: 相同的变更操作在所有主要配对条件下都会发生，与智能体是否收到额外披露无关。

sents.en: Source revisiting remains possible in each condition.
sents.zh: 在每种条件下，重新访问来源仍然是可能的。

paragraphs.en: At execution time the harness archives the state-change event, model-facing observations, browser actions, commit event, and final report. The outcome is not inferred from the displayed notice or from the model’s verbal report: an episode first undergoes validity classification and, if counted, is scored from the committed record. Archived events subsequently support independent reconstruction and targeted corruption tests. These distinctions also apply to the insurance workflow, where the changed state enters an arithmetic endpoint rather than a location-selection endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行时，测试框架会归档状态变更事件、面向模型的观察、浏览器操作、提交事件和最终报告。 结果并非从显示的提示或模型的口头报告推断得出：一个回合首先要经过有效性分类，若被计入，则根据已提交的记录进行评分。 归档的事件随后可用于独立重建和针对性的破坏性测试。 这些区别同样适用于保险工作流，其中变更后的状态进入的是算术端点，而非位置选择端点。

sents.zh: 在执行时，测试框架会归档状态变更事件、面向模型的观察、浏览器操作、提交事件和最终报告。

sents.zh: 这些区别同样适用于保险工作流，其中变更后的状态进入的是算术端点，而非位置选择端点。

paragraphs.en: An episode contains separate evidence of the original page serve, delivered observation, state mutation, assigned disclosure, and final commit. This partition is essential because one event does not prove another: a server log does not establish model delivery, and model delivery does not establish comprehension or reliance. The evaluator tests the recorded sequence against the registered intervention and outcome rules. Illustrative request ordering and implementation-level traces are retained in Appendix S2 rather than in the main methodological argument.
paragraphs.zh: 一个回合（episode）包含彼此独立的证据：原始页面的送达、交付的观察、状态的变更、指定的披露，以及最终的提交。 这一划分至关重要，因为一个事件不能证明另一个事件：服务器日志不能证明模型已交付，而模型已交付也不能证明理解或信赖。 评估器将记录的事件序列与已注册的干预规则和结果规则进行对照检验。 说明性的请求顺序和实现层面的追踪记录保留在附录 S2 中，而不是放在主要方法论论证部分。

sents.zh: 一个回合（episode）包含彼此独立的证据：原始页面的送达、交付的观察、状态的变更、指定的披露，以及最终的提交。

sents.zh: 评估器将记录的事件序列与已注册的干预规则和结果规则进行对照检验。

sents.zh: 说明性的请求顺序和实现层面的追踪记录保留在附录 S2 中，而不是放在主要方法论论证部分。

paragraphs.en: The prospective experiments use a synthetic workplace testbed with 14 containerized infrastructure services, including clinic and insurance applications and supporting mail, calendar, and database services. Only two workflows are prospectively evaluated. The policy receives screenshot and text observations through a controlled semantic-browser interface, acts through a fixed schema, and is invoked statelessly with a short memo and recent-action history. The clinic and claims tasks allow 48 and 40 actions, respectively. Matched conditions share instance data and instructions. This interface does not constitute unrestricted operating-system-level computer use; the relevant action and observation contracts are specified in Appendix O .
paragraphs.zh: 前瞻性实验使用一个包含14个容器化基础设施服务的合成工作场所测试平台，其中包括诊所和保险应用程序以及配套的邮件、日历和数据库服务。 仅有两个工作流得到前瞻性评估。 策略通过受控的语义浏览器接口接收截图和文本观测，通过固定模式执行动作，并以无状态方式被调用，附带简短备忘录和近期动作历史。 诊所任务和理赔任务分别允许48个和40个动作。 匹配条件共享实例数据和指令。 该接口并不构成不受限制的操作系统级计算机使用；相关动作和观测契约在附录O中规定。

sents.zh: 诊所任务和理赔任务分别允许48个和40个动作。

paragraphs.en: EnvOS evaluates the test construction and the model episode separately. Pre-run certification checks whether the proposed intervention satisfies a declared contract, whereas post-run auditing determines whether the recorded trajectory supports its validity classification and outcome. Both are necessary: an admissible candidate may still produce an invalid rollout, and a seemingly correct final record cannot establish that the intended stale-world sequence occurred.
paragraphs.zh: EnvOS 分别评估测试构建与模型回合。 运行前认证检查所提出的干预是否满足已声明的契约，而运行后审计判断记录的轨迹是否支持其有效性分类和结果。 两者都是必要的：一个可准入的候选仍可能产生无效的 rollout，而一个看似正确的最终记录也无法证明预期的过期世界序列确实发生了。

sents.en: EnvOS evaluates the test construction and the model episode separately.
sents.zh: EnvOS 分别评估测试构建与模型回合。

sents.en: Pre-run certification checks whether the proposed intervention satisfies a declared contract, whereas post-run auditing determines whether the recorded trajectory supports its validity classification and outcome.
sents.zh: 运行前认证检查所提出的干预是否满足已声明的契约，而运行后审计判断记录的轨迹是否支持其有效性分类和结果。

sents.en: Both are necessary: an admissible candidate may still produce an invalid rollout, and a seemingly correct final record cannot establish that the intended stale-world sequence occurred.
sents.zh: 两者都是必要的：一个可准入的候选仍可能产生无效的 rollout，而一个看似正确的最终记录也无法证明预期的过期世界序列确实发生了。

paragraphs.en: The application database is the source of truth; a page or message shown to the policy is an observation derived from that state. For a stale-world episode, the original-value serve must precede the exposure-conditioned update, which must precede any review-time disclosure of the changed value. Serving and delivery are separate recorded events. The state operator changes the application-owned record; the disclosure channel changes only information presented to the agent. As a result, differences between the experimental conditions do not amount to different injected phenomena.
paragraphs.zh: 应用数据库是事实的唯一来源；展示给策略的页面或消息是从该状态派生出的观察。 对于过期世界情境，原始值的服务必须先于暴露条件下的更新，而后者必须先于评审时对已更改值的任何披露。 服务与投递是两个分开记录的事件。 状态算子改变应用所拥有的记录；披露通道只改变呈现给智能体的信息。 因此，各实验条件之间的差异并不等同于不同的注入现象。

sents.en: The application database is the source of truth; a page or message shown to the policy is an observation derived from that state.
sents.zh: 应用数据库是事实的唯一来源；展示给策略的页面或消息是从该状态派生出的观察。

sents.en: For a stale-world episode, the original-value serve must precede the exposure-conditioned update, which must precede any review-time disclosure of the changed value.
sents.zh: 对于过期世界情境，原始值的服务必须先于暴露条件下的更新，而后者必须先于评审时对已更改值的任何披露。

sents.en: Serving and delivery are separate recorded events.
sents.zh: 服务与投递是两个分开记录的事件。

sents.en: The state operator changes the application-owned record; the disclosure channel changes only information presented to the agent.
sents.zh: 状态算子改变应用所拥有的记录；披露通道只改变呈现给智能体的信息。

sents.en: As a result, differences between the experimental conditions do not amount to different injected phenomena.
sents.zh: 因此，各实验条件之间的差异并不等同于不同的注入现象。

paragraphs.en: An application-independent specification of a class of authoritative-state changes and the conditions under which an instance of that class is admissible.
paragraphs.zh: 与具体应用无关的、对一类权威状态变更以及该类变更的实例在何种条件下可被采纳的规范说明。

paragraphs.en: An environment-specific executable intervention ρ = ( δ , τ , c , g ) \rho=(\delta,\tau,c,g) comprising a state operator, triggering condition, observation channel, and once-only guard.
paragraphs.zh: 一个环境特定的可执行干预 ρ = ( δ , τ , c , g ) \rho=(\delta,\tau,c,g) ，由状态操作符、触发条件、观测通道和一次性守卫组成。

paragraphs.en: The validity requirements concern timing, state scope, observation delivery, and endpoint evaluation. Timing tests establish a prior serve and a subsequent single update at the declared request boundary. Scope tests rule out injector-induced changes to unrelated records. Observation checks establish whether the assigned information reached the policy through the admitted channel. Finally, outcome checks use the application state at commit rather than the disclosure text. An episode can satisfy some requirements and fail others; a terminal success flag therefore cannot certify the full intervention history.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性要求涉及时序、状态范围、观测传递以及端点评估。 时序测试在声明的请求边界处确立一次先行的服务调用和一次随后的单一更新。 范围测试排除由注入器引起的对无关记录的更改。 观测检查确认所分配的信息是否通过被认可的通道到达了策略。 最后，结果检查使用提交时的应用状态而非披露文本。 一个回合可能满足部分要求而不满足其余要求；因此，终态成功标志无法证明完整的干预历史。

sents.en: The validity requirements concern timing, state scope, observation delivery, and endpoint evaluation.
sents.zh: 有效性要求涉及时序、状态范围、观测传递以及端点评估。

sents.en: Timing tests establish a prior serve and a subsequent single update at the declared request boundary.
sents.zh: 时序测试在声明的请求边界处确立一次先行的服务调用和一次随后的单一更新。

sents.en: Scope tests rule out injector-induced changes to unrelated records.
sents.zh: 范围测试排除由注入器引起的对无关记录的更改。

sents.en: Observation checks establish whether the assigned information reached the policy through the admitted channel.
sents.zh: 观测检查确认所分配的信息是否通过被认可的通道到达了策略。

sents.en: Finally, outcome checks use the application state at commit rather than the disclosure text.
sents.zh: 最后，结果检查使用提交时的应用状态而非披露文本。

sents.en: An episode can satisfy some requirements and fail others; a terminal success flag therefore cannot certify the full intervention history.
sents.zh: 一个回合可能满足部分要求而不满足其余要求；因此，终态成功标志无法证明完整的干预历史。

paragraphs.en: An initial serve arms the trigger, and the next eligible agent request applies the mutation as an application-side transaction. The transaction is archived independently of the browser frame. Irrelevant-record controls exercise the same machinery while preserving the correct target decision. This construction establishes an auditable check–use interval without presuming that the agent noticed, retained, or understood the original value. The permitted source remains accessible after the update, but absence of a source revisit is not automatically an instruction violation.
paragraphs.zh: 初始服务会预置触发器，下一个符合条件的智能体请求将以应用侧事务的方式执行该变更。 该事务的归档独立于浏览器框架。 无关记录的控制机制使用同一套机制，同时保持正确的目标决策。 这种构造建立了一个可审计的「检查—使用」区间，而不需要假设智能体注意到了、保留或理解了原始值。 更新后，被允许的来源仍然可访问，但未重新访问来源并不自动构成指令违规。

sents.en: An initial serve arms the trigger, and the next eligible agent request applies the mutation as an application-side transaction.
sents.zh: 初始服务会预置触发器，下一个符合条件的智能体请求将以应用侧事务的方式执行该变更。

sents.en: The transaction is archived independently of the browser frame.
sents.zh: 该事务的归档独立于浏览器框架。

sents.en: Irrelevant-record controls exercise the same machinery while preserving the correct target decision.
sents.zh: 无关记录的控制机制使用同一套机制，同时保持正确的目标决策。

sents.en: This construction establishes an auditable check–use interval without presuming that the agent noticed, retained, or understood the original value.
sents.zh: 这种构造建立了一个可审计的「检查—使用」区间，而不需要假设智能体注意到了、保留或理解了原始值。

sents.en: The permitted source remains accessible after the update, but absence of a source revisit is not automatically an instruction violation.
sents.zh: 更新后，被允许的来源仍然可访问，但未重新访问来源并不自动构成指令违规。

paragraphs.en: For a valid episode, the scorer applies the five registered endpoint requirements where applicable: correct target state, a single commit, absence of collateral changes, required post-commit continuation, and consistency between the final report and committed state. Insurance approval does not require the continuation term. Process measures such as source revisits are recorded separately from these outcome invariants.
paragraphs.zh: 对于有效回合，评分器会在适用的情况下应用五项已注册的端点要求：正确的目标状态、单次提交、无附带变更、提交后必要的继续执行，以及最终报告与已提交状态之间的一致性。 保险审批不需要继续执行条款。 诸如重新访问来源之类的过程度量会与这些结果不变量分开记录。

sents.en: For a valid episode, the scorer applies the five registered endpoint requirements where applicable: correct target state, a single commit, absence of collateral changes, required post-commit continuation, and consistency between the final report and committed state.
sents.zh: 对于有效回合，评分器会在适用的情况下应用五项已注册的端点要求：正确的目标状态、单次提交、无附带变更、提交后必要的继续执行，以及最终报告与已提交状态之间的一致性。

sents.en: Insurance approval does not require the continuation term.
sents.zh: 保险审批不需要继续执行条款。

sents.en: Process measures such as source revisits are recorded separately from these outcome invariants.
sents.zh: 诸如重新访问来源之类的过程度量会与这些结果不变量分开记录。

paragraphs.en: Certification exercises the actual environment and candidate scorer before model evaluation. World and trigger tests check the event sequence, target scope, one-shot guard, and condition-equivalent neutral operations. Observation tests compare delivered content with the intended channel. Successful reference policies establish a feasible completion route; deliberately deficient policies test whether the instance can distinguish the specified behavior. These scripts are exercised on the frozen generated instances, since a valid template does not ensure that every generated booking or numerical claim remains discriminative.
paragraphs.zh: 认证环节在模型评估之前对实际环境和候选评分器进行检验。 世界与触发器测试检查事件序列、目标范围、一次性防护以及条件等价的中性操作。 观察测试将交付的内容与预期的通道进行比对。 成功的参考策略确立一条可行的完成路径；刻意有缺陷的策略则测试实例能否区分所指定的行为。 这些脚本在冻结的生成实例上运行，因为有效的模板并不能保证每一个生成的预订或数值声明都仍然具有区分度。

sents.en: Certification exercises the actual environment and candidate scorer before model evaluation.
sents.zh: 认证环节在模型评估之前对实际环境和候选评分器进行检验。

sents.en: Observation tests compare delivered content with the intended channel.
sents.zh: 观察测试将交付的内容与预期的通道进行比对。

sents.en: These scripts are exercised on the frozen generated instances, since a valid template does not ensure that every generated booking or numerical claim remains discriminative.
sents.zh: 这些脚本在冻结的生成实例上运行，因为有效的模板并不能保证每一个生成的预订或数值声明都仍然具有区分度。

paragraphs.en: Scorer tests include event-localization checks, deliberately corrupted records, near-misses, and valid positive controls. The relevant cases include an update firing too early or twice, missing promised observation delivery, a mismatched commit, and an incorrectly accepted or rejected archive. An unavailable check returns monitor error and blocks admission rather than being silently recorded as passing. These tests provide evidence for the specified fault classes; they are not a general guarantee of coverage against unknown defects.
paragraphs.zh: 评分器测试包括事件定位检查、故意损坏的记录、近似错误的情况，以及有效的阳性对照。 相关案例包括更新触发过早或触发两次、未按承诺交付观测结果、提交不匹配，以及错误地接受或拒绝归档。 不可用的检查会返回监控错误并阻止准入，而不是被静默记录为通过。 这些测试为规定的故障类别提供了证据；它们并不是针对未知缺陷的覆盖范围的普遍保证。

sents.en: Scorer tests include event-localization checks, deliberately corrupted records, near-misses, and valid positive controls.
sents.zh: 评分器测试包括事件定位检查、故意损坏的记录、近似错误的情况，以及有效的阳性对照。

sents.en: The relevant cases include an update firing too early or twice, missing promised observation delivery, a mismatched commit, and an incorrectly accepted or rejected archive.
sents.zh: 相关案例包括更新触发过早或触发两次、未按承诺交付观测结果、提交不匹配，以及错误地接受或拒绝归档。

sents.zh: 不可用的检查会返回监控错误并阻止准入，而不是被静默记录为通过。

paragraphs.en: A certificate applies to the candidate and exercised scripted routes. Actual model episodes require fresh delivery evidence, validity classification, and endpoint checks; neither model understanding nor the correctness of every possible trajectory follows from a successful pre-run test.
paragraphs.zh: 证书适用于候选对象及其已执行的脚本化路由。 实际的模型运行片段需要全新的交付证据、有效性分类和端点检查；预运行测试的成功既不能证明模型的理解，也不能证明所有可能轨迹的正确性。

sents.zh: 证书适用于候选对象及其已执行的脚本化路由。

paragraphs.en: The archive separates authoritative state and commit records from delivered model observations and the action trajectory. One implementation reconstructs applicable endpoint invariants; a separate standard-library path re-derives validity classifications from raw events and frozen rules. Terms that cannot be supported by the archive are left unresolved. For the prospective clinic workflow, appointment-availability terms can be reconstructed from saved state, whereas calendar compatibility relies on specified generator and state-preservation conditions; the claims endpoint has broader independent reconstruction coverage (Table 14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 归档将权威状态和提交记录与已投递的模型观察结果及动作轨迹分离开来。 一种实现方式会重建适用的端点不变式；另一条独立的标准库路径则从原始事件和冻结规则中重新推导有效性分类。 归档无法支持的术语将被保留为未解析状态。 对于前瞻性诊所工作流，预约可用性术语可以从保存的状态中重建，而日历兼容性则依赖于指定的生成器和状态保持条件；报销申请端点拥有更广泛的独立重建覆盖范围（表 14）。

paragraphs.en: Here independent refers to separate code paths developed by the same team, not an independent research group or independent source data. Agreement can reveal implementation disagreements but does not establish that their common archived evidence is free of errors. The evaluator challenges in Section 9 test this remaining exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 此处的“独立”指的是由同一团队开发的不同代码路径，而非独立的研究团体或独立的数据源。 一致性可以揭示实现层面的分歧，但并不能证明它们共同的存档证据没有错误。 第 9 节中的评估者挑战测试的就是这一剩余风险。

sents.zh: 此处的“独立”指的是由同一团队开发的不同代码路径，而非独立的研究团体或独立的数据源。

sents.zh: 一致性可以揭示实现层面的分歧，但并不能证明它们共同的存档证据没有错误。

sents.en: The evaluator challenges in Section 9 test this remaining exposure.
sents.zh: 第 9 节中的评估者挑战测试的就是这一剩余风险。

paragraphs.en: A six-stage operational audit records certification, policy isolation, frozen experimental rules, validity-first counting, independent re-derivation, and targeted challenges. Each stage addresses a distinct failure mode, as summarized below.
paragraphs.zh: 一项六阶段的操作审计记录了认证、策略隔离、冻结的实验规则、有效性优先计数、独立重新推导以及定向挑战。 每个阶段针对一种不同的失败模式，总结如下。

sents.en: A six-stage operational audit records certification, policy isolation, frozen experimental rules, validity-first counting, independent re-derivation, and targeted challenges.
sents.zh: 一项六阶段的操作审计记录了认证、策略隔离、冻结的实验规则、有效性优先计数、独立重新推导以及定向挑战。

sents.en: Each stage addresses a distinct failure mode, as summarized below.
sents.zh: 每个阶段针对一种不同的失败模式，总结如下。

paragraphs.en: During prospective execution the sealed model policy uses a separate operating-system account, restricted file permissions and specified browser origins. The harness records model-facing frames and permitted actions; canary and access probes test whether policy inputs remain separated from evaluator files and future-state evidence. These measures bound the policy’s access under the declared harness configuration. They do not reconstruct all provider-side inputs, a limitation documented with the archived evidence inventory.
paragraphs.zh: 在前瞻性执行期间，被封存的模型策略使用独立的操作系统账户、受限的文件权限以及指定的浏览器来源。 测试框架记录面向模型的帧和被允许的操作；金丝雀与访问探针用于检验策略输入是否始终与评估器文件及未来状态证据保持隔离。 这些措施在所声明的测试框架配置下限定了策略的访问范围。 它们并不能重建所有提供方侧的输入，这一局限已随归档的证据清单一并记录在案。

sents.en: During prospective execution the sealed model policy uses a separate operating-system account, restricted file permissions and specified browser origins.
sents.zh: 在前瞻性执行期间，被封存的模型策略使用独立的操作系统账户、受限的文件权限以及指定的浏览器来源。

sents.zh: 这些措施在所声明的测试框架配置下限定了策略的访问范围。

sents.en: They do not reconstruct all provider-side inputs, a limitation documented with the archived evidence inventory.
sents.zh: 它们并不能重建所有提供方侧的输入，这一局限已随归档的证据清单一并记录在案。

paragraphs.en: A reliable task score needs two decisions in order: first whether the episode belongs in the analysis, then whether the committed task outcome passes. The study also needs a comparison rule fixed before any model results are observed. EnvOS documents these decisions per model–workflow study block rather than searching across models for a single leaderboard score.
paragraphs.zh: 一个可靠的任务得分需要依次做出两个决定：首先判断该回合是否属于本次分析，然后判断已提交的任务结果是否通过。 该研究还需要在任何模型结果被观察之前固定好比较规则。 EnvOS 针对每个模型–工作流研究块记录这些决定，而不是跨模型搜索单一的排行榜得分。

sents.en: A reliable task score needs two decisions in order: first whether the episode belongs in the analysis, then whether the committed task outcome passes.
sents.zh: 一个可靠的任务得分需要依次做出两个决定：首先判断该回合是否属于本次分析，然后判断已提交的任务结果是否通过。

sents.en: The study also needs a comparison rule fixed before any model results are observed.
sents.zh: 该研究还需要在任何模型结果被观察之前固定好比较规则。

sents.en: EnvOS documents these decisions per model–workflow study block rather than searching across models for a single leaderboard score.
sents.zh: EnvOS 针对每个模型–工作流研究块记录这些决定，而不是跨模型搜索单一的排行榜得分。

paragraphs.en: Before the first model rollout of a prospective block, the researchers freeze its task instances, conditions, contrasts, budgets, validity rules, reserves, stopping rules, statistical analysis, outcome invariants and interpretation templates. A release manifest hashes 29 repository paths, relevant container images, generator, invoker and requested model identifier; the driver rejects a run if its live artifacts drift. Amendments and departures are dated and reported rather than silently incorporated (Appendices B and M ).
paragraphs.zh: 在一个前瞻性区块的首次模型上线之前，研究者会冻结其任务实例、条件、对照、预算、有效性规则、预留、停止规则、统计分析、结果不变量与解读模板。 发布清单会对 29 个代码库路径、相关容器镜像、生成器、调用器以及请求的模型标识符进行哈希；若运行时的实际工件发生偏移，驱动程序将拒绝该次运行。 修订与偏离会被记录日期并予以报告，而非被悄然纳入（附录 B 与附录 M）。

sents.en: Before the first model rollout of a prospective block, the researchers freeze its task instances, conditions, contrasts, budgets, validity rules, reserves, stopping rules, statistical analysis, outcome invariants and interpretation templates.
sents.zh: 在一个前瞻性区块的首次模型上线之前，研究者会冻结其任务实例、条件、对照、预算、有效性规则、预留、停止规则、统计分析、结果不变量与解读模板。

sents.en: A release manifest hashes 29 repository paths, relevant container images, generator, invoker and requested model identifier; the driver rejects a run if its live artifacts drift.
sents.zh: 发布清单会对 29 个代码库路径、相关容器镜像、生成器、调用器以及请求的模型标识符进行哈希；若运行时的实际工件发生偏移，驱动程序将拒绝该次运行。

sents.en: Amendments and departures are dated and reported rather than silently incorporated (Appendices B and M ).
sents.zh: 修订与偏离会被记录日期并予以报告，而非被悄然纳入（附录 B 与附录 M）。

paragraphs.en: Validity is counted before outcome. Provider rejection or failure to deliver the promised policy input can be excluded and replaced only under the registered reserve (2 per cell; 6 per block). A valid run that reaches its action budget counts as an unsuccessful run, not a replacement. A counted clean-control failure stops a block under the declared rule; that stopping decision alone does not prove a harness defect. The two workflows retain their distinct preregistered treatment of untriggered runs: claims counts them as failures under its table; clinic replaces them because the intended intervention did not occur. The claims blocks used 0 and 0 replacements, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 有效性在结果之前计算。 提供方拒绝或未能交付承诺的策略输入，仅在已登记的储备额度内（每格 2 个；每块 6 个）方可排除并替换。 达到其动作预算的有效运行计为一次不成功运行，而不是替换。 一次被计入的洁净对照失败会按声明的规则中止一个块；仅这一中止决定并不能证明评测框架存在缺陷。 两种工作流各自保留其对未触发运行的预注册处理方式：claims 在其表格下将其计为失败；clinic 则将其替换，因为预期的干预并未发生。 claims 块分别使用了 0 次和 0 次替换。

sents.en: Validity is counted before outcome.
sents.zh: 有效性在结果之前计算。

sents.en: Provider rejection or failure to deliver the promised policy input can be excluded and replaced only under the registered reserve (2 per cell; 6 per block).
sents.zh: 提供方拒绝或未能交付承诺的策略输入，仅在已登记的储备额度内（每格 2 个；每块 6 个）方可排除并替换。

sents.zh: 达到其动作预算的有效运行计为一次不成功运行，而不是替换。

sents.en: A counted clean-control failure stops a block under the declared rule; that stopping decision alone does not prove a harness defect.
sents.zh: 一次被计入的洁净对照失败会按声明的规则中止一个块；仅这一中止决定并不能证明评测框架存在缺陷。

sents.en: The two workflows retain their distinct preregistered treatment of untriggered runs: claims counts them as failures under its table; clinic replaces them because the intended intervention did not occur.
sents.zh: 两种工作流各自保留其对未触发运行的预注册处理方式：claims 在其表格下将其计为失败；clinic 则将其替换，因为预期的干预并未发生。

sents.en: The claims blocks used 0 and 0 replacements, respectively.
sents.zh: claims 块分别使用了 0 次和 0 次替换。

paragraphs.en: Each generated instance is executed under every experimental condition for its block. A treatment-only success means that instance succeeds in the reviewed-information condition but not the comparator; a control-only success is the reverse; and a tie means their success indicators match. The preregistered comparisons use an exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 , with marginal Newcombe 95% intervals for the paired difference. Condition order is fixed and counterbalanced, not randomized.
paragraphs.zh: 每个生成的实例都会在其所属区组的每一种实验条件下执行。 仅处理组成功表示该实例在审阅信息条件下成功而在对照条件下不成功；仅对照组成功则相反；平局表示两者的成功指标一致。 预注册的比较对不一致配对在 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 水平上使用精确的双侧符号检验，并为配对差异提供边缘 Newcombe 95% 区间。 条件顺序是固定且经过平衡的，并非随机化。

sents.en: Each generated instance is executed under every experimental condition for its block.
sents.zh: 每个生成的实例都会在其所属区组的每一种实验条件下执行。

sents.en: A treatment-only success means that instance succeeds in the reviewed-information condition but not the comparator; a control-only success is the reverse; and a tie means their success indicators match.
sents.zh: 仅处理组成功表示该实例在审阅信息条件下成功而在对照条件下不成功；仅对照组成功则相反；平局表示两者的成功指标一致。

sents.en: The preregistered comparisons use an exact two-sided sign test on discordant pairs at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 , with marginal Newcombe 95% intervals for the paired difference.
sents.zh: 预注册的比较对不一致配对在 α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 水平上使用精确的双侧符号检验，并为配对差异提供边缘 Newcombe 95% 区间。

sents.en: Condition order is fixed and counterbalanced, not randomized.
sents.zh: 条件顺序是固定且经过平衡的，并非随机化。

paragraphs.en: The tests assume exchangeable directions of discordance under the null and no carry-over or period effects. Inference is conditional on the fixed instances and one sampled policy rollout per condition; reported intervals and p p -values do not incorporate task-population variation or repeated-model-sampling variation. The total effects include any navigation effort saved by a review information at the fixed action budget. Within-order counts are descriptive, not evidence that period effects are absent. In CLM-BS the arm run first and the arm run second each succeeded on 5 of 10 pairs (by order: Appendix J ); five pairs per order cannot exclude a period effect.

paragraphs.en: We report prospective matched-instance evaluations in clinic booking and insurance-claim approval. Both workflows use preregistered feasibility and validity criteria; task-relevant state changes are held fixed across the principal compared conditions. Table 6 presents full-task outcomes and paired comparisons, and Figure 3 displays instance-level results. Exploratory findings are reported separately in Appendix V and do not contribute to the confirmatory tests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们报告了在诊所预约和保险理赔审批中的前瞻性匹配实例评估。 两种工作流程均使用预先注册的可行性与有效性标准；在与主要比较条件之间，与任务相关的状态变化保持固定。 表 6 展示了完整任务的结果和配对比较，图 3 展示了实例级别的结果。 探索性发现单独在附录 V 中报告，不参与验证性检验。

paragraphs.en: The clinic block (BC) evaluates the contribution of disclosing the updated session location relative to providing a verification reminder and source link. It assigns the same 16 fresh instances to no additional information (OFF-A), a verification reminder with a source link (CUE-A), and direct display of the current location (LIVE-A) in a fixed counterbalanced order, with 3 irrelevant-change controls (LIVE-I). The preregistered primary contrast is LIVE–CUE; the key secondary contrast CUE–OFF asks whether the verification reminder improves success over no additional information before confirmation. These are unconditional, block-local Holm-adjusted comparisons under the fixed 48-action budget.
paragraphs.zh: 临床区块（BC）评估：相对于提供验证提醒及来源链接，披露更新后的会话位置所带来的贡献。 该区块将相同的16个全新实例以固定的平衡顺序分配给三种条件：无附加信息（OFF-A）、带来源链接的验证提醒（CUE-A），以及直接显示当前位置（LIVE-A），并包含3个无关变化对照（LIVE-I）。 预注册的主要对比为 LIVE–CUE；关键次要对比 CUE–OFF 旨在检验：在确认之前，验证提醒相对于无附加信息能否提升成功率。 这些是在固定的48步行动预算下进行的无条件、区块内 Holm 校正比较。

paragraphs.en: Claude Opus 5 passed OFF-A 0/16, CUE-A 2/16 and LIVE-A 15/16 on 16 instances (Table 31 gives every contrast). At the registered block-local level, displaying the current location increased success relative to this cue-and-link panel. The CUE–OFF contrast did not reject; this does not establish absence of a cue effect. Contradiction, salience, and reduced verification effort remain possible explanations. The LIVE–CUE rejection survives the paper-wide Holm analysis over 12 claim-bearing tests (adjusted p = 0.00293 p=0.00293 ). The LIVE-I controls passed 3/3; nothing is attributed to the panel from unmatched controls. The independent scorer reconstructs appointment availability from archived rows; calendar compatibility is not re-derived but rests on stated design conditions (the generator and state preservation), whose checks are reported separately. Under that condition, every outcome term is resolved and agreeing with the evaluator on 51 of 51 counted rollouts (Table 14 ). For transparency, the primary LIVE–CUE contrast has 13 treatment-only successes, 0 control-only successes and 3 ties (net + 0.81 +0.81 [ 0.49 0.49 , 0.92 0.92 ]; exact p = 0.000244 p=0.000244 ; block-local Holm p = 0.000488 p=0.000488 ). The secondary CUE–OFF contrast has 2 treatment-only successes, 0 control-only successes and 14 ties (net + 0.13 +0.13 [ − 0.09 -0.09 , 0.36 0.36 ]; block-local Holm p = 0.5 p=0.5 ).

paragraphs.en: Directly providing the updated location may expose a mismatch with the agent’s previously observed value and avoids requiring navigation back to the session record. A reminder with a source link leaves verification to the agent and can consume additional actions. The registered difference is the total effect of the interface choice at 48 actions. It is not an estimate of “value understanding” with navigation cost removed, and a failure to follow the cue link is not an independent failure under the task instruction. These mechanisms remain possible explanations rather than tested mediators.
paragraphs.zh: 直接提供更新后的位置可能会暴露与智能体此前观察到的值不一致的情况，并避免了要求导航回会话记录的需要。 带有来源链接的提醒将验证工作留给智能体，并可能消耗额外的操作。 所记录的差异是接口选择在 48 次操作时的总体效应。 它不是去除导航成本后对“价值理解”的估计，而且未按提示链接操作也不构成任务指令下的独立失败。 这些机制仍只是可能的解释，而非经过检验的中介变量。

paragraphs.en: The claims blocks evaluate approval accuracy when the current policy is re-exposed before the consequential decision. Each model is evaluated in its own block over the same 10 frozen generated instances (seeds 0–9) with paired OFF-A and ON-A target-change conditions and additional ON-I and L0 controls. The blocks were registered before their model rollouts and follow a frozen counterbalanced order. The interface presents the current policy record before approval, not the calculated approval amount; it combines a verification cue, value re-exposure, contradiction salience and saved lookup effort.
paragraphs.zh: 当当前政策在后续决策之前被重新展示时，claims 区块评估批准的准确性。 每个模型在其各自的区块中，在相同的 10 个冻结生成实例（种子 0–9）上进行评估，采用配对的 OFF-A 与 ON-A 目标变更条件，并附加 ON-I 和 L0 对照。 这些区块在模型上线运行之前预先登记，并遵循固定的平衡顺序。 界面在批准之前展示当前政策记录，而非计算出的批准金额；它结合了核对提示、数值重新展示、矛盾显著性以及节省查询操作成本。

paragraphs.en: Over 10 sealed instance pairs (seeds 0–9), Claude Sonnet 5 met the full approval endpoint on 1/10 without the panel and 9/10 with it; of the pairs, 8 favoured the panel, 0 the arm without it, and 2 neither; net + 0.80 +0.80 [ 0.37 0.37 , 0.92 0.92 ] (marginal 95 % interval), p = 0.00781 p=0.00781 . Controls: ON-I 3/3, L0 1/1. The review-step panel increased full-task success at the registered local level. The OFF-A failure categories and observed pre-commit revisions are reported separately (Appendix H ). The OFF-A–ON-A contrast rejects under its registered block-local analysis but not under the paper-wide Holm analysis (adjusted p = 0.0781 p=0.0781 over 12 tests). That family was finalized after the claims outcomes (Appendix L ). The pre-registered derived-decision gate passed on all three threshold-crossing cases. Every outcome term the independent scorer re-derives is resolved and agreeing with the evaluator on 24 of 24 counted rollouts. The standard-library validity re-derivation agrees with the archive on 25 of 25 attempts. The registered local contrast supports higher full-task success with review-step re-exposure. Its retrospective twelve-test paper-wide Holm adjustment does not reject, so the two inference families must not be conflated. Sonnet applied the superseded limit in 9/10 episodes without additional policy information and requested the policy record after the change in 8/10 ON-A episodes. These are descriptive trajectory counts, not separate randomized tests of verification behavior. The independent scorer’s scope covers all 4 registered outcome terms.
paragraphs.zh: 在 10 个密封实例对（种子 0–9）中，Claude Sonnet 5 在无评审面板时于 1/10 达到完整审批终点，有评审面板时为 9/10；在这些实例对中，8 对倾向于评审面板，0 对倾向于无面板的分支，2 对两者皆不倾向；净效应 +0.80 +0.80 [0.37 0.37, 0.92 0.92]（边际 95% 区间），p = 0.00781 p=0.00781。 对照组：ON-I 3/3，L0 1/1。 评审步骤面板在注册的局部层面提高了完整任务成功率。 OFF-A 的失败类别及观察到的提交前修订将另行报告（附录 H）。 OFF-A–ON-A 对比在其注册的块局部分析下拒绝原假设，但在全文 Holm 分析下不拒绝（12 项检验的校正后 p = 0.0781 p=0.0781）。 该检验族是在声明结果之后确定的（附录 L）。 预注册的派生决策门槛在全部三个越过阈值的案例上均通过。 独立评分者重新推导的每一项结果指标均已解决，且在 24 次被计入的 rollout 中有 24 次与评估者一致。 标准库有效性重新推导在 25 次尝试中有 25 次与归档一致。 注册的局部对比支持在评审步骤重新暴露下更高的完整任务成功率。 其回溯性的十二项检验全文 Holm 校正不拒绝原假设，因此不得将这两个推断族混为一谈。 Sonnet 在没有额外策略信息的情况下，于 9/10 个 episode 中应用了已被取代的限制，并在 8/10 个 ON-A episode 中在变更后请求了策略记录。 这些是描述性的轨迹计数，而非针对验证行为的独立随机化检验。 独立评分者的范围涵盖全部 4 项注册结果指标。

paragraphs.en: Opus succeeded 10/10 in both OFF-A and ON-A; because every OFF-A instance already succeeded, the registered rescue-opportunity gate was not met and no panel-effect claim is made for Opus. In these instances Opus already completed every claim without additional policy information correctly, so the registered rescue-opportunity gate was not met; that ceiling does not establish that the review display is generally ineffective. paragraphs.en: On the ten registered reused claims instances, under the frozen Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview configuration, OFF-A failed on 10/10 instances, but review-step re-exposure did not meet the registered effect criterion (5 rescues, 0 harms, 5 ties; exact paired p = 0.0625); the effect is not shown for these instances under this configuration at this budget, and this is not evidence of no effect. This is a separate preregistered model–invoker configuration on reused claims instances. A non-rejection does not establish absence of a benefit, and differences in provider, invocation and frame-delivery channel prevent isolation of vendor or model effects (Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 在十个已注册的复用主张实例上，在冻结的 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 配置下，OFF-A 在 10/10 个实例上失败，但审查步骤的再次曝光未达到已注册的效应标准（5 次挽救、0 次损害、5 次平局；精确配对 p = 0.0625）；在该预算下、此配置对这批实例未呈现该效应，这并非无效应的证据。 这是在复用主张实例上的另一个预注册的模型调用者配置。 未拒绝并不能证明不存在收益，且提供方、调用方式和框架传递渠道的差异使得无法隔离供应商或模型效应（附录 I）。

paragraphs.en: Agent outcomes are credible only if the evaluation can distinguish clean episodes from corrupted or unsupported records. An archive challenge starts with a preserved episode and changes selected evidence under a known expected verdict. For example, altering the recorded timing so a purportedly mid-task mutation occurs before the old value was served should cause the validity layer to object; simply scoring the final booked row could miss the issue. An outcome scorer reconstructs task invariants, validity reconstruction re-applies eligibility rules, and evaluator replay reproduces the archived evaluator’s own checks. A simple raw-log checker serves as a limited comparator, not an independent oracle. The challenge is whether each layer recognizes the corruption within its stated scope.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的结果只有在评估能够区分干净回合与被篡改或缺乏依据的记录时才是可信的。 归档挑战以一个已保存的回合为起点，并在已知预期判定的情况下更改选定的证据。 例如，篡改记录的时间，使一个据称发生在任务执行中途的变更出现在旧值被提供之前，应当导致有效性层提出异议；仅对最终记录的行打分可能会漏掉这个问题。 结果评分器重建任务不变量，有效性重建重新应用资格规则，评估器重放则复现已归档评估器自身的检查。 一个简单的原始日志检查器只能作为有限的对比器，而不是独立的仲裁标准。 挑战在于每一层能否在其声明的范围内识别出这些篡改。

sents.zh: 挑战在于每一层能否在其声明的范围内识别出这些篡改。

paragraphs.en: The sealed, run-once challenge was built with repository access but was unseen by the Claude agents that built the pipeline. The rule-only challenge was specified from rule excerpts and the archive schema without implementation or outcome access, then instantiated by the authors and separately reviewed for fidelity. The external Gemini CLI challenge supplied rules, schema and archive copies to an agent that designed and generated its own cases. None was an independent-team audit. The challenges differ in their access, implementation, and the kinds of errors they can test; their original frozen expectations are kept even where disputed.
paragraphs.zh: 这个密封的、只运行一次的挑战在构建时可以访问代码库，但构建该流水线的 Claude 智能体从未见过它。 仅有规则的挑战根据规则摘录和存档模式进行规定，无法访问实现或结果，随后由作者实例化，并另行审查其保真度。 外部 Gemini CLI 挑战将规则、模式和存档副本提供给一个智能体，由其设计并生成自己的案例。 没有一个是独立团队的审计。 这些挑战在访问权限、实现方式以及能测试的错误类型上各不相同；它们最初冻结的预期即使存在争议也予以保留。

paragraphs.en: A separate model built a run-once 28-case challenge, white-box to its builder but unseen by the Claude agents that built the pipeline; the outcome scorer met 28/28 sealed expectations, validity re-derivation 24/28 and archived evaluator replay 10/28, unrepaired (Table 12 , Appendix C ); not blind validation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个独立的模型构建了一个仅运行一次的 28 个案例的挑战集，对其构建者来说是白盒，但对构建该流水线的 Claude 智能体而言是不可见的；结果评分器满足 28/28 的封存预期，有效性重新推导为 24/28，存档评估器重放为 10/28，均未修复（表 12，附录 C）；这并非盲测验证。

paragraphs.en: A fresh GPT-6 chat given only rule excerpts and the archive schema (no code, paper, earlier cases or outcomes) specified 56 cases with expected verdicts. We implemented them on archive copies under frozen rules; a second chat reviewed fidelity, and 36 admitted cases ran once. The pipeline accepted all 10 controls and, of 26 corruptions, caught 24 (one under another class), gave no verdict on 2 and counted none as clean (outcome scorer alone: 10; raw-log baselines: 19). Only the case design was blind, and clinic coverage is thin (Appendix E ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个全新的 GPT-6 对话在只获得规则摘录和归档模式（不提供代码、论文、早期案例或结果）的情况下，指定了 56 个案例及其预期判定结果。 我们在冻结规则下于归档副本上实现了这些案例；由第二个对话审查保真度，其中 36 个被接受的案例各运行一次。 该流水线接受了全部 10 个对照案例，并在 26 个损坏案例中捕获了 24 个（其中 1 个被归入另一类别），对 2 个未给出判定结果，且没有把任何一个计为干净案例（仅用结果评分器时：10 个；原始日志基线：19 个）。 只有案例设计采用了盲测，且诊所覆盖面较薄（附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: A Gemini CLI agent given only the rules, schema and 15 archive copies designed 56 cases and wrote their generator, which we ran unread, sealed and scored once per tool. The pipeline caught 14/20 claims and 11/19 clinic corruptions (raw-log baselines 1, 3), counted 4 and 8 as clean (baselines 15, 15) and rejected 3 of 16 controls (baselines ≤ \leq 1). We dispute 19 expectations; it used one base per workflow, and an LLM agent is no independent team (Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个仅给定规则、模式（schema）和 15 份存档副本的 Gemini CLI 智能体设计了 56 个用例并编写了它们的生成器，我们在未阅读的情况下运行了这些用例，将其封存并针对每个工具评分一次。 该流程捕获了 14/20 的声明和 11/19 的诊所损坏（原始日志基线分别为 1 和 3），将 4 个和 8 个判定为干净（基线为 15 和 15），并拒绝了 16 个对照组中的 3 个（基线 ≤ \leq 1）。 我们对 19 项预期提出异议；它在每个工作流中只使用一个基座模型，且一个 LLM 智能体并不是独立的团队（附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: A corruption caught and rejected is not the same as one receiving no verdict, and an expected verdict challenged by the authors is not automatically a proven evaluator defect. The external challenge’s original labels include 12 of 39 designated corruptions counted clean and 19 disputed expectations after scoring; its pipeline also rejected three of 16 controls, as detailed in Appendix F . We retain the original classification alongside the disputes rather than replacing the headline with a retrospectively restricted subset.
paragraphs.zh: 被捕获并予以拒绝的损坏样本与未获得任何判定结果的样本并不相同，而作者所质疑的预期判定结果也并不自动构成已被证实的评估器缺陷。 如附录 F 所详述，该外部质疑的原始标注中，39 个指定损坏样本里有 12 个在计分时被计为干净样本，并存在 19 个存在争议的预期结果；其流程还拒绝了 16 个对照样本中的 3 个。 我们在保留原始分类的同时呈现这些争议，而不是用回溯性收窄后的子集来替换主要结果。

paragraphs.en: This comparison is post hoc, author-built and not blind: after the sealed result, which stands unchanged, we wrote a simple checker rebuilding each verdict from the same raw state, access log and served pages, with the pipeline in view, and sealed each before its one run (Table 7 ). No protocol path rejected a control; the clinic baseline rejected one. Within the baseline’s declared scope both rejected 11 of 12 clinic corruptions; on claims the pipeline rejected 10 and the baseline 6 of 12. A careful simple checker thus reproduced most narrow clinic checks; EnvOS adds breadth (delivery, served arm, collateral state) that such a checker could be extended to cover, and the baseline alone caught one case (Appendix D ). As we built both cases and checkers, only the external challenge above tests independent construction, and there the pipeline counted 4 of 20 claims and 8 of 19 clinic corruptions as clean.
paragraphs.zh: 此对比是事后进行的、由作者构建且非盲测的：在密封结果（保持不变）之后，我们在可见流水线的情况下编写了一个简单的校验器，从相同的原始状态、访问日志和所提供的页面重建每个判定，并在其唯一一次运行之前进行了密封（表 7）。 没有任何协议路径拒绝了对照；临床基线拒绝了一个。 在基线声明的范围内，两者都拒绝了 12 个临床损坏中的 11 个；在声明上，流水线拒绝了 12 个中的 10 个，而基线拒绝了 6 个。 因此，一个精心编写的简单校验器复现了大部分窄范围的临床检查；EnvOS 增加了此类校验器可扩展覆盖的广度（交付、所提供的分支、附带状态），且基线单独捕获了一个案例（附录 D）。 由于我们构建了这两个案例和校验器，只有上述外部挑战能测试独立构建，而在该挑战中，流水线将 20 个声明中的 4 个和 19 个临床损坏中的 8 个判定为干净。

paragraphs.en: Within the simple baseline’s declared scope, the gap is smaller than an unrestricted total might suggest: on the clinic subset both approaches rejected 11 of 12 corruptions, while on claims the pipeline rejected 10 and the baseline 6 of 12 (Table 7 ). The baseline and comparison cases were constructed post hoc by the authors with the pipeline in view, and the scores should not be interpreted as an unbiased detection-rate estimate. The external challenge is the more consequential test of independently constructed cases, albeit still produced by a model agent rather than an independent research team.
paragraphs.zh: 在简单基线所声明的适用范围内，差距比无限制的总数可能显示的要小：在临床子集上，两种方法均拒绝了12个损坏中的11个，而在索赔上，该流程拒绝了10个，基线拒绝了6个（表7）。 基线与对比案例是作者在考虑该流程的情况下事后构建的，因此这些分数不应被解读为无偏的检测率估计。 外部挑战是对独立构建案例的更具决定性的检验，尽管这些案例仍由一个模型智能体而非独立研究团队产生。

sents.zh: 外部挑战是对独立构建案例的更具决定性的检验，尽管这些案例仍由一个模型智能体而非独立研究团队产生。

paragraphs.en: The archive challenges are better interpreted as tests of specific failure hypotheses than as a single scalar score for evaluator quality. The first sealed challenge kept its builder’s access and tested whether separate layers reproduced frozen expectations. A second challenge separated case specification from implementation and access to previous outcomes, but the cases were subsequently instantiated by the authors and therefore do not constitute end-to-end blind testing. The external challenge delegated both case design and generator construction to a different model agent, making it less entangled with the pipeline’s design decisions but still not equivalent to validation by an independent research team.
paragraphs.zh: 存档挑战更适合被理解为对特定失败假设的检验，而不是对评估器质量的单一标量评分。 第一个密封挑战保留了构建者的访问权限，检验的是不同层级能否复现冻结的预期。 第二个挑战将案例规范与实现以及对先前结果的访问分离开来，但这些案例随后由作者实例化，因此并不构成端到端的盲测。 外部挑战将案例设计和生成器构建都委托给了一个不同的模型智能体，使其与流水线的设计决策较少纠缠，但仍不等同于由独立研究团队进行的验证。

sents.zh: 存档挑战更适合被理解为对特定失败假设的检验，而不是对评估器质量的单一标量评分。

paragraphs.en: Four outcomes must be separately reported. A detected corruption is caught and appropriately barred from clean results; an undetected corruption enters as clean; a no-verdict case is not accepted clean but also does not produce the registered classification; and a control rejection incorrectly challenges evidence designated valid. Disputed expected verdicts are additionally tracked without assuming either side of the dispute is right. The external challenge produced examples of all the consequential categories, including 12 of 39 designated corruptions accepted as clean, three of 16 controls rejected, and 19 disputed expectations. Reporting only the caught cases would overstate reliability, while collapsing abstentions into successful detections would erase uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 四种结果必须分别报告。 被检出的污染会被捕获并适当地排除在干净结果之外；未被检出的污染会作为干净结果进入；无判定的情况不会被当作干净结果接受，但也不会产生已登记的分类；而对照被拒则是对被指定为有效证据的错误质疑。 有争议的预期判定会被额外追踪，而不假定争议中任何一方是正确的。 外部质疑产生了所有有后果类别的实例，包括被指定为污染的 39 个样本中有 12 个被当作干净结果接受、16 个对照中有 3 个被拒绝，以及 19 个有争议的预期。 只报告被捕获的案例会夸大可靠性，而把弃权归并为成功检出则会抹去不确定性。

sents.en: Four outcomes must be separately reported.
sents.zh: 四种结果必须分别报告。

paragraphs.en: The post-hoc simple-checker comparison asks a different question: which classes of defects are covered by the protocol’s audit layers beyond a short baseline operating on the same raw evidence? Because the baseline and many mutations were constructed by the same authors after viewing the pipeline, the difference is diagnostic, not an unbiased population detection-rate estimate. The within-scope counts matter: for the narrow clinic subset, both pipeline and baseline catch 11 of 12; for claims, the pipeline catches 10 of 12 compared with six for the baseline. EnvOS’s broader checking surface remains useful, but breadth does not imply that every individual check is more accurate.
paragraphs.zh: 事后简单检查器对比回答的是另一个问题：在作用于相同原始证据的短基线之外，协议的审计层还能覆盖哪些类别的缺陷？ 由于基线和许多变异是在查看流水线之后由同一批作者构建的，因此这种差异具有诊断意义，而不是无偏的总体检出率估计。 范围内的计数很重要：在狭窄的诊所子集上，流水线和基线都抓住了12个中的11个；在理赔上，流水线抓住了12个中的10个，而基线只抓住了6个。 EnvOS 更广的检查面仍然有用，但广并不意味着每个单项检查都更准确。

sents.en: The post-hoc simple-checker comparison asks a different question: which classes of defects are covered by the protocol’s audit layers beyond a short baseline operating on the same raw evidence?
sents.zh: 事后简单检查器对比回答的是另一个问题：在作用于相同原始证据的短基线之外，协议的审计层还能覆盖哪些类别的缺陷？

paragraphs.en: Certification, re-derivation and audits surfaced 11 defects, which now serve as regression cases. For 7, a previously scored archive already carried a model verdict under the defective code. Examples include timing, delivery and scoring mismatches that could otherwise become erroneous claims about agent behavior (Appendix W ). Every historical and prospective block is interpreted under the actual code that governed it; repairs do not retroactively make an earlier verdict more reliable. The remaining undetected corruptions, unevaluable archive terms and incomplete provider-side traces show why an evaluator should be regarded as tested within stated bounds, not certified correct in general.
paragraphs.zh: 认证、重新推导和审计共发现了 11 处缺陷，这些缺陷现在作为回归测试用例。 对于其中的 7 处，先前已评分的存档在缺陷代码下已经带有模型判定结果。 例子包括时序、交付和评分方面的不匹配，若不处理，它们可能变成关于智能体行为的错误论断（附录 W）。 每一个历史性区块和前瞻性区块都在治理它的实际代码下进行解读；修复不会追溯地使先前的判定更可靠。 其余未被发现的损坏、无法评估的存档条目以及不完整的提供方侧追踪记录表明，评估器应被视为在所述范围内经过测试，而不是在一般意义上被认证为正确。

paragraphs.en: A phenomenon-based benchmark must distinguish the application state that changes from the model-visible information used to communicate that change. EnvOS encodes this distinction in an executable perturbation and makes certification a prerequisite to model measurement. Its most specific evaluated contribution is the combination of a prior-serve requirement, controlled review-step disclosure, and independent tests of timing, delivered observations and scoring. The goal is not to replace general-purpose benchmark generation or to claim that injections or evaluator tests themselves are unprecedented. Instead, the design is organized around which concrete evidence can support each conclusion about a sampled agent action. Supplementary phenomenon families illustrate other state-change classes under their own recorded execution and analysis conditions (Appendix S1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于现象的基准测试必须区分发生变化的应用状态与用于传达该变化的模型可见信息。 EnvOS 在一个可执行的扰动中编码了这一区分，并将认证作为模型测量的前提。 其所评估的最具体贡献是先验服务要求、受控的审查步骤披露，以及对时机、交付观测和评分的独立测试三者的结合。 其目标不是取代通用的基准测试生成，也不是声称注入或评估器测试本身是前所未有的。 相反，该设计围绕「哪些具体证据能够支持关于采样智能体行为的每一个结论」来组织。 补充的现象族在其他类别下展示了其他状态变化类别，并遵循各自记录的执行与分析条件（附录 S1）。
