paragraphs.en: OSWorld 2.0 evaluates realistic computer workflows with mid-task information updates ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) . Gaia2 studies asynchronous changes and temporal constraints ( Froger et al., 2026 ; Froger et al., 2025 ) ; InterruptBench changes user goals during execution ( Zou et al., 2026 ) . StressWeb studies controlled interface and action-semantic perturbations ( Bai et al., 2026 ) , while DynamicGUIBench and AgentHijack examine changes to dynamic interfaces, observation and control ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . STT-Arena is particularly close: it builds dynamic tool environments and validates injected conflicts, timing and plan disruption ( Hui et al., 2026 ) . These efforts already establish controlled interventions and validation as important design ideas. EnvOS instead narrows its experimental target to an application value first served to a browser agent, then superseded, with matched review-step disclosure conditions and archive-level checks of that sequence. This is a benign time-of-check–time-of-use gap ( Lilienthal et al., 2025 ) , not a claim that the gap itself is newly identified.
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld 2.0 通过任务中途的信息更新来评估真实istic 的计算机工作流（Yuan et al., 2026）。 Gaia2 研究异步变化和时间约束（Froger et al., 2026；Froger et al., 2025）；InterruptBench 在执行期间改变用户目标（Zou et al., 2026）。 StressWeb 研究受控的界面与动作语义扰动（Bai et al., 2026），而 DynamicGUIBench 和 AgentHijack 考察动态界面、观察与控制的变化（Liu et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026）。 STT-Arena 与本工作尤为接近：它构建动态工具环境，并验证注入的冲突、时序与计划中断（Hui et al., 2026）。 这些工作已经确立了受控干预与验证作为重要的设计思想。 EnvOS 则将实验目标收窄为一个应用价值：先提供给一个浏览器智能体，随后被取代，并在匹配的审查步骤披露条件下对该序列进行归档层面的检查。 这是一个良性的检查时间–使用时间间隙（Lilienthal et al., 2025），并非声称该间隙本身是新发现的。

paragraphs.en: STALE studies recognition and downstream use of invalidated memories ( Chao et al., 2026 ) ; EnvProbe considers when an agent re-queries its environment ( Song et al., 2026 ) ; and work on agent–computer observation interfaces examines richer between-step observations ( Li et al., 2026 ) . EnvOS evaluates durable task actions under an unchanged instruction and contrasts no additional information, a link to accessible source information, and direct display of the current value. It does not claim that improved observation is new or that a record’s prior serve proves comprehension.
paragraphs.zh: STALE 研究已失效记忆的识别与下游使用 ( Chao et al., 2026 )；EnvProbe 考虑智能体何时重新查询其环境 ( Song et al., 2026 )；而关于智能体–计算机观察接口的工作则研究步骤之间更丰富的观察 ( Li et al., 2026 )。 EnvOS 在指令不变的情况下评估持久性任务动作，并对比三种条件：无附加信息、提供可访问的源信息的链接，以及直接显示当前值。 它并不声称改进观察是新的贡献，也不认为某条记录此前曾被使用过就证明了理解。

paragraphs.en: CUA-Gym co-generates task instructions, environment states and verifiable reward functions for computer-use training ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . This is a substantive task-generation contribution; EnvOS does not replace it or claim that generation itself is novel. The two are complementary: CUA-Gym scales environments and rewards for training, whereas EnvOS certifies that a mid-episode change and its verifier behave as specified, a precondition for trusting either as a training signal. Our scientific unit is a mid-episode authoritative transition anchored to the agent’s prior serve , with separately controlled review-time disclosure and archived evidence supporting or withholding an outcome verdict. The present study uses authored phenomenon specifications and an implemented perturbation mechanism in a bounded synthetic testbed; it does not establish general autonomous discovery or synthesis of new change classes. Likewise, STT-Arena already injects dynamic spatio-temporal conflicts and validates key intervention properties. The distinction here is not “first dynamic event” but the specific exposure-and-delivery contract, matched disclosure contrasts and independent archive checks around the resulting full-task action.
paragraphs.zh: CUA-Gym 为计算机使用训练共同生成任务指令、环境状态和可验证的奖励函数（Wang et al., 2026）。 这是一项实质性的任务生成贡献；EnvOS 并不取代它，也不声称生成本身具有新颖性。 二者是互补的：CUA-Gym 为训练扩展环境与奖励，而 EnvOS 则验证一次片段中期的变更及其校验器按规范运行，这是将二者作为训练信号加以信任的前提条件。 我们的科学研究单元是锚定于智能体先前服务的一次片段中期权威转换，其中审查时披露被单独控制，且存档证据支持或暂缓某一结果裁决。 本研究在一个有界的合成测试平台中使用编写好的现象规范和已实现的扰动机制；它并未确立一般性的自主发现或新变更类别的合成。 同样，STT-Arena 已经注入动态时空冲突并验证了关键的干预属性。 这里的区别不在于“首个动态事件”，而在于围绕所得完整任务动作的特定暴露与交付契约、匹配的披露对照以及独立的存档检查。

paragraphs.en: Multi-service environments such as TheAgentCompany and controlled task-generation systems motivate reproducible application workflows; generation alone is not the contribution here. OpenComputer investigates verifiable software worlds and state-based judging ( Wei et al., 2026 ) . ABC and log-based evaluation critiques document task, reward and attribution threats ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kirgis et al., 2026 ) ; broader reviews question what an aggregate agent score measures ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Patel et al., 2026 ) . EnvOS combines established techniques—state-based outcomes, preregistration, mutation testing, independent code paths and provenance hashes—around the specific timing, disclosure and scoring of an authoritative mid-task change. The comparison concerns focus and evidence coverage, not a claim that other benchmarks lack validation or that this feature combination is universally unprecedented (extended discussion: Appendix X ).
paragraphs.zh: 诸如 TheAgentCompany 的多服务环境以及受控任务生成系统推动了可复现的应用工作流；单纯生成并非本文的贡献所在。 OpenComputer 研究可验证的软件世界和基于状态的评判（ Wei et al., 2026 ）。 ABC 与基于日志的评估批评记录了任务、奖励和归因方面的威胁（ Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kirgis et al., 2026 ）；更广泛的综述则质疑智能体聚合分数究竟衡量了什么（ Zhu et al., 2026 ; Patel et al., 2026 ）。 EnvOS 围绕一次权威性任务中途变更的具体时机、披露与评分，整合了已有技术——基于状态的结果、预注册、变异测试、独立代码路径和来源哈希。 这里的比较关注的是侧重点与证据覆盖面，并非声称其他基准缺乏验证，也不是声称这一特征组合在所有方面都前所未有（详细讨论见：Appendix X ）。

paragraphs.en: The prospective evaluation covers two workflows in a synthetic workplace under a controlled semantic-browser interface, with fixed, counterbalanced instance orders and one sampled rollout per condition. These settings do not establish performance in unrestricted native computer use or naturally occurring change-time distributions. The principal contrasts manipulate review-time information while retaining the same authoritative mutation in both paired conditions; they do not estimate the causal effect of environmental change itself. Small paired samples and potential order effects further limit generalization, and non-rejection does not establish equivalence. We evaluate agents but do not train them; whether certified non-stationary environments improve RL-trained computer-use agents is untested.
paragraphs.zh: 前瞻性评估在一个受控语义浏览器界面下的合成工作场所中覆盖两个工作流，采用固定且经过平衡的实例顺序，每个条件仅进行一次抽样执行。 这些设置无法确立在不受限制的原生计算机使用或自然发生的变化时间分布下的表现。 主要对比在操控审查时间信息的同时，在两个配对条件中保留相同的权威变更；它们并不估计环境变化本身的因果效应。 较小的配对样本以及潜在的顺序效应进一步限制了结论的推广性，且未拒绝原假设并不等同于证明等价性。 我们评估智能体但不训练它们；经过认证的非平稳环境能否改进经强化学习训练的计算机使用智能体仍未经过检验。

sents.en: The prospective evaluation covers two workflows in a synthetic workplace under a controlled semantic-browser interface, with fixed, counterbalanced instance orders and one sampled rollout per condition.
sents.zh: 前瞻性评估在一个受控语义浏览器界面下的合成工作场所中覆盖两个工作流，采用固定且经过平衡的实例顺序，每个条件仅进行一次抽样执行。

sents.zh: 这些设置无法确立在不受限制的原生计算机使用或自然发生的变化时间分布下的表现。

sents.en: The principal contrasts manipulate review-time information while retaining the same authoritative mutation in both paired conditions; they do not estimate the causal effect of environmental change itself.
sents.zh: 主要对比在操控审查时间信息的同时，在两个配对条件中保留相同的权威变更；它们并不估计环境变化本身的因果效应。

sents.zh: 较小的配对样本以及潜在的顺序效应进一步限制了结论的推广性，且未拒绝原假设并不等同于证明等价性。

paragraphs.en: Evidence coverage is also bounded. Served pages and delivered frames do not establish agent comprehension. In clinic booking, calendar compatibility is not independently reconstructed from the archived records, and certain provider-side inputs and historical endpoints are incomplete (Appendices R and J ). Independently implemented checkers were developed by the same team and rely on shared archived evidence. External archive challenges reveal residual false acceptance and control-rejection errors, with some expected verdicts disputed; the case sets are not population-level error-rate estimates. Supplementary phenomenon-family experiments use different settings and are kept separate from the prospective results (Appendix S1 ). All prospective inferential claims of the paper rest on Claude-model blocks; the only non-Anthropic block (CLM-BG) is a separately registered configuration follow-up on reused instances. A pre-registered screenshot-only coordinate-action crossover of the claims workflow stopped at its engineering admission gate before any model rollout: viewport fit failed (18 of 144 page checks did not fit) and legibility failed (4 of 404 values unrecovered at 1536 × 864 1536\times 864 ). It therefore contributes no behavioral evidence, and interface robustness remains untested.
paragraphs.zh: 证据覆盖范围同样是有边界的。 已服务的页面和已交付的帧并不能证明智能体的理解。 在诊所预约任务中，日历兼容性并未根据存档记录独立重建，且某些提供方侧的输入和历史端点不完整（附录 R 和 J）。 独立实现的检查器由同一团队开发，并依赖于共享的存档证据。 外部存档挑战揭示了残余的误接受和误拒绝（控制被拒绝）错误，部分预期判定存在争议；这些案例集并非总体层面的错误率估计。 补充的现象族实验使用不同的设置，并与前瞻性结果分开保留（附录 S1）。 论文的所有前瞻性推断性结论都基于 Claude 系列模型组块；唯一非 Anthropic 的组块（CLM-BG）是一个单独注册的、在复用实例上进行的配置后续实验。 一项预注册的仅基于截图的坐标操作交叉实验针对理赔工作流在任何模型上线之前就止步于其工程准入门槛：视口适配未通过（144 项页面检查中有 18 项未适配），可读性未通过（在 1536 × 864 1536\times 864 分辨率下 404 个数值中有 4 个未能恢复）。 因此它不提供任何行为证据，界面鲁棒性仍未得到检验。

paragraphs.en: EnvOS integrates phenomenon-based task construction, executable intervention certification, controlled agent evaluation, and evidence-based auditing into a single experimental workflow. By distinguishing authoritative state transitions from their observation channels and by evaluating episode validity before task success, the framework establishes a more explicit evidential basis for claims about agents operating in changing environments.
paragraphs.zh: EnvOS 将基于现象的任务构建、可执行的干预认证、受控的智能体评估以及基于证据的审计整合到一个统一的实验工作流中。 通过将权威状态转换与其观察通道区分开来，并在任务成功之前先评估回合有效性，该框架为关于智能体在变化环境中运行的主张建立了更明确的证据基础。

sents.en: EnvOS integrates phenomenon-based task construction, executable intervention certification, controlled agent evaluation, and evidence-based auditing into a single experimental workflow.

paragraphs.en: In the prospective stale-information study, the underlying mutation was fixed while review-time information varied. Direct presentation of the current clinic location improved booking success relative to a verification reminder and source link under the registered and paper-wide analyses. The insurance results show configuration-dependent behavior: Opus 5 succeeded without re-exposure on the tested instances, while Sonnet 5 benefited at its registered local level but not under the retrospective paper-wide adjustment. These contrasts concern review-time information, not a no-change baseline or general model ranking.
paragraphs.zh: 在前瞻性陈旧信息研究中，潜在突变是固定的，而审查时信息是变化的。 在注册分析和全文分析下，直接呈现当前诊所位置相较于验证提醒和来源链接提高了预订成功率。 保险结果显示出依赖配置的行为：Opus 5 在测试实例上无需重新曝光即成功，而 Sonnet 5 在其注册的局部层面受益，但在回顾性全文调整下则不然。 这些对比涉及审查时信息，而非无变化基线或总体模型排名。

paragraphs.en: The prospective claims and clinic experiments, not the historical predecessor blocks, carry the model-effect conclusions (Section 8 ). In clinic booking, at the block-local level the value display increased success relative to the cue-and-link panel (LIVE–CUE block-local Holm p = 0.000488 p=0.000488 , paper-wide p = 0.00293 p=0.00293 ; CUE–OFF block-local p = 0.5 p=0.5 ). In insurance-claim approval Opus succeeded 10/10 without review-step re-exposure, and for Sonnet the panel increased full-task success at the registered local level (block-local p = 0.00781 p=0.00781 ; retrospective paper-wide Holm p = 0.0781 p=0.0781 ). These contrasts estimate within-configuration effects; unrejected comparisons do not establish absence or equivalence. The auditing challenges and the post-hoc, author-built raw-log comparisons show concretely that intervention, delivery and scoring checks can disagree on the same corrupted archive, so each layer must be tested rather than assumed correct.
paragraphs.zh: 前瞻性声明与临床实验，而非历史上的前身区块，承载模型效果的结论（第 8 节）。 在临床预约中，在区块局部层面，数值展示相对于提示加链接面板提高了成功率（LIVE–CUE 区块局部 Holm p = 0.000488 p=0.000488，全文 p = 0.00293 p=0.00293；CUE–OFF 区块局部 p = 0.5 p=0.5）。 在保险理赔审批中，Opus 在无审查步骤再暴露的情况下成功 10/10，而对 Sonnet，该面板在注册的局部层面提高了完整任务成功率（区块局部 p = 0.00781 p=0.00781；回顾性全文 Holm p = 0.0781 p=0.0781）。 这些对比估计的是配置内效应；未被拒绝的比较不能证明不存在差异或等价性。 审计挑战以及事后由作者构建的原始日志比较具体地表明，对于同一个受损的存档，干预、投放和评分检查可能得出不一致的结果，因此每一层都必须经过测试，而不能假定其正确。

paragraphs.en: Archive-based reconstruction and evaluator challenges reveal both useful verification coverage and remaining failure modes. The methodological contribution is therefore a pipeline in which the intervention, pre-run checks, model observations, committed outcome, and evaluator claims can be inspected separately, with residual uncertainty explicitly retained. A natural next step is to use certified EnvOS environments as non-stationary, verifiable-reward environments for reinforcement learning of computer-use agents, with certification and evaluator audits helping to guard the reward against hacking.
paragraphs.zh: 基于存档的重建与评估器挑战既揭示了有用的验证覆盖范围，也暴露了尚未解决的失败模式。 因此，方法论上的贡献是一个流水线，其中干预、预运行检查、模型观察、提交的结果和评估器的主张都可以分别检查，并显式保留剩余的不确定性。 一个自然的下一步是将经过认证的 EnvOS 环境用作非平稳、可验证奖励的环境，用于计算机使用智能体的强化学习，并通过认证和评估器审计来帮助防止奖励被攻破。

paragraphs.en: Every quantitative statement in this paper is a macro emitted by a claim ledger ( claims.py ) that re-derives it from a hashed artifact and fails on any missing or drifting input and on any macro used but not defined (Appendix Y ); in Section 8 and the conclusion, every sentence interpreting a prospective block is a template selected by the ledger (Appendix K ), and the abstract and Section 1 state the same conclusions in shortened prose with every number still emitted by the ledger; ADDENDA 18 and 19 and the claims pre-registration are frozen (each file verifies against its sha256 record) and the interpretation templates are sealed. The figures are generated from the same artifacts. The anonymous supplement includes the raw text archives, search logs, results, independent scorer outputs and validity re-derivations for every prospective block reported in the main text, including BC; a no-model reproduction target recomputes the cells of Table 6 , the per-instance grids of Figure 3 , all registered paired tests and the associated audit counts from those packaged artifacts. It also contains the environment, task-module, certifier, scorer, harness, invoker and test sources; the pre-registrations, certificates, block specifications, release manifests and search logs; the raw text archives of the historical, claims (CLM-BG included) and Blocks BC and BCS model episodes (no screenshot frame ships, for size); the held-out battery and the sealed archive challenge after its one run; and a reproduction script that needs no network, world or model. Evidence that cannot be reconstructed, such as slot occupancy at booking time in the historical blocks and the CLI’s unarchived defaults, is listed rather than inferred: Appendix Y states the result of an offline run of the supplement’s reproduction script and what is permanently missing, and points to the supplement’s complete inventory, which ships as a generated provenance file.
paragraphs.zh: 本文中的每一个量化陈述都是由一个声明账本（claims.py）发出的宏，该账本从哈希工件中重新推导出这些陈述，并在任何输入缺失或漂移、以及任何宏被使用但未定义时直接失败（附录Y）；在第8节和结论部分，每一句解读前瞻性区块的话都是由该账本选定的模板（附录K），摘要和第1节以更简短的行文陈述相同的结论，其中每一个数字仍由账本发出；补遗18和19以及声明预注册已冻结（每个文件均能对照其sha256记录完成校验），解读模板也已封存。 各图均由相同的工件生成。 匿名补充材料包含正文中报告的每个前瞻性区块（包括BC）的原始文本档案、搜索日志、结果、独立评分器输出和有效性重新推导；一个无模型复现目标会从这些打包的工件中重新计算表6的单元格、图3的逐实例网格、所有已注册的配对检验以及相关的审计计数。 它还包含环境、任务模块、认证器、评分器、测试框架、调用器和测试的源代码；预注册、证书、区块规范、发布清单和搜索日志；历史区块、声明（包括CLM-BG）以及区块BC和BCS的模型回合的原始文本档案（出于体积考虑，不含任何截图帧）；保留测试集以及一次性运行后的封存档案挑战；还有一个无需网络、外部环境或模型即可运行的复现脚本。 无法重建的证据，例如历史区块中的预订时点槽位占用情况以及CLI未归档的默认设置，均以列表形式给出而非推断得出：附录Y说明了补充材料复现脚本一次离线运行的结果以及永久缺失的内容，并指向补充材料的完整清单，该清单以生成的溯源文件形式随附发布。

sents.en: It also contains the environment, task-module, certifier, scorer, harness, invoker and test sources; the pre-registrations, certificates, block specifications, release manifests and search logs; the raw text archives of the historical, claims (CLM-BG included) and Blocks BC and BCS model episodes (no screenshot frame ships, for size); the held-out battery and the sealed archive challenge after its one run; and a reproduction script that needs no network, world or model.
sents.zh: 它还包含环境、任务模块、认证器、评分器、测试框架、调用器和测试的源代码；预注册、证书、区块规范、发布清单和搜索日志；历史区块、声明（包括CLM-BG）以及区块BC和BCS的模型回合的原始文本档案（出于体积考虑，不含任何截图帧）；保留测试集以及一次性运行后的封存档案挑战；还有一个无需网络、外部环境或模型即可运行的复现脚本。

sents.en: Evidence that cannot be reconstructed, such as slot occupancy at booking time in the historical blocks and the CLI’s unarchived defaults, is listed rather than inferred: Appendix Y states the result of an offline run of the supplement’s reproduction script and what is permanently missing, and points to the supplement’s complete inventory, which ships as a generated provenance file.
sents.zh: 无法重建的证据，例如历史区块中的预订时点槽位占用情况以及CLI未归档的默认设置，均以列表形式给出而非推断得出：附录Y说明了补充材料复现脚本一次离线运行的结果以及永久缺失的内容，并指向补充材料的完整清单，该清单以生成的溯源文件形式随附发布。

paragraphs.en: The testbed is synthetic: every person, appointment, claim, message and record in the office-v1 world is generated, and no human subjects, personal data or production systems are involved. The evaluated policies are commercial Claude models accessed through the vendor’s command-line interface (the Claude CLI) and, in Block CLM-BG, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview accessed through Google’s REST API, under their providers’ terms; the isolation described in § 6.7 exists to protect the evaluation, not to circumvent any provider control. The paper reports a non-replication of an earlier result of our own (Block A2); its account ships with the supplementary provenance file described in Appendix U , where the earlier evidence is retained rather than withdrawn.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试平台是合成的：office-v1 世界中的每一个人、预约、理赔申请、消息和记录均为生成内容，不涉及任何人类受试者、个人数据或生产系统。 被评估的策略是通过厂商命令行界面（Claude CLI）访问的商业 Claude 模型，以及在 Block CLM-BG 中通过 Google 的 REST API 访问的 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview，均遵循其提供商的条款；第 6.7 节所述的隔离措施旨在保护评估本身，而非规避任何提供商的控制。 本文报告了对我方早期结果（Block A2）的一次未复现；相关说明附带了附录 U 所述的补充溯源文件，其中保留了早期证据而非将其撤回。

paragraphs.en: We disclose LLM involvement against the categories ICLR asks about. Used: method implementation (Claude Code was used to author task modules, checkers and analysis code, all of which is covered by offline tests, certification and the independent scorer); research methodology (GPT-6 was consulted on the experimental design, the pre-registration addenda, the sizing of the blocks and the interpretation templates; every consult, answer and disposition is archived); evaluation infrastructure (GPT-6, through the Codex CLI, built the second sealed archive challenge of Section 9 , which no Claude agent read before its run; in a web chat, GPT-6 specified the cases and expected verdicts of the rule-only case-design challenge of Section 9 , and a second chat reviewed the fidelity of the authors’ implementation of each case; Appendix E ; a Gemini CLI agent ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview ) designed the cases and expected verdicts of the externally built challenge and wrote the generator that instantiated them, Appendix F ); writing (GPT-6 critiqued drafts of the abstract and of this manuscript; Claude Code drafted sections from the project’s own documents). LLMs as the object of study: the evaluated policies are LLM-based computer-use agents: Claude models and, in the claims block CLM-BG only, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview ); no GPT-6 model result is reported (Appendix M ). Not used: no measurement in this paper was produced by an LLM; every number is derived mechanically from archived artifacts by the claim ledger, and no experimental outcome was generated, altered or selected by an LLM. The research question, the decision of what to claim, and every acceptance of a result were the authors’. The authors take full responsibility for all content, including any error introduced this way.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照 ICLR 所询问的类别披露 LLM 的使用情况。 已使用：方法实现（使用 Claude Code 编写任务模块、检查器与分析代码，所有这些均由离线测试、认证和独立评分器覆盖）；研究方法（就实验设计、预注册补充材料、各区块的规模设定以及解释模板咨询了 GPT-6；每次咨询、回答与处理决定均有存档）；评估基础设施（GPT-6 通过 Codex CLI 构建了第 9 节的第二个密封存档挑战，在运行之前没有任何 Claude 智能体阅读过该挑战；在一次网页聊天中，GPT-6 为第 9 节仅规则案例设计挑战指定了案例与预期判定结果，另一次聊天则审查了作者对每个案例实现的一致性；附录 E；一个 Gemini CLI 智能体（ gemini-3.1-pro-preview ）设计了外部构建挑战的案例与预期判定结果，并编写了实例化这些案例的生成器，附录 F）；写作（GPT-6 对摘要与本文手稿的草稿提出了批评意见；Claude Code 依据项目自身的文档起草了部分章节）。 LLM 作为研究对象：被评估的策略是基于 LLM 的计算机使用智能体：Claude 模型，以及仅在主张区块 CLM-BG 中的 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview（ gemini-3.1-pro-preview ）；未报告任何 GPT-6 模型的结果（附录 M ）。 未使用：本文中的任何测量结果都不是由 LLM 产生的；每一个数字都由主张账本从存档的产物中以机械方式推导得出，没有任何实验结果是由 LLM 生成、修改或挑选的。 研究问题、决定主张什么内容，以及对每个结果的接受与否，均由作者决定。 作者对所有内容承担全部责任，包括由此方式引入的任何错误。

paragraphs.en: Every validity or analysis rule, where the pre-registration registers it (line of the frozen file), where the code implements it (file and line; the pre-image where the code later changed), the dated correction that followed, and which archived values that correction re-derived. The five current model-block logs hold 82 attempts and 78 counted rollouts, each attempt matched one to one to a run directory (82). Generated by audit/rule_reconciliation.py , whose independent re-derivations of the delivery checkpoints agree with the archived values on every row.

paragraphs.en: ADDENDUM 10 re-derived one Block B row; the classifier before it would have voided 25 model failures of the silent blocks, those of the re-exposure arm included (every arm without a notice, the sense of “silent-arm” in the rule matrix above). ADDENDUM 11 re-derived 5 Block A2 rows and changed 4 signatures; ADDENDUM 16’s delivery redefinition flipped 7 checkpoints and changed 4 signatures; neither changed a verdict. The implemented classifier tested success before delivery, so a success was never checked for validity; that later corrections left the verdicts unchanged shows what re-ordering changes on these archives, not that the success-first procedure was valid. The validity-first analysis covers 53 success rows: the 46 counted successes of the five current blocks and the 7 counted successes of the superseded Block A restart (ADDENDUM 3), which rule_reconciliation.py examines alongside them. Of these, 9 would have been voided under a validity-first order with some archived version of the delivery checkpoint: 8 current rows (A2 S-L2 s9; A2 S-L2 s11; A2 S-C s12; A2 S-C s13; A2 S-C s14; A2 S-C s15; BS FRX-ON-I s21; BS FRX-ON-I s22) and 1 of the superseded block.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 10 重新推导了 Block B 的一行；其之前的分类器本会作废 25 个静默块的模型失败，包括再暴露臂的失败（所有没有通知的臂，即上述规则矩阵中「静默臂」的含义）。 附录 11 重新推导了 5 行 Block A2 并更改了 4 个签名；附录 16 对交付的重新定义翻转了 7 个检查点并更改了 4 个签名；两者都没有改变裁决。 实现的分类器在交付之前测试成功，因此从未对成功进行有效性检查；后来的更正使裁决保持不变，这只说明重排序会在这些档案上改变什么，而不是证明成功优先的程序是有效的。 有效性优先的分析涵盖 53 个成功行：五个当前区块的 46 个计入成功，以及被取代的 Block A 重启（附录 3）的 7 个计入成功，rule_reconciliation.py 将其与前者一并检查。 其中，9 个在采用交付检查点的某个存档版本的有效性优先顺序下本会被作废：8 个当前行（A2 S-L2 s9；A2 S-L2 s11；A2 S-C s12；A2 S-C s13；A2 S-C s14；A2 S-C s15；BS FRX-ON-I s21；BS FRX-ON-I s22）以及被取代区块中的 1 个。

sents.en: The implemented classifier tested success before delivery, so a success was never checked for validity; that later corrections left the verdicts unchanged shows what re-ordering changes on these archives, not that the success-first procedure was valid.
sents.zh: 实现的分类器在交付之前测试成功，因此从未对成功进行有效性检查；后来的更正使裁决保持不变，这只说明重排序会在这些档案上改变什么，而不是证明成功优先的程序是有效的。

sents.en: The validity-first analysis covers 53 success rows: the 46 counted successes of the five current blocks and the 7 counted successes of the superseded Block A restart (ADDENDUM 3), which rule_reconciliation.py examines alongside them.

sents.en: Of these, 9 would have been voided under a validity-first order with some archived version of the delivery checkpoint: 8 current rows (A2 S-L2 s9; A2 S-L2 s11; A2 S-C s12; A2 S-C s13; A2 S-C s14; A2 S-C s15; BS FRX-ON-I s21; BS FRX-ON-I s22) and 1 of the superseded block.

paragraphs.en: A dated amendment can rebuild a block’s manifest mid-block (ADDENDA 11 and 12: 4 Block BS attempts, 1 counted, ran under the manifest it replaced), and a digest identifies an artifact without preserving it: that earlier manifest survives by digest only, and Block A2’s task module is absent from the working tree (where it survives: Appendix Y ). Sonnet’s review-information delivery rule: in each of its 3 stale FRX-ON-A failures the review information reached it as page text but it did not open the screenshot at that step—undelivered under the pre-registration, a rule never enforced and redefined after these outcomes—while in all 6 rescues it opened the screenshot. The rule as registered voids those rows and the successful FRX-ON-I controls (7 rows under its literal reading, re-derived independently), beyond the reserve; left unobserved, FRX-ON-A is 6/7 ( p = 0.0312 p=0.0312 ). Opus opened the screenshot at every review display step, so its result is the same under either rule. The reported 6/10, the narrower rule’s and the literal rule’s figures (Table 10 ) are different selected denominators; that they share a paired p p -value neither repairs the eligibility failure nor supplies the unobserved replacement outcomes. Behaviour after assignment. Opening the screenshot and reaching the review step are the agent’s own behaviour, not exogenous delivery events, so a rule that voids episodes on them can remove the very trajectories the review display is meant to affect; the literal rule voids 2 episodes that never reached the review step, while an action-cap termination elsewhere counts as a failure. Neither rule voids any Block B row.
paragraphs.zh: 一份标注日期的修订案可以在区块中途重建该区块的清单（附录 11 和 12：4 次 Block BS 尝试中，1 次被计入，是在其替换后的清单下运行的），而摘要可以在不保存工件的情况下标识该工件：那份较早的清单仅以摘要形式存留，且 Block A2 的任务模块不在工作树中（其存留位置：附录 Y）。 Sonnet 的评审信息送达规则：在其 3 次 FRX-ON-A 失效中的每一次里，评审信息都以页面文本的形式送达，但它没有在该步骤打开截图——按照预注册这属于未送达，而该规则从未被执行，并在这些结果出现之后被重新定义——而在全部 6 次救援中它都打开了截图。 按注册的规则会使这些行以及成功的 FRX-ON-I 对照（按其字面解读为 7 行，经独立重新推导）作废，超出预留范围；若不加观测，FRX-ON-A 为 6/7（p = 0.0312）。 Opus 在每个评审显示步骤都打开了截图，因此在任一规则下其结果都相同。 所报告的 6/10、较窄规则的数字与字面规则的数字（表 10）是不同的选择性分母；它们共享同一个配对 p 值，既不能修复资格判定失败，也无法提供未被观测到的替代结果。 分配之后的行为。 打开截图和到达评审步骤是智能体自身的行为，而非外生的送达事件，因此一条在其上使回合作废的规则可能会移除评审显示本欲影响的那些轨迹本身；字面规则使 2 个从未到达评审步骤的回合作废，而在别处发生的动作上限终止则计为一次失效。 两条规则均未使 Block B 的任何行作废。

paragraphs.en: Frame delivery is admitted per channel: a model that reads frames through a file-read tool must read the frame it was handed. As implemented, a successful read of a path the harness had not yet handed over voids the episode (before ADDENDUM 12, an errored read too); re-reading an earlier handed frame is admitted, a reading chosen after seeing archive data on which 14 counted Sonnet rows depend (Appendix C.1 ). For the other tool calls a model emits (Sonnet 5: 1591) the invoker archives only the name, so their containment rests on the account’s permissions; their availability was identical across paired arms (Section 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 帧交付按通道接纳：通过文件读取工具读取帧的模型必须读取交给它的那个帧。 按照实现，成功读取一个测试框架尚未交付的路径会使该回合作废（在 ADDENDUM 12 之前，出错的读取同样如此）；重新读取先前已交付的帧是被接纳的，这一读法是在看到档案数据之后做出的，有 14 行计入的 Sonnet 数据依赖于此（附录 C.1）。 对于模型发出的其他工具调用（Sonnet 5：1591 次），调用方只归档其名称，因此其包含性取决于该账户的权限；它们在成对的各实验组之间的可用性是完全相同的（第 11 节）。

paragraphs.en: 11 development mutations: 2 positive controls the checker must accept and 9 corruptions it must reject, all 11 expectations met with zero monitor errors.
paragraphs.zh: 11 个开发突变：2 个是检查器必须接受的正向对照，9 个是它必须拒绝的损坏样本，全部 11 项预期均满足，零监控错误。

paragraphs.en: 10 held-out cases with frozen expectations, sealed by sha256 ( d1ac0f83 , re-verified before the run), were run once, on 2026-09-23, after every model block, against the checker as it then stood; the digest of every checker file is archived with the run. The set was sealed against change but not hidden: the held-out file had been read before the run, and audit/mutation_battery.py , last modified before the run, carries a case-specific adjudication that labels one outcome below “ADJUDICATED TEST DEFECT”. The result is therefore not blind evidence, and that adjudication is not used: the battery’s own pass/fail is. 8 of 10 exact frozen expectations were met (Table 11 ). Of the 5 corruptions, 5 were instantiated and 5 of those rejected; of the 5 valid (invariant-preserving) cases, 4 were instantiated and 4 of those accepted, and 1 could not be instantiated. The 2 misses, as the run’s summary words them: (1) heldout_stale_location_via_history_actor : “the corruption (committed clinic rewritten to the superseded one, plus a plausible ‘relocate’ history row) WAS rejected: target_state_correct failed as expected. final_report_correct ALSO failed, because the agent’s report now disagrees with the rewritten record — correct checker behaviour that the frozen expectation omitted.” It is counted as a miss against the frozen expectation. (2) heldout_notice_file_rewritten_after_commit : “could NOT be instantiated: the mutation harness formats the orch payload with str.format and the JSON braces raise ‘ValueError: Invalid format specifier’ → \rightarrow MONITOR_ERROR, which the tri-state protocol counts as not passing. A harness (templating) defect, not a checker verdict. Not re-run: a repaired re-run would not be held-out evidence.” This is one fixed challenge of 10 cases on one family; it does not establish general verifier soundness. Of its two misses, one is additional correct checker behaviour and the other a mutation-harness failure, and neither makes the run blind evidence. The development mutations are selected examples, and the 11 defects we found (Appendix W ) give no denominator for defects missed on paths no scripted policy takes; no blind estimate of detection or false-rejection rates exists in this paper (the sealed challenge below counts misses on constructed cases).
paragraphs.zh: 共有 10 个冻结预期的留存（held-out）用例，以 sha256 封存（d1ac0f83，运行前重新验证），于 2026-09-23 在每个模型模块之后各运行一次，针对当时的检查器执行；每个检查器文件的摘要与该次运行一同存档。 该用例集是封存以防更改的，但并非隐藏：留存文件在运行前已被读取，且 audit/mutation_battery.py（最后修改于运行之前）包含一条针对特定用例的裁定，将下文一个结果标注为「ADJUDICATED TEST DEFECT」（已裁定的测试缺陷）。 因此，该结果并非盲测证据，且该裁定并未被使用：使用的是测试集自身的通过/失败判定。10 个精确的冻结预期中有 8 个得到满足（表 11）。 在 5 个损坏用例中，5 个被实例化，且其中 5 个被拒绝；在 5 个有效（保持不变式）的用例中，4 个被实例化，且其中 4 个被接受，另有 1 个无法被实例化。 这 2 个未达项，按该次运行摘要的措辞为：(1) heldout_stale_location_via_history_actor：「该损坏（已提交的诊所被改写为已被取代的诊所，外加一条看似合理的『搬迁』历史记录行）确实被拒绝了：target_state_correct 如预期般失败。final_report_correct 也失败了，因为智能体的报告与改写后的记录不一致——这是正确的检查器行为，只是冻结预期未将其涵盖。」该结果被计为针对冻结预期的未达项。 (2) heldout_notice_file_rewritten_after_commit：「无法被实例化：变异测试框架使用 str.format 格式化 orch 负载，而 JSON 花括号会引发『ValueError: Invalid format specifier』→ \rightarrow MONITOR_ERROR，三态协议将其计为未通过。 这是测试框架（模板化）的缺陷，而非检查器的判定。 未重新运行：修复后的重新运行将不构成留存证据。」这是针对单一族群的 10 个用例的一次固定挑战，它并不能证明验证器的普遍可靠性。 在其两个未达项中，一个是额外的正确检查器行为，另一个是变异测试框架的故障，二者都不使该次运行成为盲测证据。 开发阶段的变异是精选的示例，我们发现的 11 个缺陷（附录 W）无法为未被脚本化策略经过的路径上漏掉的缺陷提供分母；本文不存在对检测率或误拒率的盲测估计（下文的封存挑战统计的是构造用例上的未达项）。

paragraphs.en: A second, sealed archive challenge built by a different model met 24 of 28 frozen expectations on its first and only run (14 of 18 instantiated corruptions rejected; 10 of 10 valid cases accepted); its 4 misses are listed in Appendix C as its comparison output words them. These are the registered pipeline’s numbers, the outcome scorer’s and the validity re-derivation’s jointly (a case is met only if both meet it); by tool, the outcome scorer met 28, the validity re-derivation 24 and the evaluator’s archive replay 10 of the 28 (Table 13 ), and the misses are reported, not repaired. Built by a different model (GPT-6, through the Codex CLI) from real Block A2, B and BS episodes, with its expectations written per tool before its harness: 28 cases, 10 valid controls and 18 corruptions, one per defect class. It is unseen only by the Claude agents that wrote and ran the pipeline, not by its builder: our brief named the defect classes, and the builder could read the whole repository (the code under test, the protocol and the paper), so its cases are white-box to it. Its seal record ( b9f9000f0393 ) and the 7 file digests it holds are those ADDENDUM 19 §7 froze before any Claude agent read the challenge (§7 discloses that a Claude agent’s repository-wide search printed lines of its comparison and expectation-writing scripts, never its expectations); the build re-verifies them, and every one of the 337 outputs against the hash list written at the run before anyone read them ( 9d0c898bc8bb ). This is its first and only run, and its first output is the result: no case-specific patch was made (the 7 tool source files its run manifest pins are byte-identical now, so no patch followed), no expectation was edited, and the misses are reported, not repaired. Three tools ran on every case, and no invocation ended in a tool error or was skipped. The sealed sentence at the head of this paragraph gives the registered pipeline’s numbers, the outcome scorer’s and the validity re-derivation’s jointly; Section 9 reports each layer, and Table 13 gives each tool per case class.
paragraphs.zh: 由另一个模型构建的第二个密封存档挑战，在其首次也是唯一一次运行中满足了28项冻结预期中的24项（18个实例化破坏中有14个被拒绝；10个有效案例全部接受）；其4处未达标按其比较输出的措辞列于附录C。 这些是已注册流水线、结果评分器与有效性重新推导三者联合的数字（只有两者都满足该案例才算满足）；按工具计，结果评分器满足28项，有效性重新推导满足24项，而评估器的存档重放在28项中满足10项（表13），且未达标之处只报告，不修复。 该挑战由另一个模型（GPT-6，通过 Codex CLI）基于真实的 Block A2、B 和 BS 片段构建，其预期在测试框架之前逐工具编写：共28个案例，包括10个有效对照和18个破坏，每个缺陷类别一个。 它只对编写并运行流水线的 Claude 智能体是不可见的，对其构建者并非如此：我们的任务说明指定了缺陷类别，且构建者可以阅读整个仓库（被测代码、协议和论文），因此这些案例对其而言是白盒的。 其密封记录（ b9f9000f0393 ）及其所含的7个文件摘要，正是 ADDENDUM 19 §7 在任何 Claude 智能体读取该挑战之前冻结的内容（§7 披露，某 Claude 智能体的全仓库搜索打印出了其比较脚本和预期编写脚本的若干行，但从未打印其预期）；构建过程会重新验证它们，以及337个输出中的每一个，对照的是在任何人读取之前于该次运行时写入的哈希清单（ 9d0c898bc8bb ）。 这是它的首次也是唯一一次运行，其首个输出即结果：没有进行任何针对具体案例的修补（其运行清单锁定的7个工具源文件现在仍逐字节相同，因此事后没有任何修补），没有编辑任何预期，未达标之处只报告，不修复。 每个案例都运行了三个工具，没有任何一次调用以工具错误告终或被跳过。 本段开头的密封句子给出的是已注册流水线、结果评分器与有效性重新推导三者联合的数字；第9节逐层报告，表13则给出每个工具在各案例类别上的结果。

paragraphs.en: The 4 misses, as its comparison output words them: (1) C01_success_without_delivery (success-before-validity: notice), the validity re-derivation: “validity: valid (expected observation_not_delivered)”; (2) C02_panel_without_delivery (missing intervention panel delivery), the validity re-derivation: “validity: valid (expected observation_not_delivered)”; (3) C08_commit_before_change (commit before change), the validity re-derivation: “validity: valid (expected invalid_intervention); registered_validity: valid (expected invalid_intervention)”; (4) C15_truncated_trajectory (truncated trajectory), the validity re-derivation: “registered_validity: valid (expected delivery_ambiguous/verifier_failure/infra_failure)”. Under the rules as implemented the validity re-derivation missed three (C01, C02, C08), under the rules as registered two (C08, C15); one (C08) under both. The evaluator’s archived verdict path met 10 of its frozen expectations and missed 18 (it met 10 of the 10 valid controls and 0 of the 18 corruptions); these misses stand as failed expectations. The challenge bounds defect detection on one family; it does not establish universal correctness, and it selects no cell and gates no block.

Membership was established by joining each search-log row’s path to its run directory, one to one; the scorer’s own search-log attribution could not attach 18 counted rows (its spec omits the A2S and BF logs, and a retried cell matches two rows). Table 17 gives, per block and invariant, resolved-and-agreeing / contradiction / unresolved. No counted episode has an invariant contradiction (0). Target-state correctness (I1) is unresolved on 46 of the 78 counted episodes, every one on the slot term: the instruction allows the nearest later available slot, and deciding nearest needs the full set of valid slots at booking time, which no trajectory archives (0 of 82). Because I1 is a conjunction, it can resolve only when another of its terms fails: the 46 unresolved episodes are exactly the counted successes, and the 32 counted episodes with all five invariants resolved and agreeing are all failures, so the scorer confirms no success in full. The term that carries the phenomenon, whether the booked clinic is the post-change clinic, is resolved on all 73 counted episodes that booked a row: correct on the 46 successes and wrong on 27 failures (5 booked no single row). Every other episode leaves the dense reward unresolved as well. Re-scored with the current scorer, the 76 certification episodes leave I1 unresolved on 41 and I3 on 15; the audit of them cited in Section 6.4 , run before the nearest-slot rule was added, left I1 unresolved on 0. That audit records the scorer by path only, so a present-day re-run establishes current reproducibility, not the digest that produced it.

paragraphs.en: REPAIR_r20/slot_evidence.py tries, for all 82 attempts and from same-episode evidence (the page text of each step, the access log, the event log; the attempt list, the parsed requirement, the pre-episode appointment set and the committed row are read from the r19 audit’s output; no scorer, spec or evaluator import), to reconstruct two of the three sets the nearest-slot term needs: the slots the wizard offered and the slots already taken on the date (the third, the patient’s calendar conflicts, it does not attempt). It treats a slot as taken if any appointment on that date carries it, at any clinic, which is how the wizard’s own text scopes it and which can only over-approximate occupancy. The result is negative: the evidence is complete on 0 of 82 attempts, so the slot term resolves on 0 of the 46 counted successes, and on none does it contradict the evaluator. The cause is structural. The portal’s appointment list shows no date or slot column, so occupancy can be read only from each existing appointment’s own page, and 78 attempts open only one of the portal’s 4 existing appointments (the distractor the instruction names), which is not always on the requested date; and every one of the 73 committing attempts submits its slot choice (the wizard’s POST /new/1 ) between its last occupancy read and the commit, so under the script’s rule that no write of any kind may intervene, even the 1 attempt that opened all 4 is incomplete. Table 15 gives the cross-tabulation by outcome: every counted failure is verified on all five invariants and no counted success is; for every success, Opus’s 10 rescues included, what is verified is the clinic. Closing the gap needs the world to archive the date’s appointment rows at the two points the harness already snapshots, which requires new rollouts; no archived episode can be repaired.

paragraphs.en: The strict rule above voids occupancy evidence if any write falls between the last occupancy read and the commit. A second rule, chosen after seeing the archive like the first, accepts it when the appointment table’s harness-recorded rows_fingerprint is unchanged from that read to the step before the commit. Under it 1 counted success has complete occupancy evidence (A2, S-L2, seed 15, attempt 1: last occupancy read at step 26, commit at step 36, with 2 wizard writes between that leave the fingerprint unchanged), and in 1 the committed slot is the nearest available one the evidence supports. The conservative reconstruction verifies no historical success in full. A post-hoc fingerprint-based reconstruction supports the selected slot in one A2 success under additional assumptions; it does not independently establish every component of the full endpoint: the fingerprint covers identifier, appointment number, slot time and status but not the date or the clinic, it is a harness record rather than an independent one, and neither rule reconstructs the patient’s calendar conflicts, which the evaluator’s standard also requires.
paragraphs.zh: 若有任何写入发生在最后一次占用读取与提交之间，上述严格规则将使占用证据失效。 第二条规则与第一条一样，是在查看存档后选定的：当预约表中由测试框架记录的 rows_fingerprint 从该次读取到提交前一步保持不变时，接受该证据。 在该规则下，1 次计为成功的运行具有完整的占用证据（A2、S-L2、种子 15、尝试 1：最后一次占用读取在第 26 步，提交在第 36 步，其间有 2 次向导写入但指纹保持不变），并且在 1 中，所提交的时段是该证据所能支持的最近可用时段。 保守重建无法完整验证任何历史成功。 一种基于指纹的事后重建在附加假设下支持一次 A2 成功中所选的时段；它并不能独立确立完整端点的每一个组成部分：该指纹涵盖标识符、预约编号、时段时间和状态，但不涵盖日期或诊所；它是测试框架的记录而非独立记录；并且两条规则都无法重建患者的日历冲突，而评估者的标准同样要求这一点。

sents.zh: 一种基于指纹的事后重建在附加假设下支持一次 A2 成功中所选的时段；它并不能独立确立完整端点的每一个组成部分：该指纹涵盖标识符、预约编号、时段时间和状态，但不涵盖日期或诊所；它是测试框架的记录而非独立记录；并且两条规则都无法重建患者的日历冲突，而评估者的标准同样要求这一点。

paragraphs.en: REPAIR_r20/validity_independent.py re-derives every attempt’s validity verdict from raw records (access log, event log, the harness’s per-step records), with code written from the pre-registration and addenda text, standard library only; no evaluator code, checkpoint or archived classification is an input. Under the rules as implemented it agrees with the archive on 82 of 82 attempts (0 disagreements): the 4 uncounted attempts are re-derived as harness errors, and on all 78 counted rows each validity sub-fact holds (the change fired once, on the request the rule predicts, from the agent’s own client, after the sessions page was served; the state change is present; notice and review-information flags match the level; on announced arms the notice was delivered and dismissed), while a rough outcome test matches the archived success or failure on 78. Under the rules as registered it counts 71, not 78: the 7 differences are all Block BS rows voided by ADDENDUM 5’s review-screenshot rule (FRX-ON-A s22 (model failure); FRX-ON-A s23 (budget limited); FRX-ON-A s27 (model failure); FRX-ON-A s28 (model failure); FRX-ON-I s20 (budget limited); FRX-ON-I s21 (success); FRX-ON-I s22 (success))—5 saw the review information as text only (3 failures, 2 successful controls) and 2 never reached the review step; the narrower reading that voids only a rendered, undelivered review display voids 5. If only the first notice step’s screenshot counts, Block A2’s S-C s12 and S-C s15 (both successes) would also be void. It is independent of the evaluator’s code, not of its records: it trusts the portal’s logs and the harness’s per-step records, and it logs 14 readings of the rule text, 2 of them fixed after looking at archive data (that re-reading an earlier frame is not a read violation, without which 14 more Sonnet rows would be void, 11 of Block BS and 3 of Block A2S, the rule Appendix B states as implemented; and that any notice step counts). The agreement is therefore with the rules as implemented under this reconstructed interpretation, not with a fully prespecified adjudication, and neither post-hoc reading is yet part of a frozen registration for the prospective blocks (ADDENDA 18 and 19 and the claims pre-registration are frozen (each file verifies against its sha256 record) and the interpretation templates are sealed).
paragraphs.zh: REPAIR_r20/validity_independent.py 根据原始记录（访问日志、事件日志、测试框架的逐步记录）重新推导每次尝试的有效性判定，代码完全依据预注册及附录文本编写，仅使用标准库；不将任何评估器代码、检查点或归档分类作为输入。 按照实际实现的规则，它与归档在 82 次尝试中的 82 次上一致（0 处分歧）：4 次未计入的尝试被重新推导为测试框架错误，并且在全部 78 行计入的行上，每项有效性子事实均成立（变更触发了一次，且发生在规则所预测的请求上、来自智能体自身的客户端、在会话页面被提供之后；状态变更确实存在；通知与审查信息标志与级别相符；在预先声明的分支上，通知已被送达并被关闭），同时一项粗略的结果检验在 78 次上与归档的成功或失败相匹配。 按照注册的规则，它计数为 71 而非 78：这 7 处差异全部是因 ADDENDUM 5 的审查截图规则而作废的 Block BS 行（FRX-ON-A s22（模型失败）；FRX-ON-A s23（预算受限）；FRX-ON-A s27（模型失败）；FRX-ON-A s28（模型失败）；FRX-ON-I s20（预算受限）；FRX-ON-I s21（成功）；FRX-ON-I s22（成功））——其中 5 次仅以文本形式看到了审查信息（3 次失败，2 次成功的对照），2 次从未到达审查步骤；将仅作废已渲染但未送达的审查显示这一较窄解读会作废 5 次。 如果只将第一个通知步骤的截图计入，那么 Block A2 的 S-C s12 和 S-C s15（均为成功）也将被作废。 它独立于评估器的代码，但不独立于其记录：它信任门户的日志和测试框架的逐步记录，并且它记录了 14 次对规则文本的解读，其中 2 次是在查看归档数据后修正的（即重新查看先前的帧不构成读取违规——若非如此，将另有 14 行 Sonnet 行被作废，其中 Block BS 11 行、Block A2S 3 行，这是附录 B 所陈述的实现规则；以及任何通知步骤均计入）。 因此，这种一致性是针对在此重构解释下所实现规则的，而非针对完全预先指定的裁定，且这两种事后解读均尚未成为前瞻性区块的冻结注册的一部分（ADDENDA 18 和 19 及主张预注册均已冻结（每个文件均通过其 sha256 记录进行校验），且解释模板均已密封）。

The file is written as a block runs (per block in this build: BC re-derived, BCS re-derived, BGC not re-derived , CLM-B re-derived, CLM-BS re-derived), but the paper claims an independent validity re-derivation for a prospective block only once the block has completed and its file exists; in this build that re-derivation is complete for BC, CLM-B and CLM-BS.

sents.zh: 该文件在区块运行期间写入（本次构建中各区块的情况：BC 已重新推导，BCS 已重新推导，BGC 未重新推导，CLM-B 已重新推导，CLM-BS 已重新推导），但论文声称，只有当某前瞻性区块已完成且其文件存在时，才对该区块进行独立的有效性重新推导；在本次构建中，BC、CLM-B 和 CLM-BS 的重新推导已完成。

paragraphs.en: This is not the sealed challenge and does not re-label it : that challenge’s result (its two registered tools, the independent scorer and the validity re-derivation, both met the frozen expectations on 24 of 28 cases, Table 13 ) stands as recorded. After it, and in answer to reviewers, the authors of the claims pipeline built a second check on the claims path; they also wrote its cases, its expected verdicts and its baseline, having read the pipeline’s code, so it is neither blind nor independent. Cases. 29 cases (10 valid controls, 19 corruptions), each a copy of a real counted archive of Block CLM-B or CLM-BS (six source archives, left unchanged); a mutation edits every copy of a fact together and recomputes every recorded digest, so a tool must catch a case from its content, not from a broken hash. Seal and run. The expected verdicts were written from the claims pre-registration and sealed ( EXPECTED.json 1450457f8225, with the case listing, the case index, the baseline source and the builder) at 2026-09-24 09:13Z, before any tool ran on any case; the one run, at 2026-09-24 09:14Z, used no model and no world, the tool files did not change during it, and every claims tool ran at the digest the claims release manifests pin. Each case was first re-scored the way the harness archives an episode (the frozen task module’s own hooks), then given to the claims validity re-derivation (C8), the independent scorer, the evaluator with the classifier, and the baseline; the pipeline is the classifier followed by the registered void gate (a gating scorer finding, an unresolved invariant, a scorer–evaluator disagreement or a C8 verdict other than valid voids the block). Baseline. A 108-line, standard-library script that rebuilds the verdict from the raw world snapshots, the access log and the page texts by asking whether the policy row changed once, after the old value was served in the same session and inside the agent’s own request; whether exactly one approval committed after the change; and whether the approved amount is the minimum of the eligible amount and the limit at commit. It does not assess the collateral-change (I3) or report (I4) terms, delivery, or archive completeness.
paragraphs.zh: 这并非被密封的挑战，也不会对其重新标注：该挑战的结果（其登记的两件工具、独立评分器与有效性重推导，在 28 个用例中的 24 个上均满足了冻结的预期，见表 13）按原样保留记录。 在此之后，作为对审稿人的回应，claims 流水线的作者在 claims 路径上构建了第二项检查；他们还编写了其用例、预期判定与基线，并且他们阅读过该流水线的代码，因此该检查既非盲测也非独立。 用例。29 个用例（10 个有效对照，19 个破坏性变体），每个用例都是 Block CLM-B 或 CLM-BS 的一个真实已计数档案的副本（六个源档案，保持不变）；一次变异会同时编辑某事实的所有副本并重新计算所有已记录的摘要，因此工具必须依据内容而非失效的哈希来识别用例。密封并运行。 预期判定依据 claims 预注册编写并密封（EXPECTED.json 1450457f8225，连同用例清单、用例索引、基线来源与构建者），时间为 2026-09-24 09:13Z，先于任何工具在任何用例上运行；唯一的一次运行在 2026-09-24 09:14Z 进行，未使用任何模型与任何世界，工具文件在运行期间未发生改变，并且每个 claims 工具都运行在 claims 发布清单所固定的摘要上。 每个用例首先按测试框架归档一次 episode 的方式重新评分（即冻结任务模块自带的钩子），然后交给 claims 有效性重推导（C8）、独立评分器、带分类器的评估器以及基线；该流水线为分类器后接已登记的作废门控（发现门控评分器异常、存在未解决的不变量、评分器与评估器不一致、或 C8 判定非 valid，均会使该区块作废）。基线。 一个 108 行、仅用标准库的脚本，它通过询问以下问题，从原始世界快照、访问日志与页面文本重建判定：策略行是否在旧值于同一会话内、且在智能体自身请求之内被提供后恰好变更一次；变更之后是否恰好提交了一个批准；以及被批准的金额是否等于提交时可用金额与限额两者中的较小值。 它不评估附带变更（I3）或报告（I4）条款、交付或档案完整性。

paragraphs.en: No tool rejected a control (C8, scorer, evaluator/classifier, baseline, pipeline: 10, 10, 10, 10, 10 of 10). Of the 19 corruptions, the pipeline kept 16 from a clean score (1 with the wrong class) and missed 3; the baseline kept 6, missed 11 and left 2 outside its scope. Incremental coverage. Stopped by the pipeline only (11): C02 , C02b , C04 , C05 , C06 , C07 , C08a , C08b , C10 , C11 , C16 ; by the baseline only (1): C09a ; by both (5): C03 , C09b , C12 , C17 , C18 ; by neither (2): C15 , C17p . The baseline therefore does not catch everything the pipeline catches: it never reads prompts or review panels (the delivery cases), orders events by timestamp rather than by the world’s own history, attributes the change to the nearest agent request, does not read the event log, and does not assess I3 or I4. The one case only it caught is a duplicate commit that the claims I2 term, which requires at least one committing request, accepts.

paragraphs.en: Every miss, with its mechanism. C15 (truncated trajectory): all five counted it as a correct success. The step list was cut after the change and before any approval step, leaving the report, the logs and the harness’s state archive intact; every completeness check (the manifest’s artifact check, the scorer’s evidence check, C8’s loader) looks only at the steps that are listed, and none checks that every archived state snapshot and the final step appear in the list; in the sealed challenge the historical validity re-derivation also missed its truncated-trajectory case. C17p (stale pages): all five counted it. Every policy-record page served after the change still showed the starting limit although the database row changed; the validity term that checks served pages looks only at steps up to the change, and the certifier predicate that would catch it runs only during certification, not in the classifier (the clinic blocks’ re-derivation has the equivalent check). C09a (two committing requests against one approval event): the scorer, the evaluator/classifier and the pipeline scored I2 as passed, because the claims I2 term requires at least one committing request, not exactly one; the baseline, which requires exactly one, caught it. That I2 must fail here is our normative reading, since the pre-registration phrases I2 in terms of approval events. C09b (two approvals in the world): C8, the scorer, the evaluator/classifier and the pipeline rejected it as an invalid intervention, which would replace the episode instead of counting it as an I2 failure: the before-commit term binds a single approval and is undefined for two in all three implementations, so they agree and the block’s void gate would not flag it; only the baseline gave the sealed class. Approval is terminal in the task, so a real double approval would need a portal fault. C8 also counted the three panel and delivery corruptions ( C02 , C02b , C07 ), which its declared scope, intervention validity only, does not cover; the classifier and the scorer reject all three.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次漏判，及其机制。 C15（被截断的轨迹）：五人都判定其为正确的成功。 步骤列表在变更之后、任何审批步骤之前被截断，而报告、日志与测试工具（harness）的状态存档保持完整；每一项完整性检查（清单的产物检查、评分器的证据检查、C8 的加载器）都只查看列出的步骤，且没有任何检查验证每个已存档的状态快照与最终步骤都出现在列表中；在密封挑战中，历史有效性重推导也遗漏了其被截断轨迹的情形。 C17p（过期页面）：五人全都计入。 变更之后提供的每一份政策记录页面仍然显示起始限额，尽管数据库中的行已经改变；校验所服务页面有效性的项只查看变更之前的步骤，而能够发现该问题的认证谓词只在认证阶段运行，不在分类器中运行（诊所模块的重推导具有等价的检查）。 C09a（两个提交请求对应一个审批事件）：评分器、评估器/分类器和流水线都判定 I2 通过，因为 I2 项只要求至少一个提交请求，而非恰好一个；基线（要求恰好一个）发现了该问题。 I2 在此处必须失败是我们的规范性解读，因为预注册文件是以审批事件来表述 I2 的。 C09b（世界中有两个审批）：C8、评分器、评估器/分类器和流水线将其判为无效干预而拒绝，这会替换整个回合而不是将其计为 I2 失败：提交前的项只绑定单个审批，在三种实现中对于两个审批的情形均未定义，因此它们一致，且该模块的作废门（void gate）不会对其标记；只有基线给出了密封类别。 审批在该任务中是终态的，因此真正的双重审批需要门户故障。 C8 还计入了三个面板与交付损坏（C02、C02b、C07），而其声明的范围仅限干预有效性，并不涵盖这些；分类器和评分器都拒绝了这三项。

paragraphs.en: Trust boundary. On the archive as stored, with the archived evaluator verdict not recomputed, the classifier alone counts 16 of the 19 corruptions: it rejects only the three its own archive checks see ( C02 , C02b , C07 ), because its validity row reads the archived verdict. For such an archive the backstop is the scorer’s and C8’s recomputation through the block’s void gate, which voids the whole block rather than replacing the attempt; this is inferred from their recomputed verdicts in this run, not run separately on the stored copies.

paragraphs.en: After the sealed challenge and the check above, we asked what the protocol adds over a fair simple checker on identical evidence and scored properties. For clinic we wrote clinic_baseline.py (143 lines, standard library), the counterpart of the claims baseline: it asks whether the session row changed exactly once, after its old location was served in the same login session and inside the agent’s own recorded request, and whether any served page contradicts the change (on L0, whether nothing changed); whether exactly one commit and one patient row followed the change; whether the booked clinic equals the session’s location at the commit (the nearest-slot term is not archived, so it reports fail or unresolved, never pass); and whether the report matches the committed record. It does not check delivery, the arm served, collateral rows, the confirm state or archive completeness. It was developed only on 92 clinic-family run archives that are not sources of any challenge case, sealed (with the table’s decision definitions) at 2026-09-24 10:00Z, and run once on the challenge’s cases at 10:01Z; nothing was tuned afterwards. Before writing it, its author had read the challenge’s expected verdicts, the sealed tools’ recorded outputs and the unmodified control archives, but not the mutation code. Disclosure: 16 of the 92 development archives were Block BC archives written while that block was running; the development check compared the baseline only with their archived evaluator scores, no number from them appears in this paper, and BC’s reading is selected mechanically by its frozen rule. The sealed challenge’s joint figure, 14 of 18 corruptions, is the set both validity readings reject; the protocol rows of Table 7 take one reading at a time. The claims baseline’s in-scope misses reflect implementation choices a careful checker need not make (nearest-request attribution, timestamp ordering, no event log, counting history rows rather than change requests); the clinic baseline, which reads more raw sources, matched the protocol within its scope. The added value this shows is breadth of checked properties and, on claims, a more robust causal chain than one simple checker; it does not show that a simple checker cannot match the causal chain.
paragraphs.zh: 在密封挑战和上述核查之后，我们追问：在相同证据与评分属性上，该协议相比一个公平的简单检查器增加了什么，并据此打分。 对于 clinic，我们编写了 clinic_baseline.py（143 行，仅用标准库），即 claims 基线的对应物：它询问会话行是否恰好变更一次，且该变更发生在同一登录会话中旧位置已被服务之后、并处于智能体自身记录的请求之内；是否有任何已服务的页面与该变更矛盾（在 L0 上，即是否什么都没有变更）；变更之后是否恰好有一次提交和一行患者记录；提交时被预约的诊所是否等于该会话的位置（最近时段这一项未存档，因此只会报告 fail 或 unresolved，绝不会 pass）；以及报告是否与已提交的记录相符。 它不检查投递情况、所服务的分支、附带行、确认状态或归档完整性。 它仅在 92 个 clinic 家族的运行归档上开发，这些归档不是任何挑战案例的来源，于 2026-09-24 10:00Z 依据表中的判定定义被密封，并于 10:01Z 在挑战案例上运行一次；此后未做任何调整。 在编写它之前，其作者已阅读过挑战的预期判定、被密封工具的记录输出以及未修改的对照归档，但没有阅读过变异代码。 披露：92 个开发归档中有 16 个是在 Block BC 运行期间写下的 BC 归档；该开发检查仅将基线与其归档的评估器分数进行比较，这些归档中的任何数字都没有出现在本文中，且 BC 的解读是由其冻结规则机械选出的。 密封挑战的联合数字——18 个损坏中的 14 个——是两种有效性解读都拒绝的集合；表 7 中的协议行每次只采用其中一种解读。 claims 基线在范围内的遗漏反映的是一个仔细的检查器不必做出的实现选择（最近请求归属、时间戳排序、没有事件日志、以历史行而非变更请求来计数）；而读取了更多原始来源的 clinic 基线，在其范围内与协议相匹配。 这所展示的附加价值在于被检查属性的广度，以及在 claims 上比单个简单检查器更稳健的因果链；它并未表明简单检查器无法匹配该因果链。

paragraphs.en: After the per-episode reconstruction of Appendix J had run on the counted archives, we built 24 further cases (9 valid controls, 15 corruptions: new variants of truncation, stale post-change pages, duplicate commits, review display delivery and commit ordering) from 24 counted claims archives, none a base of Table 18 , wrote their expected verdicts from the raw start and end state, and sealed the cases, the expectations, the builder, runner and comparer and both new tools at 10:03:30Z on the same day, before any tool ran on any case (a crash check of the repaired checker on an r28 control case preceded the seal). One run at 10:03:34Z used the frozen claims tools as in Table 18 , the r28 baseline unchanged, the repaired checker and the reconstruction’s verdict. The frozen pipeline again missed truncation, stale pages and access-log duplicate commits and gave the duplicate approval the wrong class; it is not modified for the counted blocks. The repaired checker, which like the baseline orders events by timestamp and reads no prompts or event log, missed the delivery and ordering corruptions the pipeline catches. The reconstruction contains both kinds of check and missed 0 corruptions with 0 false rejections; that shows it implements the checks it names, not an unbiased coverage estimate, and because it reads the same archives as the pipeline, a fault that falsified every copy of the raw record consistently would pass both. In summary (moved from the main text), on these 24 post-hoc, author-built fresh cases with expectations sealed before their single run, the reconstruction missed none of 15 corruptions, the frozen pipeline 7 (truncation, stale pages, access-log duplicate commits) and the repaired raw-log checker 6 (panel delivery, commit ordering). “Fresh” means unused archive bases, not independent or blind evidence: the cases were built by the authors after the fault classes were known.
paragraphs.zh: 在按回合进行的附录 J 重构已在计数的存档上运行之后，我们从 24 个计数的声明存档中另外构建了 24 个案例（9 个有效对照、15 个损坏：截断、变更后过期页面、重复提交、评审展示投递和提交排序的新变体），其中没有一个是表 18 的基础案例，我们从原始开始与结束状态写出其预期判定，并在同一天 10:03:30Z、在任何工具运行于任何案例之前（在封存之前已对修复后的检查器在 r28 对照案例上做了一次崩溃检查），封存了这些案例、预期结果、构建器、运行器与比较器以及两个新工具。 10:03:34Z 的一次运行像表 18 那样使用了冻结的声明工具，r28 基线保持不变，另外还使用了修复后的检查器与重构的判定。 冻结的流水线再次漏掉了截断、过期页面和访问日志中的重复提交，并给重复审批赋予了错误的类别；对于计数的区块，它未被修改。 修复后的检查器与基线一样按时间戳对事件排序且不读取提示词或事件日志，它漏掉了流水线能捕获的投递与排序类损坏。 重构包含两类检查，漏掉 0 个损坏且无误拒；这表明它实现了它所命名的那些检查，而不是一个无偏的覆盖率估计，并且由于它读取的存档与流水线相同，一个能一致地篡改原始记录每一份副本的故障会同时通过两者。 概括而言（从正文移来），在这 24 个事后由作者构建、预期在其唯一一次运行之前就已封存的新案例上，重构漏掉了 15 个损坏中的 0 个，冻结流水线漏掉 7 个（截断、过期页面、访问日志重复提交），修复后的原始日志检查器漏掉 6 个（面板投递、提交排序）。“新”指的是未使用过的存档基础，而非独立或盲测的证据：这些案例是在故障类别已知之后由作者构建的。

sents.zh: 重构包含两类检查，漏掉 0 个损坏且无误拒；这表明它实现了它所命名的那些检查，而不是一个无偏的覆盖率估计，并且由于它读取的存档与流水线相同，一个能一致地篡改原始记录每一份副本的故障会同时通过两者。

sents.en: In summary (moved from the main text), on these 24 post-hoc, author-built fresh cases with expectations sealed before their single run, the reconstruction missed none of 15 corruptions, the frozen pipeline 7 (truncation, stale pages, access-log duplicate commits) and the repaired raw-log checker 6 (panel delivery, commit ordering). “Fresh” means unused archive bases, not independent or blind evidence: the cases were built by the authors after the fault classes were known.
sents.zh: 概括而言（从正文移来），在这 24 个事后由作者构建、预期在其唯一一次运行之前就已封存的新案例上，重构漏掉了 15 个损坏中的 0 个，冻结流水线漏掉 7 个（截断、过期页面、访问日志重复提交），修复后的原始日志检查器漏掉 6 个（面板投递、提交排序）。“新”指的是未使用过的存档基础，而非独立或盲测的证据：这些案例是在故障类别已知之后由作者构建的。

paragraphs.en: This is neither the sealed challenge (Table 13 ) nor the post-hoc author-built checks of Appendix D , and it changes neither result. Design. GPT-6 (ChatGPT, a new temporary chat with memory off) received a brief of verbatim excerpts of the registered rules (the claims pre-registration and the clinic addenda that govern Block BC) and an archive schema (file list, what each log records, one type skeleton per file); the brief held no code, no paper text, no earlier case, class or finding, and no model outcome, and three redactions removed a historical defect label, a defect narrative and changelog identifiers. It returned 56 case specifications (28 per workflow: 20 corruptions and 8 controls each), each with its expected verdict, its rule basis and any accepted alternative; they were parsed without edits, and GPT-6 marked 1 as ambiguous. Implementation and seal. The base-selection, exclusion and scoring rules were committed by digest at 2026-09-24 18:44Z, before any answer text had been retrieved (the retrieval log records none until 2026-09-24 18:51Z). The authors then implemented each specification by literal application of its named edits (a specification that could not be applied as written was to be excluded, not reinterpreted) on a copy of a counted prospective archive (claims: Blocks CLM-B and CLM-BS; clinic: Block BC), editing every copy of a fact and recomputing recorded digests. The answer, specifications, cases, expectations and all implementation, run and comparison code were sealed at 2026-09-24 19:00Z; no tool under test had run on any case before then, so no case could be altered to make a tool fail. A second GPT-6 temporary chat—a model, not a human adjudicator—compared every implementation with its specification and judged 36 of the 38 implemented ones faithful; cases it did not confirm were excluded under the frozen admission rule, and the fidelity claim remains the authors’; its decision was recorded at 2026-09-24 19:08Z. The authors checked every admitted expectation against the rule text and disputed none; expectations are copied verbatim and none was edited, and under the frozen rules a dispute would have been reported beside the case without changing any score. The run began at 2026-09-24 19:08Z, used no model and no world, and the tool and case files did not change during it. Exclusions (pre-declared rules).

paragraphs.en: Of the specifications, 18 had no base archive meeting their stated requirement: 17 clinic ones (13 need a successful OFF-A episode, and Block BC has none) and 1 claims one; the brief, being blind, did not say which outcomes each level contains, and the fidelity reviewer judged 2 (LC14, LC15) unfaithful; none of these ran. Admitted: 27 claims cases (20 corruptions, 16 of them expected uncounted, and 7 controls) and 9 clinic cases (6 corruptions, all expected uncounted, and 3 controls). Tools. claims : combined pipeline (classifier, void gate), evaluator with classifier, claims validity re-derivation (C8), independent scorer, simple raw-log baseline (r28), repaired raw-log checker (r29); clinic : combined pipeline (driver row, void gate), evaluator with classifier (refresh), BC validity re-derivation, independent scorer, simple raw-log clinic baseline (r29). The clinic evaluator path re-applies what the harness computes from archived evidence, with the world readouts as archived. Two disclosed deviations: the runner crashed in its own bookkeeping on the case with a deleted trajectory before any claims tool had produced output; the one-line fix changed only that bookkeeping (both runner digests recorded; the tool files are identical across the two invocations), the claims part then ran once, and the clinic part, which had already run once, was not rerun; and the brief described the agent-attributed access log as the same list as the trajectory’s, so three cases were implemented on the trajectory’s copy with the slice re-derived, which the fidelity reviewer was told and confirmed.
paragraphs.zh: 在这些规格中，18 份没有符合其所述要求的基准存档：17 份 clinic 的（13 份需要一次成功的 OFF-A 片段，而 Block BC 没有任何 OFF-A 片段），1 份带有一条主张；由于任务说明是盲评的，没有说明每一级包含哪些结果，保真审查员判定其中 2 份（LC14、LC15）不忠实；这些均未运行。 已接纳：claims 27 个案例（20 个损坏案例，其中 16 个为预期不计入，另有 7 个对照案例）和 clinic 9 个案例（6 个损坏案例，全部为预期不计入，另有 3 个对照案例）。 工具。claims：组合流水线（分类器、void 门控）、带分类器的评估器、claims 有效性重新推导（C8）、独立评分器、简单原始日志基线（r28）、修复后的原始日志检查器（r29）；clinic：组合流水线（driver 行、void 门控）、带分类器的评估器（刷新）、BC 有效性重新推导、独立评分器、简单原始日志 clinic 基线（r29）。 clinic 评估器路径重新应用 harness 从存档证据计算出的结果，其中世界读数按存档时的状态使用。 两处已披露的偏差：运行器在 claims 工具产生任何输出之前，在包含已删除轨迹的案例上因自身记账而崩溃；这一行修复仅改变了该记账部分（两个运行器摘要均已记录；两次调用中的工具文件完全相同），随后 claims 部分运行了一次，而已运行过一次的 clinic 部分未重新运行；以及任务说明将智能体归属的访问日志描述为与轨迹相同的列表，因此有三个案例基于轨迹的副本实现并重新推导了切片，保真审查员已被告知此事并予以确认。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 gives each tool; Table 22 every case. The combined pipeline accepted all 10 controls (7 claims, 3 clinic) and, of the 26 corruptions, rejected or flagged 24 (including the wrong-class case below), gave no verdict on 2 and counted none as clean: no false acceptance and 2 abstentions, which is not 26/26 detection. It missed three: on KC01, KC08 (missing trajectory, missing required artifact) the classifier alone returned the expected harness_error , but the evaluator raised a file-not-found error, so the pipeline reached no verdict; on KC13 (missing required ON review panel) it rejected the case as invalid_intervention rather than observation_not_delivered , because the evaluator’s panel-geometry validity term precedes the delivery row. The claims validity re-derivation counted 9 corruptions as clean (KC06, KC07, KC09, KC11, KC12, KC13, KC14, KC15, KC20); each falls under a countedness row it does not re-derive by design, since it re-derives intervention validity only. The independent scorer counted 9 claims corruptions as clean (KC02, KC03, KC04, KC05, KC06, KC11, KC14, KC15, KC20): it does not read the stop reason, recorded infrastructure errors, read-target violations, per-call model identity, harness text across steps, access-log episode stamps or the arm payload. In the clinic, Block BC’s validity re-derivation and the scorer both counted LC07 (supplied-frame failure on silent arm) as clean: the validity script re-derives frame supply from the frame file, which the case left in place, and the scorer’s input check gates only rows the driver counted; the operational driver voided the case as expected, and in a block that disagreement triggers the void gate. The simple raw-log baselines counted 14 of the 16 claims corruptions expected uncounted as clean (the repaired checker the same cases) and 5 of the 6 clinic ones; none reads stop reasons, infrastructure errors, read targets, prompts, episode stamps or arm payloads. The clinic baseline accepted every control but never reports the booked-slot term I1 as passing, so it meets no exact expectation.
paragraphs.zh: 表 21 给出每个工具，表 22 给出每个案例。 组合流水线接受了全部 10 个对照（7 个索赔、3 个临床），在 26 个损坏样本中拒绝或标记了 24 个（包括下文的错误类别案例），对 2 个未给出判定，且没有任何一个被计为干净：即零错误接受、2 次弃权，这并非 26/26 的检出。 它漏掉了三个：在 KC01、KC08（缺失轨迹、缺失必需工件）上，分类器本身返回了预期的 harness_error，但评估器抛出了文件未找到错误，因此流水线未得出判定；在 KC13（缺失必需的 ON 审查小组）上，它以 invalid_intervention 而非 observation_not_delivered 拒绝了该案例，因为评估器的小组几何有效性条款先于交付行生效。 索赔有效性重新推导将 9 个损坏样本计为干净（KC06、KC07、KC09、KC11、KC12、KC13、KC14、KC15、KC20）；每一个按设计都属于它不重新推导的计数行，因为它只重新推导干预有效性。 独立评分器将 9 个索赔损坏样本计为干净（KC02、KC03、KC04、KC05、KC06、KC11、KC14、KC15、KC20）：它不读取停止原因、记录的基础设施错误、读取目标违规、每次调用的模型身份、跨步骤的测试框架文本、访问日志的会话戳或分支负载。 在临床中，区块 BC 的有效性重新推导和评分器都将 LC07（静默分支上的供给帧失败）计为干净：有效性脚本从帧文件重新推导帧供给，而该案例保留了帧文件，且评分器的输入检查只对驱动程序计数的行进行把关；操作性驱动程序按预期将该案例作废，而在区块中这种不一致会触发作废门控。 简单原始日志基线将 16 个预期不被计数的索赔损坏样本中的 14 个计为干净（修复后的检查器同样针对这些案例），在 6 个临床损坏样本中为 5 个；没有哪一个读取停止原因、基础设施错误、读取目标、提示、会话戳或分支负载。 临床基线接受了每一个对照，但从不报告已预约时段项 I1 为通过，因此它不满足任何精确预期。

sents.zh: 组合流水线接受了全部 10 个对照（7 个索赔、3 个临床），在 26 个损坏样本中拒绝或标记了 24 个（包括下文的错误类别案例），对 2 个未给出判定，且没有任何一个被计为干净：即零错误接受、2 次弃权，这并非 26/26 的检出。

sents.en: It missed three: on KC01, KC08 (missing trajectory, missing required artifact) the classifier alone returned the expected harness_error , but the evaluator raised a file-not-found error, so the pipeline reached no verdict; on KC13 (missing required ON review panel) it rejected the case as invalid_intervention rather than observation_not_delivered , because the evaluator’s panel-geometry validity term precedes the delivery row.
sents.zh: 它漏掉了三个：在 KC01、KC08（缺失轨迹、缺失必需工件）上，分类器本身返回了预期的 harness_error，但评估器抛出了文件未找到错误，因此流水线未得出判定；在 KC13（缺失必需的 ON 审查小组）上，它以 invalid_intervention 而非 observation_not_delivered 拒绝了该案例，因为评估器的小组几何有效性条款先于交付行生效。

sents.en: The claims validity re-derivation counted 9 corruptions as clean (KC06, KC07, KC09, KC11, KC12, KC13, KC14, KC15, KC20); each falls under a countedness row it does not re-derive by design, since it re-derives intervention validity only.
sents.zh: 索赔有效性重新推导将 9 个损坏样本计为干净（KC06、KC07、KC09、KC11、KC12、KC13、KC14、KC15、KC20）；每一个按设计都属于它不重新推导的计数行，因为它只重新推导干预有效性。

sents.en: The independent scorer counted 9 claims corruptions as clean (KC02, KC03, KC04, KC05, KC06, KC11, KC14, KC15, KC20): it does not read the stop reason, recorded infrastructure errors, read-target violations, per-call model identity, harness text across steps, access-log episode stamps or the arm payload.
sents.zh: 独立评分器将 9 个索赔损坏样本计为干净（KC02、KC03、KC04、KC05、KC06、KC11、KC14、KC15、KC20）：它不读取停止原因、记录的基础设施错误、读取目标违规、每次调用的模型身份、跨步骤的测试框架文本、访问日志的会话戳或分支负载。

sents.en: In the clinic, Block BC’s validity re-derivation and the scorer both counted LC07 (supplied-frame failure on silent arm) as clean: the validity script re-derives frame supply from the frame file, which the case left in place, and the scorer’s input check gates only rows the driver counted; the operational driver voided the case as expected, and in a block that disagreement triggers the void gate.
sents.zh: 在临床中，区块 BC 的有效性重新推导和评分器都将 LC07（静默分支上的供给帧失败）计为干净：有效性脚本从帧文件重新推导帧供给，而该案例保留了帧文件，且评分器的输入检查只对驱动程序计数的行进行把关；操作性驱动程序按预期将该案例作废，而在区块中这种不一致会触发作废门控。

sents.en: The simple raw-log baselines counted 14 of the 16 claims corruptions expected uncounted as clean (the repaired checker the same cases) and 5 of the 6 clinic ones; none reads stop reasons, infrastructure errors, read targets, prompts, episode stamps or arm payloads.
sents.zh: 简单原始日志基线将 16 个预期不被计数的索赔损坏样本中的 14 个计为干净（修复后的检查器同样针对这些案例），在 6 个临床损坏样本中为 5 个；没有哪一个读取停止原因、基础设施错误、读取目标、提示、会话戳或分支负载。

sents.en: The clinic baseline accepted every control but never reports the booked-slot term I1 as passing, so it meets no exact expectation.
sents.zh: 临床基线接受了每一个对照，但从不报告已预约时段项 I1 为通过，因此它不满足任何精确预期。

paragraphs.en: Coverage is uneven: the clinic side has 6 corruptions, all expected uncounted, and no outcome-invariant corruption, because every such specification needed a base outcome Block BC does not contain; 19 of the 27 claims cases use the two L0 archives, and every clinic base is an Opus Block BC archive. The results are per case, not rates. The authors chose the brief’s excerpts, wrote the implementation and chose the tools, having read the earlier challenges; the implementation was sealed before any tool ran, and a model, not an independent team, reviewed its fidelity. What was blind is exactly the case design: specifications and expected verdicts were written without the implementation, the paper, earlier cases or model outcomes. The controls are a constructed case set, not a false-positive-rate estimate, and claims and clinic counts are never pooled into a rate. GPT-6’s expectations are its readings of the registered rules.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖并不均衡：临床侧有 6 个损坏情形，全部预期不计入，且没有结果不变式损坏情形，因为每一条此类规范都需要基础结果 Block BC 所不包含的内容；27 个声明案例中有 19 个使用两个 L0 档案，且每个临床基础都是一个 Opus Block BC 档案。 结果是按案例给出的，而不是比率。 作者选择了简报中的摘录、编写了实现并选择了工具，他们是在阅读了此前的质疑之后完成这些工作的；实现在任何工具运行之前就已封存，而对其忠实度的审查是由一个模型而非独立团队完成的。 盲态的对象正是案例设计：规范和预期裁定是在没有实现、论文、先前案例或模型结果的情况下写成的。 对照组是一个构造出来的案例集，而不是假阳性率的估计，且声明与临床的计数从不被合并成比率。 GPT-6 的预期是它对已注册规则的解读。

paragraphs.en: This challenge differs from the rule-only one (Appendix E ) in one respect that matters: the authors neither implemented nor reviewed the cases. Constructor and sandbox. One headless Gemini CLI call ( gemini-3.1-pro-preview , default approval mode; it could neither run a shell nor write files) worked in a sandbox holding only: the four rule and schema files of the rule-only challenge’s brief (byte copies, same redactions), 15 byte-verified copies of counted base archives (9 claims, three each from CLM-B, CLM-BS and CLM-BG, including failed episodes; 6 Block BC clinic ones), and an instruction file asking for at least 20 corruptions and 8 unusual-but-valid controls per workflow, a stdlib-only generator that edits every copy of a changed fact and recomputes recorded digests, and an expectation file. The sandbox held no code of ours, no earlier case, class or finding, no paper and no outcome table; a leak check of the instructions, prompt and every base file found no case identifier, tool name or earlier-round label outside verbatim rule text. Instantiation and seal. The agent returned the generator and 56 expectations between markers; both were saved byte for byte and the generator ran once, unedited. It built 55 cases; EB11 is excluded because its own generation raised, and no repair round was used. The cases, expectations, transcript, runner and scorer were sealed at 2026-09-25 09:59:06Z, before any tool under test touched any case (the only earlier tool run was a loader smoke test on unmodified base copies). The run began at 2026-09-25 09:59:09Z, used no model and no world; tool and case files did not change during it. The runner is the rule-only challenge’s with only its loader adapted, and the scoring functions are that challenge’s, copied verbatim.
paragraphs.zh: 本挑战与纯规则挑战（附录 E）有一处关键差异：作者既未实现也未审查这些案例。构造与沙盒。 一次无界面的 Gemini CLI 调用（gemini-3.1-pro-preview，默认审批模式；它既不能运行 shell 也不能写文件）在一个仅包含以下内容的沙盒中进行：纯规则挑战简报的四个规则与模式文件（字节副本，同样的脱敏处理）、15 份经字节验证的已清点基础归档副本（9 个声明，分别来自 CLM-B、CLM-BS 和 CLM-BG 各三个，包括失败回合；6 个来自 Block BC 诊所的），以及一份要求每个工作流至少包含 20 个损坏项和 8 个异常但有效的对照的指令文件、一个仅使用标准库、会编辑被修改事实的每一个副本并重新计算已记录摘要的生成器，还有一份预期文件。 沙盒中没有我们的任何代码，没有先前的案例、类别或发现，没有论文，也没有结果表；对指令、提示词和每个基础文件的泄漏检查发现，除逐字引用的规则文本外，没有任何案例标识符、工具名称或先前轮次的标签。实例化与封存。 智能体返回了生成器和标记之间的 56 条预期；两者均按字节原样保存，生成器未经编辑地运行了一次。 它构建了 55 个案例；EB11 被排除，因为其自身的生成抛出了错误，且未使用任何修复回合。 案例、预期、转录、运行器和评分器于 2026-09-25 09:59:06Z 封存，此时被测的任何工具尚未接触任何案例（此前唯一的工具运行是对未修改基础副本的加载器冒烟测试）。 运行始于 2026-09-25 09:59:09Z，未使用任何模型和世界；运行期间工具和案例文件未发生变化。 运行器即纯规则挑战的运行器，仅适配了其加载器；评分函数也是该挑战的，逐字复制而来。

paragraphs.en: Table 23 gives each tool. Against the simple raw-log baselines (claims: the r28 baseline; clinic: the r29 baseline) the pipeline caught 13 claims corruptions the baseline missed and the baseline none the pipeline missed; in the clinic 9 against 1 (EB12, whose edit added a key the schema lacks; the baseline scores it only because it never reports the booked-slot term I1 as passing). Every miss: the pipeline counted EA08, EA09, EA19, EA20 (claims) and EB01, EB03, EB10, EB12, EB14, EB16, EB17, EB18 (clinic) as clean. EB14 and EB18 are undisputed gaps: EB14 changed a collateral appointment’s status only in the final state rows, disagreeing with the archived I3 pass, and EB18 set the trajectory’s event-log target version equal to its source version while the event log and step copies were unchanged; the pipeline does not cross-check these copies. Three claims misses (EA08, EA19, EA20) edit only an archived derived verdict, which the pipeline silently re-derives instead of flagging the disagreement. It gave no verdict on EA01 and EA18 (a deleted trajectory or claims file: the evaluator raised), and rejected EA11, EB05, EB08, EB09, EB19, EB20 under a class other than the registered one (clinic: the void gate’s G0_void where the rules name the infrastructure or harness verdict). It did not count EA26, EA27, EB27, controls that change one copy of a fact: the scorer reported the disagreement and the void gate voided the case, whereas the agent expected them counted. Disputes (scores unchanged). Written after scoring from a mechanical diff of each case against its base: six edit only a derived field that the refresh re-derives or the rules say is never read (EA08, EA19, EA20, EB03, EB10, EB17); three equal their base (EA09, EA28, EB28); three expect an outcome the unchanged evidence contradicts (EA24, EB24, EB25); two add a key the schema lacks (EB12, EB26); two set a stop reason the rules do not register (EB01, EB16); two are controls that change one copy of a fact, against the instructions (EA26, EA27); one is a control the rules leave open (EB27). On the undisputed cases alone the pipeline caught 14/16 claims corruptions with 0 counted as clean and 2 without verdict (baseline 1 and 11), and 11/13 clinic ones with 2 counted as clean (baseline 2 and 10), accepting every undisputed control.
paragraphs.zh: 表23列出了每个工具。 与简单的原始日志基线相比（claims：r28基线；clinic：r29基线），该流水线捕捉到了13处基线遗漏的claims损坏，而基线捕捉到而流水线遗漏的为零；在clinic中为9对1（EB12，其编辑添加了模式中不存在的键；基线之所以给它计分，只是因为它从不将被预订时段术语I1报告为通过）。 所有遗漏：流水线将EA08、EA09、EA19、EA20（claims）和EB01、EB03、EB10、EB12、EB14、EB16、EB17、EB18（clinic）判定为干净。 EB14和EB18是无可争议的缺口：EB14仅在最终状态行中更改了关联预约的状态，与已归档的I3通过结果不一致；EB18将轨迹的事件日志目标版本设置为与其源版本相等，而事件日志和步骤副本均未更改；流水线不交叉核对这些副本。 三处claims遗漏（EA08、EA19、EA20）仅编辑了已归档的派生结论，流水线静默地重新推导该结论，而不是标记这一不一致。 它对EA01和EA18（删除的轨迹或claims文件：评估器抛出异常）未给出结论，并以不同于注册类别的类别拒绝了EA11、EB05、EB08、EB09、EB19、EB20（clinic：规则中命名的是基础设施或测试框架结论，而它给出的是G0_void空档门）。 它未将EA26、EA27、EB27计入，这些是更改事实单一副本的对照项：计分器报告了不一致，且空档门将案例作废，而智能体期望它们被计入。 争议项（分数未变）。 在计分后，基于每个案例相对其基础的机械差异撰写：六个仅编辑了刷新会重新推导或规则规定从不读取的派生字段（EA08、EA19、EA20、EB03、EB10、EB17）；三个与其基础相同（EA09、EA28、EB28）；三个期望的结果与未改变的证据相矛盾（EA24、EB24、EB25）；两个添加了模式中不存在的键（EB12、EB26）；两个设置了规则未注册的停止原因（EB01、EB16）；两个是违反指令、更改事实单一副本的对照项（EA26、EA27）；一个是规则留待开放的对照项（EB27）。 仅就无可争议的案例而言，流水线捕捉到了14/16的claims损坏，0个被计为干净，2个无结论（基线为1和11）；clinic中捕捉到11/13，2个被计为干净（基线为2和10），并接受了每一个无可争议的对照项。

sents.en: It gave no verdict on EA01 and EA18 (a deleted trajectory or claims file: the evaluator raised), and rejected EA11, EB05, EB08, EB09, EB19, EB20 under a class other than the registered one (clinic: the void gate’s G0_void where the rules name the infrastructure or harness verdict).
sents.zh: 它对EA01和EA18（删除的轨迹或claims文件：评估器抛出异常）未给出结论，并以不同于注册类别的类别拒绝了EA11、EB05、EB08、EB09、EB19、EB20（clinic：规则中命名的是基础设施或测试框架结论，而它给出的是G0_void空档门）。

sents.en: It did not count EA26, EA27, EB27, controls that change one copy of a fact: the scorer reported the disagreement and the void gate voided the case, whereas the agent expected them counted.
sents.zh: 它未将EA26、EA27、EB27计入，这些是更改事实单一副本的对照项：计分器报告了不一致，且空档门将案例作废，而智能体期望它们被计入。

sents.en: Disputes (scores unchanged).
sents.zh: 争议项（分数未变）。

sents.en: Written after scoring from a mechanical diff of each case against its base: six edit only a derived field that the refresh re-derives or the rules say is never read (EA08, EA19, EA20, EB03, EB10, EB17); three equal their base (EA09, EA28, EB28); three expect an outcome the unchanged evidence contradicts (EA24, EB24, EB25); two add a key the schema lacks (EB12, EB26); two set a stop reason the rules do not register (EB01, EB16); two are controls that change one copy of a fact, against the instructions (EA26, EA27); one is a control the rules leave open (EB27).
sents.zh: 在计分后，基于每个案例相对其基础的机械差异撰写：六个仅编辑了刷新会重新推导或规则规定从不读取的派生字段（EA08、EA19、EA20、EB03、EB10、EB17）；三个与其基础相同（EA09、EA28、EB28）；三个期望的结果与未改变的证据相矛盾（EA24、EB24、EB25）；两个添加了模式中不存在的键（EB12、EB26）；两个设置了规则未注册的停止原因（EB01、EB16）；两个是违反指令、更改事实单一副本的对照项（EA26、EA27）；一个是规则留待开放的对照项（EB27）。

sents.en: On the undisputed cases alone the pipeline caught 14/16 claims corruptions with 0 counted as clean and 2 without verdict (baseline 1 and 11), and 11/13 clinic ones with 2 counted as clean (baseline 2 and 10), accepting every undisputed control.
sents.zh: 仅就无可争议的案例而言，流水线捕捉到了14/16的claims损坏，0个被计为干净，2个无结论（基线为1和11）；clinic中捕捉到11/13，2个被计为干净（基线为2和10），并接受了每一个无可争议的对照项。

paragraphs.en: The design is shallow: one call, one base per workflow (a CLM-B Opus success and a Block BC success) although several were requested, one-to-three-word case descriptions, and no case marked ambiguous; 19 of 56 expectations are disputable. Most corruptions flip a single field the harness records (stop reason, infrastructure errors, read-target violations, episode marker, a policy-input fault or digest) that the operational validity table reads by design; the raw-log baselines were built to audit intervention validity and the I1/I2 terms and do not read those fields, so part of the gap reflects their narrower scope, and a baseline that reads the validity-table fields was not tested. The constructor is an LLM agent, not an independent research team, and Gemini is also a policy under test elsewhere in this paper (CLM-BG, the same model); the authors chose the rule excerpts, the base archives, the instructions and the tools. The results are per case on this suite, not detection rates, and claims and clinic counts are not pooled.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计较为浅显：每个工作流只调用一次、只用一个基座（一次 CLM-B Opus 成功和一次 Block BC 成功），尽管请求了多个；案例描述只有一到三个词，且没有任何案例被标记为有歧义；56 条预期中有 19 条存在争议。 大多数破坏性操作只翻转测试框架记录的单一字段（停止原因、基础设施错误、读取目标违规、回合标记、策略输入故障或摘要），而操作有效性表在设计上正是读取这些字段；原始日志基线是为了审计干预有效性和 I1/I2 术语而构建的，并不读取这些字段，因此部分差距反映了它们更窄的范围，而读取有效性表字段的基线并未被测试。 构造者是一个 LLM 智能体，而非独立的研究团队，且 Gemini 在本文其他地方也是被测试的策略之一（CLM-BG，同一模型）；规则摘录、基座档案、指令和工具均由作者选择。 这些结果是本套件上逐案例的结果，而非检测率，并且声明和诊所数量未被汇总。
