paragraphs.en: Block BC (ADDENDUM 18; Claude Opus 5, Claude CLI, frames by file read): 16 instances (seeds 42–49, 51–55, 57–59) under FRX-OFF-A, FRX-CUE-A and FRX-LIVE-A in a frozen per-instance order, plus 3 FRX-LIVE-I controls. G1 withholds an interpretation from a confirmatory contrast with fewer than 13 complete pairs; the rescue-opportunity gate is 8 OFF-A failures. Block BCS (ADDENDUM 19; Claude Sonnet 5, Claude CLI, frames by file read) and Block BGC (ADDENDUM 19; GPT-6, Codex CLI, frames inline) run the same instances; BGC adds FRX-OFF-I and the target-relevance contrast to its block-local Holm family. Block BG2 (ADDENDUM 19; GPT-6, Codex CLI, frames inline) runs Block B’s cells only if Block BC is dropped. CUE–OFF asks whether adding the verification reminder with a source link changes success, and LIVE–CUE whether displaying the current value in it does. The estimand is the effect at the fixed 48-action budget, so it includes the navigation effort the value saves; the design’s increase from 10 to 16 triples before any BC rollout is disclosed in Appendix M . States: BC completed; BCS incomplete at the registered experiment cutoff; BG2 fallback not triggered; BGC’s final disposition is stated once, below. Admission (ADDENDUM 19): pass. Frame delivery is admitted per channel (§ 6.7 ): a model that reads frames through a file-read tool must read the frame it was handed, and one that receives frames inline must transcribe a random code printed on the frame, with the invocation record naming that frame. Reading-rule source mirrored: audit block_report.py 493abaaeeb4b . The LIVE–OFF comparisons are supporting descriptive analyses; they support neither a confirmatory replication claim nor a claim that the effect differs from Block B (moved from Section 7.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 块 BC（ADDENDUM 18；Claude Opus 5，Claude CLI，逐文件读取帧）：16 个实例（种子 42–49、51–55、57–59）在固定的逐实例顺序下运行 FRX-OFF-A、FRX-CUE-A 和 FRX-LIVE-A，外加 3 个 FRX-LIVE-I 对照。 G1 在确证性对比的完整配对少于 13 时放弃解释；补救机会门槛为 8 次 OFF-A 失败。 块 BCS（ADDENDUM 19；Claude Sonnet 5，Claude CLI，逐文件读取帧）与块 BGC（ADDENDUM 19；GPT-6，Codex CLI，内联帧）运行相同的实例；BGC 将 FRX-OFF-I 和目标相关性对比纳入其块局部 Holm 家族。 块 BG2（ADDENDUM 19；GPT-6，Codex CLI，内联帧）仅当块 BC 被放弃时才运行块 B 的单元格。 CUE–OFF 询问添加带来源链接的验证提醒是否会改变成功率，LIVE–CUE 询问在其中显示当前值是否会改变成功率。 估计量是固定 48 次动作预算下的效应，因此包含该值所节省的导航成本；设计在任何 BC 展示披露之前从 10 次增至 16 次的三倍扩充记录于附录 M。 状态：BC 已完成；BCS 在注册的实验截止时未完成；BG2 回退未触发；BGC 的最终处置在下文仅陈述一次。 准入（ADDENDUM 19）：通过。 帧交付按通道准入（§ 6.7）：通过文件读取工具读取帧的模型必须读取其被交付的帧，以内联方式接收帧的模型必须转录帧上印刷的随机码，且调用记录中须指明该帧。 读取规则来源已镜像：审计 block_report.py 493abaaeeb4b。 LIVE–OFF 对比属于支持性描述性分析；它们既不支持确证性复现声明，也不支持该效应与块 B 存在差异的声明（自第 7.2 节移入）。

paragraphs.en: Over the 16 instances (seeds 42–49, 51–55, 57–59), Claude Opus 5 passed OFF-A 0/16, CUE-A 2/16 and LIVE-A 15/16. LIVE versus CUE (primary): rescue 13, harm 0, tie 3 of 16 pairs, net + 0.81 +0.81 [ 0.49 0.49 , 0.92 0.92 ] (marginal 95 % interval), p = 0.000244 p=0.000244 (block-local Holm p = 0.000488 p=0.000488 ). CUE versus OFF (key secondary): 2/0/14, net + 0.13 +0.13 [ − 0.09 -0.09 , 0.36 0.36 ], p = 0.5 p=0.5 (block-local Holm p = 0.5 p=0.5 ). LIVE versus OFF (supporting, descriptive, outside the paper-wide family): 15/0/1, net + 0.94 +0.94 [ 0.64 0.64 , 0.99 0.99 ]. At the registered block-local level, displaying the current location increased success relative to this cue-and-link panel. The CUE–OFF contrast did not reject; this does not establish absence of a cue effect. Contradiction, salience, and reduced verification effort remain possible explanations. The LIVE–CUE rejection survives the paper-wide Holm analysis over 12 claim-bearing tests (adjusted p = 0.00293 p=0.00293 ). The LIVE–OFF comparison is a supporting descriptive analysis; it supports neither a confirmatory replication claim nor a claim that the effect differs from Block B. The LIVE-I controls passed 3/3; nothing is attributed to the panel from unmatched controls. The independent scorer reconstructs appointment availability from archived rows; calendar compatibility is not re-derived but rests on stated design conditions (the generator and state preservation), whose checks are reported separately. Under that condition, every outcome term is resolved and agreeing with the evaluator on 51 of 51 counted rollouts (Table 14 ). Independent code re-derived this block’s validity verdicts ( audit/failure_mining/P3v2/VALIDITY_INDEPENDENT_blockBC.json ), agreeing with the archive on 53 of 53 attempts. Strict recovery occurred in 1 of 16 CUE-A and 15 of 16 LIVE-A runs, and 1 of 16 CUE-A runs followed the panel’s link (descriptive; never a reading condition).
paragraphs.zh: 在全部16个实例（种子42–49、51–55、57–59）上，Claude Opus 5 的 OFF-A 通过率为 0/16，CUE-A 为 2/16，LIVE-A 为 15/16。 LIVE 对 CUE（主要）：16对中救援13、损害0、平局3，净效应 +0.81 [0.49, 0.92]（边际95%区间），p = 0.000244（区块内局部 Holm 校正 p = 0.000488）。 CUE 对 OFF（关键次要）：2/0/14，净效应 +0.13 [−0.09, 0.36]，p = 0.5（区块内局部 Holm 校正 p = 0.5）。 LIVE 对 OFF（支持性、描述性，不属于全文检验族）：15/0/1，净效应 +0.94 [0.64, 0.99]。 在预注册的区块内局部水平上，显示当前位置相对于该提示与链接面板提高了成功率。 CUE–OFF 对比未获拒绝；这并不能证明提示效应不存在。 矛盾、显著性以及验证成本的降低仍是可能的解释。 LIVE–CUE 的拒绝结果在全文12项含声明检验的 Holm 分析中依然成立（校正后 p = 0.00293）。 LIVE–OFF 比较是一项支持性描述性分析；它既不支持验证性重复声明，也不支持该效应不同于区块B的声明。 LIVE-I 对照全部通过（3/3）；未匹配的对照不归因于面板的任何结果。 独立评分者从存档行中重建预约可用性；日历兼容性未被重新推导，而是基于所述设计条件（生成器与状态保存），其检查结果另行报告。 在该条件下，所有结果项均已被解析，且在全部51次计数的 rollout 中与评估器一致（表14）。 独立代码重新推导了本区块的有效性判定（audit/failure_mining/P3v2/VALIDITY_INDEPENDENT_blockBC.json），在全部53次尝试上与存档一致。 严格恢复出现在16次 CUE-A 运行中的1次和16次 LIVE-A 运行中的15次，且16次 CUE-A 运行中有1次跟随了面板的链接（描述性；从不作为读出条件）。

sents.zh: LIVE 对 OFF（支持性、描述性，不属于全文检验族）：15/0/1，净效应 +0.94 [0.64, 0.99]。

sents.en: At the registered block-local level, displaying the current location increased success relative to this cue-and-link panel.
sents.zh: 在预注册的区块内局部水平上，显示当前位置相对于该提示与链接面板提高了成功率。

sents.en: The CUE–OFF contrast did not reject; this does not establish absence of a cue effect.
sents.zh: CUE–OFF 对比未获拒绝；这并不能证明提示效应不存在。

sents.en: Contradiction, salience, and reduced verification effort remain possible explanations.
sents.zh: 矛盾、显著性以及验证成本的降低仍是可能的解释。

sents.en: The LIVE–CUE rejection survives the paper-wide Holm analysis over 12 claim-bearing tests (adjusted p = 0.00293 p=0.00293 ).
sents.zh: LIVE–CUE 的拒绝结果在全文12项含声明检验的 Holm 分析中依然成立（校正后 p = 0.00293）。

sents.en: The LIVE–OFF comparison is a supporting descriptive analysis; it supports neither a confirmatory replication claim nor a claim that the effect differs from Block B.
sents.zh: LIVE–OFF 比较是一项支持性描述性分析；它既不支持验证性重复声明，也不支持该效应不同于区块B的声明。

sents.en: The LIVE-I controls passed 3/3; nothing is attributed to the panel from unmatched controls.
sents.zh: LIVE-I 对照全部通过（3/3）；未匹配的对照不归因于面板的任何结果。

sents.en: The independent scorer reconstructs appointment availability from archived rows; calendar compatibility is not re-derived but rests on stated design conditions (the generator and state preservation), whose checks are reported separately.
sents.zh: 独立评分者从存档行中重建预约可用性；日历兼容性未被重新推导，而是基于所述设计条件（生成器与状态保存），其检查结果另行报告。

sents.en: Under that condition, every outcome term is resolved and agreeing with the evaluator on 51 of 51 counted rollouts (Table 14 ).
sents.zh: 在该条件下，所有结果项均已被解析，且在全部51次计数的 rollout 中与评估器一致（表14）。

paragraphs.en: Block CLM-B (PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS; Claude Opus 5, Claude CLI, frames by file read) runs CLM-OFF-A and CLM-ON-A in a counterbalanced frozen order, with CLM-ON-I and CLM-L0 controls, on 10 frozen generated instances (seeds 0–9); Block CLM-BS (PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS ADDENDUM 1; Claude Sonnet 5, Claude CLI, frames by file read) runs the same cells in the same order. The paired instances are stratified by whether the limit rises or falls and whether the change crosses the eligible amount; on a threshold-crossing increase, copying the displayed limit instead of deriving min(eligible, limit) is wrong, which the derived-decision gate uses. Registered wording: PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS words R1 as “The certified evaluation protocol transfers to a second domain with a derived decision, and the review-step intervention increases full-task success”. We prospectively instantiate the same protocol on a second workflow with a different authoritative object and a derived decision rule; this tests task-level reuse, not environment-level transfer. This paper’s templates are narrower (no transfer claim is printed, the task cannot repair an already committed approval, and a failure includes no commit and budget exhaustion). States: CLM-B completed; CLM-BS completed. The claims task runs on the clinic task’s scaffold, harness and invoker; the claim it supports is task-level reuse of the protocol, not portability, and engineering line counts are not used as evidence for it.
paragraphs.zh: 模块 CLM-B（PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS；Claude Opus 5、Claude CLI、按文件读取构建框架）以对抗平衡的冻结顺序运行 CLM-OFF-A 和 CLM-ON-A，并以 CLM-ON-I 和 CLM-L0 作为对照，在 10 个冻结的生成实例（种子 0–9）上执行；模块 CLM-BS（PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS 附件 1；Claude Sonnet 5、Claude CLI、按文件读取构建框架）以相同顺序运行相同的实验单元。 配对实例按限额是上升还是下降、以及变更是否跨越可报销金额进行分层；在跨越阈值的上升情形中，直接复制显示的限额而不是推导 min(eligible, limit) 是错误的，推导决策门控正是利用这一点。 注册表述：PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS 将 R1 表述为「经认证的评估协议可迁移到一个包含推导决策的第二领域，且评审步骤干预可提升完整任务的成功率」。 我们在一个具有不同权威对象和推导决策规则的第二个工作流上前瞻性地实例化相同协议；这检验的是任务级复用，而非环境级迁移。 本文的模板范围更窄（不输出迁移声明、任务无法修复已提交的批准，且失败情形不包含提交与预算耗尽）。 状态：CLM-B 已完成；CLM-BS 已完成。 声明任务运行在诊所任务的脚手架、测试框架与调用器之上；它所支持的声明是协议的任务级复用而非可移植性，且工程代码行数不作为其证据。

paragraphs.en: As the ledger’s mirror of the registered decision function applies them (probed from it, not typed; registered in PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS): a block with more than 6 replacements or failed readiness gives reading R4 and no result; the rescue question is open only if OFF-A fails on at least 5 pairs (else R2); R1 needs p < 0.05 p<0.05 , more rescues than harms and a minimum number of rescues, which together require at least 6 (else R3); controls are credible only if every L0 control passes and at least 2 ON-I controls pass; the derived-decision gate needs ON-A to pass on at least 2 threshold-crossing-increase pairs. Sample size and seeds are fixed by the block’s specification (10 frozen generated instances (seeds 0–9)).
paragraphs.zh: 由于账本中对已注册决策函数的镜像会应用它们（从镜像中探测获得，而非手工输入；注册于 PRECOMMIT_CLAIMS 中）：替换次数超过 6 次或就绪性检查失败的区块给出读取结果 R4 且无结论；仅当 OFF-A 在至少 5 对上失败时救援问题才开放（否则为 R2）；R1 要求 p < 0.05、救援多于损害且救援次数达到最低数量，这些条件合计要求至少 6 次（否则为 R3）；仅当所有 L0 对照通过且至少 2 个 ON-I 对照通过时，对照结果才可信；派生决策门要求 ON-A 在至少 2 个阈值交叉增加对上通过。 样本量与随机种子由区块的规范固定（10 个冻结的生成实例（种子 0–9））。

For each block it asserts that the paper’s mirror of claims_readings.decide , the registered function itself (loaded read-only from its pinned file) on the archived decide_inputs , and the reading stored in the result file are identical (CLM-B: registered decide() = mirror = stored reading; CLM-BS: registered decide() = mirror = stored reading); that the generated report prints the same reading; that the result’s disposition and inferential eligibility agree with the state the ledger derives; and that its paper-family p p (CLM-B 1.00, CLM-BS 0.00781) and Holm slot (#6, #7) are those of Table 31 . The copy-limit baseline in each result file is asserted equal to the certification’s.

paragraphs.en: Independent scorer (4 terms per rollout; gate passed and passed): every term resolved and agreeing with the evaluator on 24 of 24 (CLM-B) and 24 of 24 (CLM-BS) counted rows; the derived-amount term resolved on 24 and 24; unresolved rows 0 and 0; contradictions 0 and 0. Standard-library validity re-derivation: agreeing on 24 of 24 and 25 of 25 attempts (an interrupted attempt has no archive and is re-derived as uncounted); counted rows valid 24 of 24 and 24 of 24. sents.en: Before the freeze no Gemini call carried a claims-task prompt or frame; the engineering calls used synthetic images only and are archived.
sents.zh: 在冻结之前，没有任何 Gemini 调用携带 claims 任务提示或框架；工程调用仅使用了合成图像，且均已存档。

paragraphs.en: The ledger asserts that the block specification’s slots (10 OFF-A/ON-A pairs, three ON-I cells and one L0 cell), instances, counterbalanced order and 40-step budget equal CLM-B’s. The task text, world, trigger, action schema, scorer, validity rules and registered decision function ( claims_readings.decide , the file pinned for CLM-B and CLM-BS) are the frozen claims ones.
paragraphs.zh: 该账本断言，该区块规格的槽位（10 对 OFF-A/ON-A、三个 ON-I 单元和一个 L0 单元）、实例、平衡顺序以及 40 步预算均与 CLM-B 相同。 任务文本、世界、触发器、动作模式、评分器、有效性规则以及已注册的决策函数（claims_readings.decide，即为 CLM-B 和 CLM-BS 锁定的文件）均为冻结的 claims 版本。

paragraphs.en: Only the policy side changes: model and provider; invoker (one stateless REST generateContent request per step from the driver process, instead of a fresh Claude CLI session per step); tools (none, instead of the file-read tool only); frame delivery (the frame inline in every request, instead of an instruction to read the frame file, which the Claude policies executed on 357/357 (CLM-B) and 217/297 (CLM-BS) policy steps, counts pinned before any CLM-BG rollout); and pinned generation settings (temperature 1.0, top- p p 0.95, top- k k 64, thinking level “high”, high media resolution), where the Claude CLI’s cannot be set. Within Gemini, OFF-A and ON-A share one delivery channel. Every response’s model version and a models.get capture before and after the block ( 3.1-pro-preview-01-2026 both times) record the model’s identity; a server-side change under the same strings would not be detectable.
paragraphs.zh: 只有策略侧发生了变化：模型与提供方；调用方式（由驱动进程在每一步发起一次无状态的 REST generateContent 请求，而不是每一步新建一个 Claude CLI 会话）；工具（无，而不是仅有文件读取工具）；帧交付方式（每一请求内联帧本身，而不是指示读取帧文件——在 CLM-BG 部署之前统计，Claude 策略在 357/357（CLM-B）和 217/297（CLM-BS）个策略步上执行了该指示）；以及固定的生成设置（temperature 1.0、top-p 0.95、top-k 64、思考级别「高」、高媒体分辨率），而 Claude CLI 的对应设置无法设定。 在 Gemini 内部，OFF-A 与 ON-A 共用同一交付通道。 每次响应的模型版本，以及该区块前后各一次的 models.get 捕获（两次均为 3.1-pro-preview-01-2026）记录了模型的身份；在相同字符串之下发生的服务端变更将无法被检测到。

paragraphs.en: Six registered gates (identity, statelessness, request content, model and settings, a stub end-to-end run, and a live scripted certification whose policy requests went to a loopback stub, never to Gemini) passed on the final invoker digest. The first live certification stopped at episode 41 of 48: the invoker’s own pre-send check refused to send because the API-key pattern matched inside the base64 bytes of a real portal frame (3 of 915 archived certification frames match). No model call or output was involved. The check now blanks the image bytes before the pattern test and still refuses the exact key; because the invoker’s digest changed, every admission gate was re-run from scratch on the final digest, and the superseded records are archived and unused.
paragraphs.zh: 六项注册门（身份、无状态、请求内容、模型与设置、桩端到端运行，以及一次真实脚本化认证——其策略请求发往回环桩，从未发往 Gemini）在最终调用器摘要上全部通过。 第一次真实认证在第 41 集（共 48 集）停止：调用器自身的发送前检查拒绝发送，因为 API 密钥模式匹配到了一个真实门户帧的 base64 字节内部（915 个归档认证帧中有 3 个匹配）。 没有涉及任何模型调用或输出。 该检查现在会在模式测试前清空图像字节，并且仍然拒绝确切的密钥；由于调用器的摘要已改变，每一项准入门都在最终摘要上从头重新运行，被取代的记录已归档且未被使用。

paragraphs.en: One launch made 25 attempts, 24 counted. One ON-A attempt received a provider HTTP 500 at step 22 and was replaced from the reserve under the registered rule (1 of 6 replacements). All 626 task requests are journaled with the digests of their frame and text, which equal the archived files. The independent scorer re-derives all four terms on the 24 counted rows and agrees with the evaluator on 24, with no contradiction and none unresolved; the standard-library validity re-derivation agrees on 25 of 25 attempts and finds all 24 counted rows valid; a separate offline re-derivation from the raw archives passes all 42 of its checks. Registered secondaries: the change fired in OFF-A 10/10, ON-A 10/10, ON-I 3/3 rollouts; the triggered-only sensitivity has 10 pairs, 5 rescues, 0 harms; the OFF-A labels of the rescued pairs are stale approval 5; and 0 of the 603 policy steps of the counted rollouts were provider-blocked or returned an empty reply.
paragraphs.zh: 一次运行发起了 25 次尝试，计入 24 次。 一次 ON-A 尝试在第 22 步收到服务商的 HTTP 500，并按照已登记的规则从备选中替换（6 次替换中的 1 次）。 全部 626 条任务请求均有日志记录，包含其框架与文本的摘要，摘要与归档文件一致。 独立评分者在计入的 24 行上重新推导全部四项，与评估者在 24 行上全部一致，无矛盾且无未决项；标准库有效性重新推导在 25 次尝试中有 25 次一致，并确认全部 24 个计入行均有效；基于原始归档的另一次离线重新推导通过了其全部 42 项检查。 已登记的次级指标：变更在 OFF-A 10/10、ON-A 10/10、ON-I 3/3 的运行中触发；仅触发型敏感性共有 10 对，5 次挽救，0 次损害；被挽救对的 OFF-A 标签为过期批准共 5；计入运行的 603 个策略步骤中，有 0 个被服务商拦截或返回空回复。

paragraphs.en: The block is complete and inferentially eligible. The registered decide() , the ledger’s mirror and the stored reading agree: R3, controls credible (L0 1/1, ON-I 3/3); ON-A succeeded on 1/3 threshold-crossing-increase pairs (the derived-decision qualifier applies to R1 only). Net paired difference + 0.50 +0.50 [ 0.12 0.12 , 0.76 0.76 ] (Newcombe method 10); the copy-limit baseline, reported beside the reading as registered: R1 (7/0/3, p = 0.0156 p=0.0156 ; controls not credible). CLM-BG’s exact p p (0.0625) is a nominal within-block p p : the block was added after the twelve-test paper-wide family was frozen, is not in it and carries no family-wise claim. The result file’s paper_family_p field and the generated report’s “Holm slot XV-1” are identifiers only, and no family computation reads them. The Results paragraph (Section 8.2 ) is ADDENDUM G’s item for R3 with credible controls, and the abstract’s sentence the matching variant, selected first-match by the ledger and filled from the result file; the limitations sentence is the addendum’s fixed one. No other sentence interprets CLM-BG, and nothing is pooled or tested between models.
paragraphs.zh: 该区块完整且具备推断资格。 已注册的 decide()、账本镜像与存储读数一致：R3，对照可信（L0 1/1，ON-I 3/3）；ON-A 在 1/3 个阈值交叉增加配对上成功（派生决策限定符仅适用于 R1）。 净配对差异 +0.50 +0.50 [ 0.12 0.12 , 0.76 0.76 ]（Newcombe 方法 10）；复制上限基线按注册规定与读数并列报告：R1（7/0/3，p = 0.0156 p=0.0156；对照不可信）。 CLM-BG 的精确 p p（0.0625）是名义上的区块内 p p：该区块是在十二项测试的论文级家族冻结之后加入的，不在该家族内，也不带有任何家族层面（family-wise）的声明。 结果文件的 paper_family_p 字段与生成报告中的「Holm 槽位 XV-1」仅为标识符，没有任何家族计算会读取它们。 结果段落（第 8.2 节）是附录 G 中关于 R3 且对照可信的条目，摘要中的句子是对应变体，由账本按首个匹配选定并从结果文件填充；局限性句子是该附录的固定表述。 没有其他句子对 CLM-BG 作出解读，且任何内容都不在模型之间进行合并或检验。

paragraphs.en: Post hoc and author-built, read-only over the frozen claims archives; no episode is re-labelled, re-scored or re-counted, and nothing here changes a registered reading.
paragraphs.zh: 事后构建、由作者完成，对已冻结的声明档案进行只读访问；没有任何情节被重新标注、重新评分或重新计数，本文中的任何内容都不会更改已注册的解读。

paragraphs.en: The step-0 request as sent to the policy (CLM-BS, OFF-A, seed 0; sha256 prefix 18cd71847bed), up to the current page, transliterated to ASCII. It is byte-checked against all 48 counted trajectories and their step-0 requests: header, task text and action schema are identical, and only the claim number varies with the instance. Each step repeats them, then shows the current page’s address, title, text (at most 3000 characters) and numbered elements, the recent actions with their memos, and a line naming the screenshot to read.
paragraphs.zh: 发送给策略（policy）的 step-0 请求（CLM-BS，OFF-A，seed 0；sha256 前缀 18cd71847bed），截取至当前页面，并转写为 ASCII。 已对全部 48 条统计轨迹及其 step-0 请求进行逐字节校验：页眉、任务文本和动作模式（action schema）完全相同，仅断言编号随实例而变。 每一步都会重复这些内容，然后显示当前页面的地址、标题、文本（至多 3000 字符）和编号元素、带有备忘的近期动作，以及一行指明要读取的截图的说明。

paragraphs.en: Regenerated from the pinned generator, reproducing the sealed seed-table digest, and checked against the start state, end state and event log of every counted episode that used them (Table 26 ). E E is the amount claimed minus the deductible; the correct approval is min ⁡ ( E , limit at approval ) \min(E,\ \text{limit at approval}) , the limit at approval being the new limit on OFF-A and ON-A; the stale approval is min ⁡ ( E , old limit ) \min(E,\ \text{old limit}) . The scripted copy-limit policy enters the displayed limit (the old one, or the review display’s new one) and never computes the minimum; over the ten pairs it has 10 OFF-A failures, 7 rescues, 0 harms, 3 ties. Controls: ON-I at seeds 0 (1400.00, copy-limit pass), 1 (1550.00, copy-limit pass) and 4 (3856.18, copy-limit fail); L0 at seed 5 (2240.59, copy-limit fail).
paragraphs.zh: 由固定的生成器重新生成，复现密封的种子表摘要，并与使用它们的每个计数剧集的起始状态、结束状态和事件日志进行核对（表 26）。 E E 为申领金额减去免赔额；正确的批准额为 min ⁡ ( E , limit at approval ) \min(E,\ \text{limit at approval})，其中批准时的限额为 OFF-A 和 ON-A 上的新限额；过期的批准额为 min ⁡ ( E , old limit ) \min(E,\ \text{old limit})。 脚本化的复制限额策略只输入显示的限额（旧限额，或审核显示中的新限额），从不计算最小值；在这十对中它有 10 次 OFF-A 失败、7 次挽救、0 次危害、3 次平局。 对照组：ON-I 在种子 0（1400.00，复制限额通过）、1（1550.00，复制限额通过）和 4（3856.18，复制限额失败）；L0 在种子 5（2240.59，复制限额失败）。

paragraphs.en: episode_reconstruction.py (standard library; it imports nothing from the claims pipeline) reads only the raw evidence of each counted episode—world snapshots, the access log, the event log, the arm payload, the delivered prompts and requests with their digests, the step list and the frames—and never an archived verdict field; the search log’s success and label are read only for the final comparison. Table 29 counts each property over the 48 episodes and Table 30 gives every episode. In the 46 armed episodes the last old-limit serve preceded the change by 11.6 to 54.5 s (median 19.9) and the change preceded the commit by 22.4 to 199.7 s (median 75.6). The stale-page property has something to check in 31 of them; in the other 15 (9 OFF-A, 4 ON-I and 2 ON-A) no Policy records page was served after the change, and the world row, history row and event log agree that it happened. “Delivered” means that the page text reached the policy and that a frame showing the old value was offered and read on at least one old-limit step (in 1 episode one such frame was not read and another was); the frame Read was not confirmed on 80 of 654 steps overall. Delivery is not belief. Report-format sensitivity. One CLM-BS ON-A episode (seed 9) approved the correct amount and failed only the report term, because its single reply line starts with prose before RESULT: , which the frozen parser requires at the start of a line. Under a looser reading that accepts RESULT: anywhere in the line, the pair would be a further rescue (9 discordant pairs, exact p = 0.00391 p=0.00391 ); the registered, stricter reading is the one reported.
paragraphs.zh: episode_reconstruction.py（标准库；它不从 claims 流水线导入任何内容）只读取每个被计入回合的原始证据——世界快照、访问日志、事件日志、机械臂载荷、连同其摘要一起交付的提示与请求、步骤列表以及各帧——从不读取任何已归档的判定字段；搜索日志中的 success 和 label 仅用于最终比较。 表 29 在 48 个回合上统计每项属性，表 30 给出每个回合的详情。 在 46 个启用机械臂的回合中，最后一次旧限值投放比变更提前 11.6 到 54.5 秒（中位数 19.9），而变更比提交提前 22.4 到 199.7 秒（中位数 75.6）。 陈旧页面属性在其中 31 个回合中有可检验的内容；在其余 15 个回合（9 个 OFF-A、4 个 ON-I 和 2 个 ON-A）中，变更之后没有投放任何 Policy 记录页，并且世界行、历史行和事件日志一致表明变更确实发生了。“已投放”意味着页面文本到达了策略，并且在至少一个旧限值步骤上提供并读取了显示旧值的帧（在 1 个回合中，有一帧未被读取而另一帧被读取了）；总体而言，654 个步骤中有 80 个步骤的帧 Read 未被确认。投放不等于信念。 报告格式的敏感性。 一个 CLM-BS ON-A 回合（种子 9）批准了正确的金额，且仅在报告项上失败，因为其唯一的回复行在 RESULT: 之前以叙述性文字开头，而冻结的解析器要求 RESULT: 位于行首。 在接受 RESULT: 出现在行内任意位置的较宽松解读下，这一对将构成又一次挽救（9 个不一致对，精确 p = 0.00391 p=0.00391）；所报告的是已注册的更严格解读。

sents.en: This supports a target-relevance effect on success under the tested trigger and interface; it is not an estimate of a general effect of dynamic environments.

paragraphs.en: BGC.R-T- GPT-6 succeeded more often under the target change than under the irrelevant one; no mechanism is inferred.
paragraphs.zh: BGC.R-T-GPT-6 在目标变化条件下的成功率高于无关变化条件；未推断出任何机制。

paragraphs.en: BGC.R-TB GPT-6 failed often even when the target did not move (FRX-OFF-I failed on [BGC:OffIFail] of [BGC:OffIN] counted rows; [BGC:OffiOffaPairs] matched pairs), so its OFF-A failures are not shown to be specific to supersession; its cue and value contrasts are read with that caveat.
paragraphs.zh: BGC.R-TB GPT-6 即使在目标未移动时也经常失败（在被计数的 [BGC:OffIN] 行中有 [BGC:OffIFail] 次失败于 FRX-OFF-I；[BGC:OffiOffaPairs] 对匹配对），因此其 OFF-A 失败并不能被证明是特定于更替（supersession）的；其线索与价值对比需附带该保留意见来解读。

paragraphs.en: BGC.R-TC The target-relevance contrast is unresolved: insufficient evidence of a difference, not equivalence (FRX-OFF-I failed on [BGC:OffIFail] of [BGC:OffIN] counted rows; [BGC:OffiOffaPairs] matched pairs).
paragraphs.zh: BGC.R-TC 目标相关性对比尚未解决：差异的证据不足，并非等效性（FRX-OFF-I 在 [BGC:OffIN] 行计数中有 [BGC:OffIFail] 行未通过；[BGC:OffiOffaPairs] 对匹配对）。

paragraphs.en: BGC.T-X No reading was registered for the target-relevance contrast before the block ran; it is reported as numbers only.
paragraphs.zh: BGC.T-X 在该代码块运行之前，没有针对目标相关性对比（target-relevance contrast）的读数被记录；它仅以数字形式报告。

paragraphs.en: QH.survive [selected: BC] The ‹Contrast› rejection survives the paper-wide Holm analysis over [HolmPaperM] claim-bearing tests (adjusted p = [‹C›HolmPaper] p=\textsf{[{\T1\guilsinglleft{}C\T1\guilsinglright{}}HolmPaper]} ).
paragraphs.zh: QH.survive [selected: BC] ‹Contrast› 拒绝在全文 [HolmPaperM] 项含主张检验的 Holm 分析中仍然成立（校正后 p = [‹C›HolmPaper] p=\textsf{[{\T1\guilsinglleft{}C\T1\guilsinglright{}}HolmPaper]}）。

paragraphs.en: QH.local [selected: CLM-BS] The ‹Contrast› contrast rejects under its registered block-local analysis but not under the paper-wide Holm analysis (adjusted p = [‹C›HolmPaper] p=\textsf{[{\T1\guilsinglleft{}C\T1\guilsinglright{}}HolmPaper]} over [HolmPaperM] tests).
paragraphs.zh: QH.local [选中: CLM-BS] 「‹Contrast›」对比在其注册的区块局部分析下被拒绝，但在全文 Holm 分析下未被拒绝（调整后 p = [‹C›HolmPaper] p=\textsf{[{\T1\guilsinglleft{}C\T1\guilsinglright{}}HolmPaper]}，共 [HolmPaperM] 项检验）。

paragraphs.en: QH.pending The paper-wide Holm-adjusted p p of the ‹Contrast› contrast awaits the rest of the family (it is at most [‹C›BonfPaper] ).
paragraphs.zh: QH.pending 论文层面的 ‹Contrast› 对比的经 Holm 校正的 p p 正在等待同族其余检验的结果（它至多为 [‹C›BonfPaper]）。

paragraphs.zh: BG2.GZP 区块 BG2 已经运行，但其有效性或结果一致性证据尚不完整；在其注册的可采性规则下，在该证据存在之前，任何结果都不会被解读。

paragraphs.en: BG2.VOID Block BG2 is void under its registered validity gate. It contributes no inferential result.
paragraphs.zh: BG2.VOID 块 BG2 在其注册的有效性门下为空。 它不产生任何推理结果。

paragraphs.en: A block’s execution disposition and inferential eligibility govern every manuscript output: failed-admission, void and R4 blocks contribute no inferential result, their reserved multiplicity slots taking p = 1 p=1 only as non-rejection placeholders displayed as ‘not admissible’; started-but-incomplete blocks are distinguished from unrun ones; and only contrasts meeting their registered completeness and validity requirements are interpreted (moved from Section 7.2 ). Every claim-bearing test enters one paper-wide Holm family of twelve tests. The family is fixed in the frozen ADDENDUM 19 and never shrinks; 12 of 12 resolved. Its historical slots are retrospective, and the family does not make the exploratory search that preceded those blocks prospective. Readings are selected by the local registered analyses; the paper-wide adjusted p p is a qualifier. The claims contrasts were individually pre-registered before rollout; because the paper-wide family was finalized only after those outcomes existed, its adjustment of the claims tests is retrospective and is reported as a sensitivity analysis, not prospective multiplicity control. Block BC’s family was frozen before any BC outcome, so its registered block-local Holm adjustment is retained as prospective multiplicity control. The Newcombe intervals are marginal 95 % intervals, not simultaneous family-adjusted intervals, and the paper-wide adjustment does not repair Block BS’s eligibility problems (delivery-confounded, Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个区块的执行处置与推断资格约束所有稿件输出：准入失败、无效和 R4 区块不产生任何推断结果，其预留的多重性槽位仅以 p = 1 p=1 作为非拒绝占位符，显示为“不可准入”；已启动但未完成的区块与未运行的区块加以区分；且只有满足其注册的完整性与有效性要求的对比才被解读（自第 7.2 节移入）。 每一个含主张声明的检验都进入一个覆盖全文、包含十二个检验的 Holm 家族。 该家族固定于冻结的 ADDENDUM 19 中，绝不缩减；12 个中已解决 12 个。 其历史槽位是回溯性的，该家族并不会使先于这些区块的探索性搜索变为前瞻性。 解读由局部注册分析选定；覆盖全文的校正 p p 是一个限定条件。 主张声明的对比在推出前均已逐一预先注册；由于全文家族是在这些结果已存在之后才最终确定的，其对主张声明的检验的校正是回溯性的，并作为敏感性分析报告，而非前瞻性的多重性控制。 区块 BC 的家族在任何 BC 结果出现之前即已冻结，因此其注册的区块局部 Holm 校正保留为前瞻性的多重性控制。 Newcombe 区间是边际 95% 区间，而非同步的家族校正区间，且覆盖全文的校正无法修复区块 BS 的资格问题（受交付混杂影响，见附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Six procedural decisions were taken during the night before the experiment freeze. paragraphs.en: An operator error in a paper file, not a rollout outcome, halted Block BCS for about nine hours: an edit changed the source digest of the sealed reading rule, and the block’s launch gate refused to resume it. Under the registered terminal rule the runner’s failure was terminal; instead the rule was restored byte-identically and the block resumed from its frozen search log, re-running no counted row, with its cells, order and cutoff unchanged. The operator had seen the verdicts of its first four attempts; the resumption depended on none of them. The block ended incomplete at its registered experiment cutoff, so both of its paper-wide slots enter as p = 1 p=1 placeholders (Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 一次纸质文件中的操作员错误（而非发布结果）导致区块 BCS 中止了约九个小时：一次编辑改变了已封存读取规则的源摘要，该区块的启动闸门因此拒绝恢复其运行。 按照已注册的终局规则，运行器的失败本应判定为终局；但实际上该规则被逐字节完全一致地还原，区块从其冻结的搜索日志中恢复运行，未重跑任何已计数行，其单元格、顺序和截止点均保持不变。 操作员已经看到其前四次尝试的判定结果；但恢复运行并不依赖于其中任何一次。 该区块在其已注册的实验截止点处结束且未完成，因此它的两个论文级槽位均以 p = 1 p=1 的占位符形式录入（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: Beside binary success we describe the claims blocks by two diagnostics built from existing evidence only—the archived independent-scorer records and validity terms, read through the ledger; no rollout was run for this table, and nothing in it is a test or a reading. Diagnostic invariant-completion fraction : of the independent scorer’s 4 outcome terms per counted rollout, the fraction met, pooled over an arm’s rollouts. This diagnostic fraction is specific to EnvOS’s endpoint decomposition and is not comparable to partial scores reported by other computer-use benchmarks. Exposure attribution (labels after OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ): exposure means the archived validity record shows the target limit changed after the superseded value had been delivered to the policy and before the commit. Handled : exposed, and the approved amount at commit is the one derived from the limit then in force. Failed after exposure : exposed, amount wrong. Untested : the arm moves no target record (ON-I moves an irrelevant one, L0 nothing), or exposure is not evidenced. A handled rollout can still miss the full endpoint on another term, which the fraction shows. For Sonnet 5 the fraction was 30/40 (0.75) without additional information at review and 39/40 (0.98) with it, and its OFF-A rollouts were 9 failed-after-exposure and 1 handled.
paragraphs.zh: 除了二元成功之外，我们通过两个仅基于现有证据构建的诊断量来描述各 claims 区块——即归档的独立评分者记录与有效性条目，通过账本读取；本表未运行任何 rollout，其中没有任何内容是测试或读取结果。 诊断性不变式完成比例：在独立评分者对每个计入的 rollout 给出的 4 个结果条目中，已满足条目所占的比例，并在同一臂的各 rollout 上汇总。 该诊断比例特定于 EnvOS 的端点分解，不能与其他计算机使用基准报告的部分分数进行比较。 暴露归因（标签沿用 OSWorld 2.0（Yuan et al., 2026））：暴露指归档的有效性记录显示，目标限额在被取代的数值已交付给策略之后、提交之前发生了变化。 已处理：发生暴露，且提交时批准的金额正是依据当时生效的限额推导出的金额。 暴露后失败：发生暴露，但金额错误。 未测试：该臂未移动任何目标记录（ON-I 移动的是无关记录，L0 未移动任何记录），或暴露没有证据支持。 一个已处理的 rollout 仍可能在另一条目上未能达成完整端点，该比例正体现了这一点。 对于 Sonnet 5，该比例在评审时无附加信息的情况下为 30/40（0.75），有附加信息时为 39/40（0.98），其 OFF-A 的 rollout 为 9 个暴露后失败和 1 个已处理。

sents.en: This diagnostic fraction is specific to EnvOS’s endpoint decomposition and is not comparable to partial scores reported by other computer-use benchmarks.

sents.en: Exposure attribution (labels after OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) ): exposure means the archived validity record shows the target limit changed after the superseded value had been delivered to the policy and before the commit.
sents.zh: 暴露归因（标签沿用 OSWorld 2.0（Yuan et al., 2026））：暴露指归档的有效性记录显示，目标限额在被取代的数值已交付给策略之后、提交之前发生了变化。

sents.en: Handled : exposed, and the approved amount at commit is the one derived from the limit then in force.
sents.zh: 已处理：发生暴露，且提交时批准的金额正是依据当时生效的限额推导出的金额。

sents.en: Failed after exposure : exposed, amount wrong.
sents.zh: 暴露后失败：发生暴露，但金额错误。

sents.en: Untested : the arm moves no target record (ON-I moves an irrelevant one, L0 nothing), or exposure is not evidenced.
sents.zh: 未测试：该臂未移动任何目标记录（ON-I 移动的是无关记录，L0 未移动任何记录），或暴露没有证据支持。

sents.en: A handled rollout can still miss the full endpoint on another term, which the fraction shows.
sents.zh: 一个已处理的 rollout 仍可能在另一条目上未能达成完整端点，该比例正体现了这一点。

sents.en: For Sonnet 5 the fraction was 30/40 (0.75) without additional information at review and 39/40 (0.98) with it, and its OFF-A rollouts were 9 failed-after-exposure and 1 handled.
sents.zh: 对于 Sonnet 5，该比例在评审时无附加信息的情况下为 30/40（0.75），有附加信息时为 39/40（0.98），其 OFF-A 的 rollout 为 9 个暴露后失败和 1 个已处理。

paragraphs.en: Our policy interface is not intended to reproduce OSWorld-style native computer use. It is a controlled semantic browser harness: each step exposes the current screenshot together with clipped visible page text and an indexed element list, accepts a fixed browser-action schema, and provides only self-authored working memory through a bounded memo/history channel. This reduces low-level perception and pointer-control variance so the experiment can isolate response to state changes. It is more instrumented than a pure pixel benchmark but also more constrained: a fixed action schema, no shell, a navigation allowlist, an isolated user, bounded memo/history and an action cap (Table 33 ). The structured text and element list may raise absolute task success relative to pixel-only computer use, while the stateless per-step process may lower it relative to an agent with persistent conversational memory; we therefore avoid ranking the harness globally as easier or harder. Our results are fixed-instance intervention contrasts within one interface under the stated assumptions (§ 7.2 ), not directly comparable leaderboard scores: because EnvOS estimates matched intervention contrasts under one fixed interface rather than absolute computer-use capability, cross-benchmark score comparability is not required for them; interface transfer remains an external-validity question.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的策略接口并非旨在复现 OSWorld 式的原生计算机操作。 它是一个受控的语义浏览器测试框架：每一步都会提供当前截图，连同裁剪后的可见页面文本和带索引的元素列表，接受固定的浏览器操作模式，并且仅通过有界的备忘/历史通道提供由智能体自创的工作记忆。 这降低了底层感知与指针控制的方差，使实验能够隔离智能体对状态变化的响应。 相比纯像素基准，它具备更多测量手段，但也更加受限：固定的操作模式、无 shell、导航白名单、隔离的用户、有界的备忘/历史以及操作次数上限（表 33）。 结构化文本和元素列表可能会使绝对任务成功率相对仅用像素的计算机操作有所提升，而无状态的逐步处理方式则可能使成功率相对于具有持久对话记忆的智能体有所下降；因此我们避免对该测试框架整体上作出更易或更难的排序。 我们的结果是在所述假设下（§ 7.2）同一接口内的固定实例干预对比，而非可直接比较的排行榜分数：由于 EnvOS 估计的是在单一固定接口下匹配的干预对比，而非绝对的计算机操作能力，因此不需要跨基准分数的可比性；接口迁移仍是一个外部效度问题。

paragraphs.en: Stripped of the testbed, an EnvOS intervention is a tuple ( v , E , τ , c , V , I , R ) (v,E,\tau,c,V,I,R) : an authoritative variable v v on which the correct action depends; an exposure predicate E E over the archived request and frame record (the old value of v v was served in a frame delivered to the policy); a trigger τ \tau that applies the transition of v v inside the first eligible request after E E holds, in one transaction with its event record; a matched inapplicable control c c that fires the same trigger on a variable irrelevant to the correct action; a validity table V V mapping each attempt’s archived evidence to counted or not counted before its outcome is scored; invariants I I evaluated on authoritative state at commit time and on the agent’s report; and an interpretation map R R from registered test outcomes to pre-written sentences, frozen with V V and I I before rollout. The checks of Section 6.4 test these components: certification tests τ \tau and c c with scripted policies; mutation batteries and the archive challenges test V V and I I ; the independent scorer and validity re-derivation re-implement I I and V V ; and the claim ledger executes R R . Nothing in the tuple names the semantic-browser interface. What depends on it is how E E is evidenced (here, request logs and delivered text frames; in a screenshot-only harness, the frame that rendered the value), and portability to another harness is untested (Section 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 剥离测试平台后，EnvOS 干预是一个元组 ( v , E , τ , c , V , I , R ) (v,E,\tau,c,V,I,R)：一个权威变量 v v，正确动作依赖于它；一个作用于归档请求与帧记录的暴露谓词 E E（v v 的旧值在一个被投递给策略的帧中被呈现过）；一个触发器 τ \tau，在 E E 成立后的第一个符合条件的请求中，于单个事务内连同其事件记录一起应用 v v 的状态转换；一个不适用但相匹配的对照 c c，在一个与正确动作无关的变量上触发相同的触发器；一个有效性表 V V，在每次尝试的结果被评分之前，把该尝试的归档证据映射为计入或不计入；不变式 I I，在提交时于权威状态上以及智能体的报告上进行求值；以及一个解释映射 R R，从已登记的测试结果映射到预先写好的句子，并在上线前与 V V 和 I I 一起冻结。 第 6.4 节的检查测试这些组件：认证测试使用脚本化策略测试 τ \tau 和 c c；变异测试组与归档挑战测试 V V 和 I I；独立评分器与有效性重新推导重新实现 I I 和 V V；以及声明账本执行 R R。 该元组中没有任何内容提及语义浏览器界面。 依赖于它的是 E E 如何被证实（此处为请求日志与已投递的文本帧；在仅使用截图的测试平台中，则是渲染出该值的那个帧），而到其他测试平台的可移植性尚未经过测试（第 11 节）。

paragraphs.en: The tuple assumes a discrete transition. For state that changes asynchronously or continuously (a price feed, a queue position), the same structure applies when the environment versions v v : E E becomes “version k k was served”, τ \tau publishes version k + 1 k{+}1 on the first eligible request after that, and I I scores the commit against the version current at commit time, so that a commit acting on version k k is distinguishable from one acting on a later version. A continuously drifting quantity additionally needs a decision-relevant threshold crossing (as the claims task’s threshold-crossing instances use) or a stated tolerance, so that the correct action changes discretely. Without versioned authoritative state neither the exposure certificate nor the commit-time scorer can be built, and the protocol does not apply. We have not implemented this extension.
paragraphs.zh: 该元组假设状态转移是离散的。 对于异步或连续变化的状态（如价格数据流、队列位置），当环境对 v v 进行版本化时，同样的结构仍然适用：E E 变为「版本 k k 已发布」，τ \tau 在此之后第一个符合条件的请求上发布版本 k + 1 k{+}1，而 I I 在评分提交时以其提交时刻的当前版本为基准，从而使作用于版本 k k 的提交与作用于更晚版本的提交可以区分开来。 连续漂移的量还需要一个与决策相关的阈值越过（如索赔任务的阈值越过实例所用的方式）或一个明确声明的容差，以使正确动作发生离散变化。 若没有版本化的权威状态，既无法构建暴露证书，也无法构建提交时评分器，该协议便不适用。 我们尚未实现这一扩展。

paragraphs.en: One salted digest of (seed, split) draws every element of an instance: the patient, the distractor appointment, the session date and the control session two days later, the appointment number, the intake mail and calendar entry, and the ordered (old, new) clinic pair from a pool of four names. The pair is assigned by a Latin-square rule, so each of the twelve ordered pairs occurs once in twelve consecutive seeds and the dropdown position of the old and the new clinic is counterbalanced across the block. The neutral work — a distractor record to read, a mailbox lookup and a calendar check — is drawn from (seed, split) alone, so it is identical for every level of an instance by construction. The certificate check filler_facts_identical_across_arms_and_clinic_neutral scans the intake message and the calendar entry for any clinic name and the frozen cue tokens, on the module’s own instance ( S-train-0 , in all 10 certificate files); regenerating the 18 evaluated instances, 0 name a clinic. The check does not cover the distractor appointment: that record carries a clinic from the same pool, on 6 of the 18 instances the new one (23 counted rows), which is how the report-flag rule came to read the distractor’s location as a flag (ADDENDUM 17; Table 39 ). Five salted splits (train, development, held-out test, compositional, sealed) partition the seed space. Three uses of a test instance are distinct here. Generation : every instance is generated from a held-out test seed. First-model evaluation : a family’s first model runs instances no model had run (Block A2: seeds 8–15; Block B: seeds 20–29; Block BC: seeds 42–49, 51–55, 57–59). Later-model replication : Blocks A2S, BS and BF re-use those instances (A2S a subset of A2’s, BS all of B’s, BF 4 of B’s), so their instances are known to the experimenter, not fresh. A seed whose treatment outcome has become known is burnt for any new first-model block.
paragraphs.zh: 一份基于 (seed, split) 加盐的摘要生成实例的每个元素：患者、干扰预约、会话日期及两天后的对照会话、预约编号、收诊邮件与日历条目，以及从四个名称池中按序抽取的（旧、新）诊所对。 该诊所对按拉丁方规则分配，因此在十二个连续种子中十二个有序对各出现一次，且旧诊所与新诊所在下拉列表中的位置在整个区块内得到平衡。 中性工作——阅读一条干扰记录、一次邮箱查询和一次日历检查——仅由 (seed, split) 决定，因此在构造上对实例的每个层级都是相同的。 certificate check filler_facts_identical_across_arms_and_clinic_neutral 在模块自身的实例上（ S-train-0 ，全部 10 个证书文件中）扫描收诊消息和日历条目中任何诊所名称及冻结的线索词元；重新生成 18 个被评估的实例，0 个提及诊所名称。 该检查不覆盖干扰预约：该记录带有来自同一池的诊所，18 个实例中有 6 个是新诊所（23 个被统计的行），这正是报告标记规则将干扰项的位置视为标记的原因（ADDENDUM 17；Table 39 ）。 五个加盐切分（训练、开发、留出测试、组合、密封）划分种子空间。 测试实例的三种用途在此处是不同的。 生成：每个实例都从留出测试种子生成。 首模型评估：一个家族的首个模型运行此前没有任何模型运行过的实例（Block A2：种子 8–15；Block B：种子 20–29；Block BC：种子 42–49、51–55、57–59）。 后续模型复现：Blocks A2S、BS 和 BF 复用这些实例（A2S 为 A2 的子集，BS 为 B 的全部，BF 为 B 中的 4 个），因此其实例已为实验者所知，并非全新。 处理结果已变得可知的种子，对任何新的首模型区块而言即被作废。

sents.en: One salted digest of (seed, split) draws every element of an instance: the patient, the distractor appointment, the session date and the control session two days later, the appointment number, the intake mail and calendar entry, and the ordered (old, new) clinic pair from a pool of four names.
sents.zh: 一份基于 (seed, split) 加盐的摘要生成实例的每个元素：患者、干扰预约、会话日期及两天后的对照会话、预约编号、收诊邮件与日历条目，以及从四个名称池中按序抽取的（旧、新）诊所对。

sents.en: The pair is assigned by a Latin-square rule, so each of the twelve ordered pairs occurs once in twelve consecutive seeds and the dropdown position of the old and the new clinic is counterbalanced across the block.
sents.zh: 该诊所对按拉丁方规则分配，因此在十二个连续种子中十二个有序对各出现一次，且旧诊所与新诊所在下拉列表中的位置在整个区块内得到平衡。

sents.en: The neutral work — a distractor record to read, a mailbox lookup and a calendar check — is drawn from (seed, split) alone, so it is identical for every level of an instance by construction.
sents.zh: 中性工作——阅读一条干扰记录、一次邮箱查询和一次日历检查——仅由 (seed, split) 决定，因此在构造上对实例的每个层级都是相同的。

sents.en: The certificate check filler_facts_identical_across_arms_and_clinic_neutral scans the intake message and the calendar entry for any clinic name and the frozen cue tokens, on the module’s own instance ( S-train-0 , in all 10 certificate files); regenerating the 18 evaluated instances, 0 name a clinic.
sents.zh: certificate check filler_facts_identical_across_arms_and_clinic_neutral 在模块自身的实例上（ S-train-0 ，全部 10 个证书文件中）扫描收诊消息和日历条目中任何诊所名称及冻结的线索词元；重新生成 18 个被评估的实例，0 个提及诊所名称。

sents.en: The check does not cover the distractor appointment: that record carries a clinic from the same pool, on 6 of the 18 instances the new one (23 counted rows), which is how the report-flag rule came to read the distractor’s location as a flag (ADDENDUM 17; Table 39 ).
sents.zh: 该检查不覆盖干扰预约：该记录带有来自同一池的诊所，18 个实例中有 6 个是新诊所（23 个被统计的行），这正是报告标记规则将干扰项的位置视为标记的原因（ADDENDUM 17；Table 39 ）。

sents.en: Five salted splits (train, development, held-out test, compositional, sealed) partition the seed space.
sents.zh: 五个加盐切分（训练、开发、留出测试、组合、密封）划分种子空间。

sents.en: Three uses of a test instance are distinct here.
sents.zh: 测试实例的三种用途在此处是不同的。

sents.en: Generation : every instance is generated from a held-out test seed.
sents.zh: 生成：每个实例都从留出测试种子生成。

sents.en: First-model evaluation : a family’s first model runs instances no model had run (Block A2: seeds 8–15; Block B: seeds 20–29; Block BC: seeds 42–49, 51–55, 57–59).
sents.zh: 首模型评估：一个家族的首个模型运行此前没有任何模型运行过的实例（Block A2：种子 8–15；Block B：种子 20–29；Block BC：种子 42–49、51–55、57–59）。

sents.en: Later-model replication : Blocks A2S, BS and BF re-use those instances (A2S a subset of A2’s, BS all of B’s, BF 4 of B’s), so their instances are known to the experimenter, not fresh.
sents.zh: 后续模型复现：Blocks A2S、BS 和 BF 复用这些实例（A2S 为 A2 的子集，BS 为 B 的全部，BF 为 B 中的 4 个），因此其实例已为实验者所知，并非全新。

sents.en: A seed whose treatment outcome has become known is burnt for any new first-model block.
sents.zh: 处理结果已变得可知的种子，对任何新的首模型区块而言即被作废。

paragraphs.en: This appendix states the harness-authored part of the agent–environment interface of the P3v2 experiments as the archived rollouts were run. It is not the whole interface: what was not archived (the CLI’s built-in system prompt and tool definitions, its decoding defaults, per-step element lists and page titles, the results of non- Read tool calls) is marked unavailable where it arises. It is derived from the source files whose sha256 the release manifest of each block pins, not from the current tree. Table 34 lists the pinned digests. Of the pinned files, 19 of 20 (block, file) pairs are available byte-for-byte. Each of the 82 rollouts in the five search logs records the digests of the code it ran. All match the block manifest except as follows: 4 rollouts of Block BS (1 of them counted) ran harness 2439d3a38953 , the version before that block’s manifest. They ran under the block’s first manifest ( 9aa433099a46 ), which the dated amendment applying ADDENDA 11 and 12 rebuilt as ead3fa67655a ; each row records the digests it ran, but no file with the first manifest’s digest survives. That version is also available and is listed below. The harness versions used ( 2439d3a38953 , b9f4fdb5b8e4 , fe4b9bb76d40 ) differ only in the read-target check and in delivery bookkeeping. Their prompt constants and the functions build_prompt , _history_line , with_agent_notes and _trim_note are AST-identical. The two browser versions differ only in the port configuration: observation, clipping and rendering are identical. The two task-module versions that are available differ only in the delivery-certification function (Addendum 16). The instruction, generator, step budget and history window are identical. † The task-module version used by Block A2 ( 17f6c7cd72f2 ) was not in the working tree when this specification was derived from the pinned sources (Block A2’s task module ( 17f6c7cd72f2 ), absent from the working tree, was recovered from a backup and verified by its digest, and ships in the supplement). For A2 the instruction text is taken from the archive instead (item 1). This specification was derived before that module was recovered, so for A2 it describes the module’s checkpoint and delivery-certification logic as it then stood only through the archived checkpoints, and does not restate its declared history window (item 4). Repository paths are written relative to /envos .
paragraphs.zh: 本附录陈述 P3v2 实验在归档的 rollout 运行时由 harness 编写的智能体—环境接口部分。 它并非完整接口：未被归档的内容（CLI 内置的系统提示词与工具定义、其解码默认值、每步的元素列表与页面标题、非 Read 工具调用的结果）在出现处均标注为不可用。 它由各块的发布清单所锁定 sha256 的源文件导出，而非来自当前的代码树。 表 34 列出了锁定的摘要。 在锁定的文件中，20 个（块，文件）对中有 19 个可逐字节获得。 五份搜索日志中的 82 个 rollout 各自记录了其所运行代码的摘要。 全部与块清单一致，例外如下：Block BS 的 4 个 rollout（其中 1 个已计数）运行了 harness 2439d3a38953，即该块清单之前的版本。 它们在该块的第一个清单（9aa433099a46）下运行；应用附录 11 和 12 的日期修订版将其重建为 ead3fa67655a；每一行都记录了其运行的摘要，但没有文件以第一个清单的摘要形式留存。 该版本同样可用，列于下文。 所使用的 harness 版本（2439d3a38953、b9f4fdb5b8e4、fe4b9bb76d40）仅在读取目标检查和投递记账方面有所不同。 它们的提示词常量以及函数 build_prompt、_history_line、with_agent_notes 和 _trim_note 在 AST 层面完全相同。 两个浏览器版本仅在端口配置上不同：观测、裁剪和渲染完全一致。 可获得的两个任务模块版本仅在投递认证函数上有所不同（附录 16）。 指令、生成器、步数预算和历史窗口完全一致。† Block A2 所使用的任务模块版本（17f6c7cd72f2）在本规范从锁定源导出时不在工作树中（Block A2 的任务模块（17f6c7cd72f2）原本缺失于工作树，后从备份中恢复并经其摘要验证，随附录补充资料一同发布）。 对于 A2，指令文本改为取自归档（第 1 项）。 本规范在该模块被恢复之前导出，因此对于 A2，它仅通过归档的检查点描述该模块当时的检查点与投递认证逻辑，且未重述其声明的历史窗口（第 4 项）。 仓库路径以相对于 /envos 的形式书写。

paragraphs.en: Each policy step is one fresh, stateless CLI process that receives the text below as its single user prompt. There is no --continue or --resume , so no conversation is carried from one step to the next. Placeholders are in angle brackets. The RESULT line of the action specification is the instance form built by result_form_for_task , and the memo paragraph is inserted by with_agent_notes because the task module declares AGENT_NOTES = True . The last sentence is appended by the invoker, and <FRAME PATH> is the step’s screenshot inside the per-episode observation directory ( /srv/envos-obs/<16 hex>/step_NN_before.png ). Non-ASCII characters are transliterated: the em dash becomes -- .
paragraphs.zh: 每个策略步骤都是一个全新的、无状态的 CLI 进程，它将下面的文本作为其唯一的用户提示接收。 没有 --continue 或 --resume，因此对话不会从一个步骤延续到下一个步骤。 占位符位于尖括号中。 动作规范中的 RESULT 行是由 result_form_for_task 构建的实例形式，而备忘段落由 with_agent_notes 插入，因为任务模块声明了 AGENT_NOTES = True。 最后一句由调用方附加，<FRAME PATH> 是每一回合观察目录（/srv/envos-obs/<16 hex>/step_NN_before.png）内该步骤的截图。 非 ASCII 字符会被音译：破折号（em dash）变为 --。

paragraphs.en: The <INSTRUCTION> is the instance’s instruction (Appendix Q ). It is archived verbatim in every trajectory. For 82 of the 82 archived model rollouts, including all of Block A2, it equals, byte for byte, the text that the generator generate_variant_params(seed, split) produces today. The CLI also prepends its own built-in system prompt and tool definitions. That text is not part of the harness and was not archived, so it is unavailable . The CLI version that supplied it is pinned (item 5).

paragraphs.en: This is the JSON object listed in the prompt above. The schema allows 7 action types, with an optional memo on any action. A reply is parsed by removing code fences and then taking the first brace-delimited substring (non-greedy \{.*?\} ). That substring must be a JSON object with a type key. A reply that does not parse ends the episode ( unparsed_reply ), and so does a done action. Element ids index the list shown on that same step, and the browser resolves them positionally. Across the 2548 archived model steps, the actions carried these keys outside the schema: none. The harness ignores extra keys, but they are echoed back in the history. Each action has a 15 s timeout. The episode is capped at 48 policy steps in every block.
paragraphs.zh: 这是上方提示词中列出的 JSON 对象。 该模式允许 7 种动作类型，任意动作都可附带可选的备忘。 回复的解析方式是先移除代码围栏，然后取第一个用花括号界定的子串（非贪婪的 \{.*?\} ）。 该子串必须是一个带有 type 键的 JSON 对象。 无法解析的回复会终止该回合（ unparsed_reply ），done 动作同样会终止回合。 元素 id 索引的是同一步骤中显示的列表，浏览器按位置解析它们。 在 2548 个已归档的模型步骤中，动作在模式之外携带的键有：无。 智能体框架会忽略多余的键，但它们会在历史记录中被原样回显。 每个动作有 15 秒的超时时间。 在每个区块中，回合的上限为 48 个策略步骤。

paragraphs.en: The memo is part of the action. After parsing, it is truncated to its first 300 characters. The full raw reply is archived untruncated. Nothing is scored from a memo. The history block lists the last 48 executed actions, one line each: step i: <json.dumps(action)> -> ok=<True|False|None> @ <last 46 characters of the URL after the action> . The history window (48) is not smaller than the step cap (48), so every earlier action and every earlier memo is echoed back at every step. The agent’s memory is therefore the full list of its own memos and actions, not only the latest memo. It carries no earlier page text or image. json.dumps escapes non-ASCII characters in the echo (e.g. \u2014 ). The done step is not echoed, because the episode ends there. Example: the first history line of the Opus FRX-ON-A instance-20 episode (285 characters):
paragraphs.zh: 备忘录是动作的一部分。 解析后，它会被截断为前 300 个字符。 完整的原始回复会被不加截断地归档。 任何内容都不会从备忘录中获得评分。 历史块列出最近 48 个已执行的动作，每个动作一行：step i: <json.dumps(action)> -> ok=<True|False|None> @ <动作执行后 URL 的最后 46 个字符> 。 历史窗口（48）不小于步数上限（48），因此每个更早的动作和每个更早的备忘录都会在每一步中被回显。 因此，智能体的记忆是其自身全部备忘录和动作的完整列表，而不仅是最近的备忘录。 它不携带任何更早的页面文本或图像。json.dumps 会在回显中转义非 ASCII 字符（例如 \u2014 ）。 done 步骤不会被回显，因为回合在那里结束。 示例：Opus FRX-ON-A instance-20 回合的第一行历史（285 个字符）：

paragraphs.en: Each call has a 300 s timeout. A failed call or a provider error is retried on the same prompt and frame after 20 s and again after 60 s. A provider usage limit is never retried: it ends the episode as infrastructure. Decoding, reasoning and output-length settings are not passed: the argument list sets no temperature, effort, thinking budget, maximum tokens, maximum turns or system-prompt flag, and no environment variable is set beyond those listed. They are therefore the CLI’s and the provider’s defaults for the model id. Those default values were not recorded and are unavailable . Token usage was not recorded for these calls (0 steps with usage). Within one call the model may call tools several times: claude-fable-5-1 made more than one call on 1 step and none on 0; claude-opus-5 made more than one call on 17 steps and none on 3; claude-sonnet-5 made more than one call on 912 steps and none on 237. Tool calls. The argument list auto-approves only Read and denies 25 tools by name. The model also emitted calls to other tool names: claude-fable-5-1 1 call on 1 step ( ReportFindings 1); claude-opus-5 6 calls on 6 steps ( ScheduleWakeup 5, ReportFindings 1); claude-sonnet-5 1591 calls on 801 steps ( ListAgents 812, ScheduleWakeup 315, ReportFindings 184, ExitWorktree 168, CronList 52, navigate 38, select 6, done 4, fill 4, click 3, Bash 2, Navigate 1, PushNotification 1, back 1). The invoker archives the name of every tool call, but a result (executed or refused) only for Read calls ( claude-fable-5-1 : 133 ok; claude-opus-5 : 1 error, 1155 ok; claude-sonnet-5 : 81 error, 3602 ok). Whether each of the non- Read calls was refused or executed is therefore unavailable from the archive. The isolation that bounds them is the operating-system account: it can read only the observation directory, and it has no repository, run-directory or docker access. CLI version. Every block’s manifest pins the binary’s sha256 15e2d05148f8 . The file on disk today has the same digest. Its name is claude-2.1.274 , and run offline it reports 2.1.274 (Claude Code) . Model identity. Requested ids: claude-fable-5-1 , claude-opus-5 , claude-sonnet-5 . The evidence of the served model is the model field of the CLI’s system/init stream event, recorded on every step. It equals the requested id on every step of every archived rollout: claude-fable-5-1 : 133 of 133 steps; claude-opus-5 : 1148 of 1148 steps; claude-sonnet-5 : 1267 of 1267 steps.
paragraphs.zh: 每次调用有 300 秒超时。 失败的调用或供应商错误会在 20 秒后对同一提示词与同一帧重试一次，60 秒后再重试一次。 供应商用量限额从不重试：它以 infrastructure 类别结束该回合。 解码、推理与输出长度设置均未传入：参数列表没有设置 temperature、effort、thinking budget、最大 token 数、最大轮数或 system-prompt 标志，除所列环境变量外也未设置任何其他环境变量。 因此这些设置即为该模型 id 下 CLI 与供应商的默认值。 这些默认值未被记录，因而不可获得。 这些调用未记录 token 用量（0 个步骤带用量信息）。 在一次调用中模型可能多次调用工具：claude-fable-5-1 在 1 个步骤上调用不止一次，在 0 个步骤上未调用；claude-opus-5 在 17 个步骤上调用不止一次，在 3 个步骤上未调用；claude-sonnet-5 在 912 个步骤上调用不止一次，在 237 个步骤上未调用。工具调用。 参数列表仅自动批准 Read 工具，并按名称拒绝了 25 个工具。 模型还发出了对其他工具名的调用：claude-fable-5-1 在 1 个步骤上 1 次调用（ReportFindings 1 次）；claude-opus-5 在 6 个步骤上 6 次调用（ScheduleWakeup 5 次，ReportFindings 1 次）；claude-sonnet-5 在 801 个步骤上 1591 次调用（ListAgents 812 次，ScheduleWakeup 315 次，ReportFindings 184 次，ExitWorktree 168 次，CronList 52 次，navigate 38 次，select 6 次，done 4 次，fill 4 次，click 3 次，Bash 2 次，Navigate 1 次，PushNotification 1 次，back 1 次）。 调用方会归档每次工具调用的名称，但只有 Read 调用会归档结果（无论执行还是被拒）（claude-fable-5-1：133 次成功；claude-opus-5：1 次错误，1155 次成功；claude-sonnet-5：81 次错误，3602 次成功）。 因此，各非 Read 调用是被拒绝还是被执行，无法从归档中获知。 约束它们的隔离机制是操作系统账户：它只能读取观测目录，没有仓库、运行目录或 docker 访问权限。CLI 版本。 每个区块的清单固定了二进制文件的 sha256 为 15e2d05148f8。 磁盘上现存的文件具有相同的摘要。 其名称为 claude-2.1.274，离线运行时报告 2.1.274 (Claude Code)。模型身份。 请求的 id 为：claude-fable-5-1、claude-opus-5、claude-sonnet-5。 所服务模型的证据是 CLI 的 system/init 流事件中的 model 字段，每个步骤都有记录。 在每条归档 rollout 的每个步骤上，该字段都等于请求的 id：claude-fable-5-1：133/133 个步骤；claude-opus-5：1148/1148 个步骤；claude-sonnet-5：1267/1267 个步骤。

paragraphs.en: Every block in this section ran under a predecessor version of the protocol (success-first counting, an unenforced review-information delivery rule; Appendix B ); none is pooled with the prospective blocks, and the paper’s causal conclusions do not rest on them.
paragraphs.zh: 本节中的每个区块均在该协议的前一版本下运行（以成功优先的计数方式、一条未强制执行的评审信息传递规则；见附录 B）；它们均未与前瞻性区块合并，且本文的因果结论并不依赖于它们。

paragraphs.en: Historical Block B motivated the prospective experiments but is not treated as confirmatory evidence under the finalized protocol. Its evaluator recorded a 10/10 paired change in booked-clinic correctness between no additional information and value-review-time information conditions, and archive re-scoring independently verifies the booked-clinic term on all ten pairs; however, the block did not satisfy one preserved pre-registered claim condition, so we report the contrast as hypothesis-generating historical evidence rather than as a confirmatory rescue claim. Its successes are evaluator passes whose booked clinic is independently verified; none is verified on the full endpoint, because the historical archives do not hold the slot occupancy the nearest-slot term needs (0 of 10; Appendix C.1 ). The claim condition, the post-outcome sentence that read the contrast from the primary test alone, and the alternative explanations the block cannot separate—among them cueing a re-check versus delivering the value, the question Block BC was built for—are in the supplementary provenance file (Appendix U ). Descriptively, no OFF-A run of the silent blocks requested the sessions page after the change (0/24), although a legal scripted policy that does so solves 10 of 10 OFF-A instances.
paragraphs.zh: 历史区块 B 促成了前瞻性实验，但在最终确定的方案中不作为确证性证据。 其评估者记录到，在“无附加信息”与“价值审查时间信息”两种条件之间，预约门诊正确性的配对变化为 10/10，且档案重新评分独立核实了全部十对中的预约门诊术语；然而，该区块未满足一项保留的预注册声明条件，因此我们将该对比作为生成假设的历史证据报告，而非作为确证性的挽救声明。 其成功案例是评估者通过且预约门诊经过独立核实的案例；无一在完整终点上得到核实，因为历史档案不包含最近时段术语所需的时段占用信息（0/10；附录 C.1）。 声明条件、仅从主要检验读取对比的事后表述，以及该区块无法区分的替代解释——其中包括提示复核与交付价值之间的区别，这正是区块 BC 所要解决的问题——均记录在补充来源文件中（附录 U）。 描述性地看，在变更之后，静默区块中没有 OFF-A 运行请求会话页面（0/24），尽管一个执行此操作的合法脚本化策略可以解决 10 个 OFF-A 实例中的 10 个。

paragraphs.en: This section documents the earlier exploratory corpus. Its records explain how the protocol developed; they do not support quantitative model-effect claims in this paper.

sents.en: This section documents the earlier exploratory corpus.

sents.en: Its records explain how the protocol developed; they do not support quantitative model-effect claims in this paper.
sents.zh: 其记录说明了该协议是如何发展形成的；它们不支持本文中的定量模型效果主张。

paragraphs.en: The corpus was produced on a separately built stack with its own harness, and is reported in Appendix T as the source of the organising hypothesis, never as a model-level claim. Its structure, re-derived by the claim ledger from the corpus’s per-arm and per-rollout files ( audit/failure_mining/STACKB/ , where the corpus’s own ledger script agrees on every count): 32 arms across three environments (a clinic, a hotel and a travel desk), of which 27 are hand-written phenomena — among them a selected resource taken between selection and commit, a write silently altered after the commit, a fact revised with no notification, an entity merged under a new name, a policy reissued off the agent’s path and an acknowledgement lost — and 5 are controls (clean baselines and cosmetic changes). Claude Opus 5 ran all 32 arms, 93 rollouts in all, from 1 to 7 per arm (24 arms at three); Claude Sonnet 5 ran 23 arms, 22 of them also run on Opus 5, so the two models together cover 33 arms.

paragraphs.en: Four properties keep it exploratory, and each is a reason no rate from it is reported. (i) No arm carries a certificate in the sense of Section 6.4 : the stack’s own test suites do not establish that the change fired once, inside the agent’s own request, after the fact it supersedes was served. (ii) Its triggers are hand-coded: heuristics on the agent’s own actions (a page load followed by a delay, a view or reservation of the target, a submit) or, in the travel desk’s cold-start arm, the episode’s start, never certified against the value the agent was served, so an episode in which the agent never saw the superseded value is indistinguishable, from the outcome alone, from one in which it did — the ambiguity the exposure-conditioned trigger of § 6.3 removes. (iii) Several cells hit a turn cap, and capped episodes were handled inconsistently (counted as failures in some cells, voided and re-run in another), so a denominator does not uniformly separate “acted on a stale belief” from “ran out of turns”. (iv) The corpus’s verifier was corrected during its own life, and its versions are not recorded: every archived Opus 5 run record carries a re-score field (93 of 93), of which 2 record a stored failure re-scored as a pass, and a later fix to the hotel task’s verifier turned some Sonnet 5 failures on that task into passes and is reported by the corpus’s own document, not re-derived here, to leave that task’s archived Opus 5 rollouts unchanged. Per-arm pass counts are therefore left to the corpus’s own document; the ledger re-derives only the structure above, from files whose digests it pins.
paragraphs.zh: 四个特性使它保持探索性质，每一条都是从它无法报告任何率值的原因。 (i) 没有任何臂在第 6.4 节意义上带有证明：该栈自身的测试套件并未确立这一变更在智能体自己的请求内部、在被其取代的事实已被服务之后恰好触发了一次。 (ii) 它的触发条件是手工编写的：基于智能体自身动作的启发式规则（页面加载后接延迟、目标被查看或预订、一次提交），或者在差旅台的冷启动臂中，回合的开始，从未对照智能体被服务的值加以证明，因此智能体从未见过被取代值的回合，仅从结果上无法与见过该值的回合区分——这正是第 6.3 节的曝光条件触发所消除的歧义。 (iii) 若干单元达到了回合上限，且被封顶的回合处理方式不一致（在某些单元中被计为失败，在另一单元中被作废并重跑），因此分母并不能始终如一地区分「基于过时信念采取了行动」与「用尽了回合」。 (iv) 该语料库的验证器在其自身的存续期间被修正过，且其版本未被记录：每条存档的 Opus 5 运行记录都带有一个重新评分字段（93 条中 93 条），其中 2 条记录了原本存储为失败、重新评分后变为通过的情况，而后来对酒店任务验证器的一次修复将 Sonnet 5 在该任务上的部分失败转为了通过，这一点由语料库自身的文档（而非在此重新推导）报告，并称该任务存档的 Opus 5 rollout 未受影响。 各臂的通过计数因此留给语料库自身的文档；账本只根据其固定了摘要的文件重新推导上述结构。

paragraphs.en: The defects include a restarted block in which 3 of 12 episodes never triggered the change, a provider session-limit reply scored as a model decision, and a classifier that would have voided 25 model failures of the historical silent blocks; some showed only in model evidence, which no scripted policy produces.
paragraphs.zh: 缺陷包括：一个重启的块，其中12个回合中有3个从未触发更改；一个被判定为模型决策的提供商会话限制回复；以及一个本会撤销历史静默块中25次模型失败的分类器；其中一些仅出现在模型证据中，而任何脚本化策略都不会产生这种情况。

paragraphs.en: The defects divide by what caught them: design-time gates, validity rules on a block’s first rows, and archived model evidence alone, because no scripted policy produces them (an unauthenticated first request, a dismissal from the sessions page, a report naming the distractor’s clinic, and a review information read as text alone). No fix was validated by re-running a model: classification, the checkpoints and the signature are pure functions of the archive, so every corrected row was re-derived from it with the previous value kept beside the new.
paragraphs.zh: 这些缺陷按捕获它们的机制划分：设计时关卡、针对区块首行数据的有效性规则，以及仅凭归档的模型证据，因为没有脚本化策略会产生它们（一个未认证的首个请求、来自会话页面的一次驳回、一份指名干扰项诊所的报告，以及仅以文本形式读取的审查信息）。 没有任何修复是通过重新运行模型来验证的：分类、检查点和签名都是归档的纯函数，因此每个被纠正的行都是从归档重新推导出来的，并将先前的值保留在新值旁边。

paragraphs.en: Section 10 positions this work against four lines; this appendix says what each shares with EnvOS and where it stops.
paragraphs.zh: 第 10 节将本工作与四条研究脉络进行对比；本附录说明每条脉络与 EnvOS 的共同之处以及它们的局限所在。

paragraphs.en: OSWorld 2.0 ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) is the closest in ambition: 31 services, long-horizon workflows, mid-task messages and a simulated user, and it reports the symptom this paper studies. Gaia2 ( Froger et al., 2026 ) , built in the ARE platform ( Froger et al., 2025 ) , lets asynchronous events change state while time flows, and pairs each scenario with a write-action verifier — the closest existing work to our invariant scoring. Real-Time Reasoning Gym ( Wen et al., 2026 ) keeps the environment evolving while the agent is still reasoning and trades reasoning depth against latency; our change is one discrete intervention rather than continuous evolution of the environment. In τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench ( Barres et al., 2025 ) a simulated user changes shared state through its own tools as part of a cooperative task, and InterruptBench ( Zou et al., 2026 ) injects announced revisions of the user’s goal into long-horizon WebArena-Lite tasks; our changes alter world state rather than the goal, and include silent arms with no message at all. DynamicGUIBench ( Liu et al., 2026 ) changes interfaces between actions and answers with a video-input agent; AgentHijack ( Sun et al., 2026 ) corrupts perception and control. StressWeb ( Bai et al., 2026 ) compares perturbed with clean runs of the same tasks and finds agents that confidently report success on tasks they failed — the signature our silent arms also show — but its perturbations act on layout, interaction semantics and execution, not on authoritative backend state. STT-Arena ( Hui et al., 2026 ) is the closest design: a trigger fires when a condition on state and spatio-temporal context holds, applies an effect that can invalidate the agent’s plan, and, for solvable tasks, is scored by rule-based checks on the final state; the benchmark is compared with non-dynamic environments in aggregate, and it names stale-state execution as a dominant failure mode. Its environments are Python tool APIs rather than a browser, its trigger conditions are defined on state and context rather than on what the agent has observed, and we found no per-instance paired test in it. Our design combines a change fired only after the agent has been served the value it supersedes, with that exposure certified from archives; inapplicable controls sharing the changed arm’s trigger (and, for an announced change, its notice); and a matched re-exposure test. Mitigation has also been studied: Li et al.
paragraphs.zh: OSWorld 2.0（Yuan et al., 2026）在目标上最为接近：包含 31 个服务、长时程工作流、任务中途消息和一个模拟用户，并且它报告了本文所研究的症状。 Gaia2（Froger et al., 2026）构建于 ARE 平台（Froger et al., 2025）之上，允许异步事件在时间流逝时改变状态，并为每个场景配有一个写操作验证器——这是与我们不变量评分最接近的现有工作。 Real-Time Reasoning Gym（Wen et al., 2026）让环境在智能体仍在推理时持续演化，并以推理深度换取延迟；而我们的改变是一次离散干预，而非环境的连续演化。 在 τ²-bench（Barres et al., 2025）中，模拟用户在协作任务中通过其自身的工具改变共享状态，而 InterruptBench（Zou et al., 2026）则在长时程的 WebArena-Lite 任务中注入事先通告的用户目标修订；我们的改变改变的是世界状态而非目标，并且包括完全不带任何消息的静默变更。 DynamicGUIBench（Liu et al., 2026）在动作之间改变界面，并使用视频输入的智能体作答；AgentHijack（Sun et al., 2026）则破坏感知与控制。 StressWeb（Bai et al., 2026）将同一任务的受扰动运行与干净运行进行比较，发现智能体会自信地报告其失败任务的成功——这正是我们的静默变更所呈现的特征——但其扰动作用于布局、交互语义和执行，而非权威的后端状态。 STT-Arena（Hui et al., 2026）是与我们最接近的设计：当关于状态和时空上下文的条件成立时触发一个触发器，施加一个可能使智能体计划失效的效果，并且对于可解任务，通过对最终状态的基于规则的检查来评分；该基准在总体上与非动态环境进行比较，并且它将过期状态执行列为主导的失败模式。 其环境是 Python 工具 API 而非浏览器，其触发条件定义在状态和上下文上而非智能体已观察到的内容上，而且我们在其中未发现逐实例的配对测试。 我们的设计将仅在智能体已被提供其将取代的值之后才触发的变更，与通过存档认证的该暴露相结合；同时使用与被变更组共享触发器（对于已通告的变更，还包括其通知）的不可适用对照；以及一个匹配的再暴露测试。 缓解措施也已被研究过：Li et al.

sents.zh: StressWeb（Bai et al., 2026）将同一任务的受扰动运行与干净运行进行比较，发现智能体会自信地报告其失败任务的成功——这正是我们的静默变更所呈现的特征——但其扰动作用于布局、交互语义和执行，而非权威的后端状态。

sents.en: STT-Arena ( Hui et al., 2026 ) is the closest design: a trigger fires when a condition on state and spatio-temporal context holds, applies an effect that can invalidate the agent’s plan, and, for solvable tasks, is scored by rule-based checks on the final state; the benchmark is compared with non-dynamic environments in aggregate, and it names stale-state execution as a dominant failure mode.
sents.zh: STT-Arena（Hui et al., 2026）是与我们最接近的设计：当关于状态和时空上下文的条件成立时触发一个触发器，施加一个可能使智能体计划失效的效果，并且对于可解任务，通过对最终状态的基于规则的检查来评分；该基准在总体上与非动态环境进行比较，并且它将过期状态执行列为主导的失败模式。

sents.en: Its environments are Python tool APIs rather than a browser, its trigger conditions are defined on state and context rather than on what the agent has observed, and we found no per-instance paired test in it.
sents.zh: 其环境是 Python 工具 API 而非浏览器，其触发条件定义在状态和上下文上而非智能体已观察到的内容上，而且我们在其中未发现逐实例的配对测试。

sents.en: Our design combines a change fired only after the agent has been served the value it supersedes, with that exposure certified from archives; inapplicable controls sharing the changed arm’s trigger (and, for an announced change, its notice); and a matched re-exposure test.
sents.zh: 我们的设计将仅在智能体已被提供其将取代的值之后才触发的变更，与通过存档认证的该暴露相结合；同时使用与被变更组共享触发器（对于已通告的变更，还包括其通知）的不可适用对照；以及一个匹配的再暴露测试。

sents.en: Mitigation has also been studied: Li et al.
sents.zh: 缓解措施也已被研究过：Li et al.

paragraphs.en: (2026) , discussed below, test observation-interface changes at benchmark scale. These benchmarks answer “do agents fail when the world moves”; the design here asks, under one particular change fired after one particular observation, whether one interface element—the review-time information—removes the failure. The change itself is present in both arms, so its own causal effect is not estimated (in the historical blocks FRX-OFF-I was certified but never run on a model; Block BGC adds it). The two are complementary: breadth of setting against control of one mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: （2026），下文将讨论，在基准测试规模上检验观察接口的变化。 这些基准回答的是“当世界发生变化时智能体是否会失败”；而此处的设计则是问，在某一特定变化于某一特定观察之后触发时，某个接口要素——即评审时的信息——是否能消除该失败。 该变化本身在两个组中都存在，因此其自身的因果效应并未被估计（在历史区块中 FRX-OFF-I 曾通过认证但从未在模型上运行；区块 BGC 加入了它）。 二者互为补充：一个是设置上的广度，一个是对单一机制的控制。

paragraphs.en: Reading a value and committing after it has been superseded is the classic time-of-check-to-time-of-use race. Lilienthal et al. (2025) study it in LLM agents as a security vulnerability (TOCTOU-Bench, 66 tasks) and propose defences such as state-integrity monitoring; we measure it as a behavioural failure under a benign change fired inside the agent’s own check-use window. Knowledge-conflict studies ( Xie et al., 2024 ) show that LLMs can adopt coherent contradicting evidence yet show confirmation bias toward what they already believe, in static question answering. STALE ( Chao et al., 2026 ) asks whether a model notices that a stored memory has been invalidated, in question answering, without actions or a world to act on. Our silent arms are the acting counterpart of both: the belief is formed by reading a page, the invalidation is a real row changing, and the cost is a durable write. EnvProbe ( Song et al., 2026 ) approaches the same problem from the policy side, deciding when an agent should re-query a belief; our re-exposure arm is the environment-side counterpart. In the historical, hypothesis-generating clinic Block B (predecessor protocol; Appendix T ), putting the current value on Opus 5’s path immediately before the commit coincided with a 10/10 paired change in evaluator-recorded booked-clinic correctness, consistent with the interface carrying a burden the policy was not carrying; those successes are not verified on the full endpoint and are not confirmatory. The prospective claims blocks do not show this for Opus 5, which succeeded on 10/10 silent-change instances without the panel; there the panel contrast is Sonnet 5’s (1/10 without, 9/10 with), for this task and interface. Li et al. (2026) reach a compatible conclusion at benchmark scale: richer between-step observation (keyframes, audio transcription, narration) gains 17 to 48 points on 100 dynamic browser tasks, with a 50-task static control. Our re-exposure arm is narrower and pre-registered: one element, the current value on the agent’s path immediately before the commit, tested on matched instances with an exact paired test.
paragraphs.zh: 读取一个值并在其已被取代之后才提交，是典型的检查时-使用时（TOCTOU）竞态。Lilienthal 等人 （2025）在 LLM 智能体中将其作为一种安全漏洞进行了研究（TOCTOU-Bench，共 66 个任务），并提出了状态完整性监控等防御措施；我们则将其测量为一种行为失败，触发条件是在智能体自身的检查-使用窗口内发生的一次良性变更。 知识冲突研究（Xie 等人，2024）表明，在静态问答中，LLM 能够采纳相互矛盾但连贯一致的证据，同时却对它们已经相信的内容表现出确认偏误。 STALE（Chao 等人，2026）探讨的问题是，在问答场景中、没有动作也没有可作用的世界的情况下，模型是否能察觉某条已存储的记忆已被失效。 我们的静默组是二者的行动对应物：信念来自读取一个页面，失效是一行真实数据的变更，而代价是一次持久化的写入。 EnvProbe（Song 等人，2026）从策略侧处理同一问题，决定智能体何时应重新查询某条信念；我们的再暴露组是其在环境侧的对应物。 在生成假设的历史门诊组 Block B（前序协议；附录 T）中，在提交之前紧邻地、将当前值置于 Opus 5 的路径上，与评估者记录的已预约门诊正确性出现 10/10 的配对改变相吻合，这与该接口承担了策略并未承担的负担相一致；这些成功未在全量端点上得到验证，也不具确证性。 前瞻性声明组并未在 Opus 5 上显示出这一点，它在没有评审组的情况下于 10/10 的静默变更实例上成功；在该任务与该接口下，评审组的对照对象是 Sonnet 5（无评审组为 1/10，有评审组为 9/10）。Li 等人 （2026）在基准规模上得出了相容的结论：更丰富的步骤间观测（关键帧、音频转录、旁白）在 100 个动态浏览器任务上带来 17 到 48 点的提升，并设有 50 个任务的静态对照。 我们的再暴露组更窄且经过预注册：仅一个元素，即在提交之前紧邻地置于智能体路径上的当前值，在匹配实例上以精确的配对检验进行测试。

paragraphs.en: TheAgentCompany ( Xu et al., 2025 ) self-hosts a reproducible workplace of services with simulated colleagues and checkpoint-based partial credit; our testbed is a workplace of self-hosted services in the same style. OpenComputer ( Wei et al., 2026 ) builds verifiable software worlds with state verifiers and shows hard-coded verifiers agree with human adjudication better than a model judge, an empirical validation of outcome verifiers on static tasks. ABC ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) turns task-setup and reward-design flaws found in existing agentic benchmarks into a checklist and shows such flaws can shift measured performance by up to 100% relative; our defect taxonomy is evidence of the same kind for one dynamic protocol, with protocol-specific checks for trigger timing relative to exposure and delivery of the evidence. Kirgis et al. (2026) argue that outcome-only agent evaluation is not credible and give a taxonomy of threats documented through execution-log analysis — the argument this paper partially executes, for the particular case of a dynamic intervention, where the verdict is not the only thing needing certification: the intervention, its timing relative to the agent’s own observations, and the delivery of the evidence all do. Related critiques ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Patel et al., 2026 ) question what a single leaderboard number means at all. Our defect taxonomy (§ 9 ) is the empirical form of that argument: 7 of 11 defects had already produced rows carrying model verdicts.
paragraphs.zh: TheAgentCompany（Xu et al., 2025）自托管了一个可复现的工作场所，其中包含模拟同事和基于检查点的部分得分；我们的测试平台是同样风格的自托管服务工作场所。 OpenComputer（Wei et al., 2026）构建了带有状态验证器的可验证软件世界，并表明硬编码验证器与人工裁决的一致性优于模型裁判，这是对静态任务上结果验证器的一次实证验证。 ABC（Zhu et al., 2025）将现有智能体基准中发现的任务设置与奖励设计缺陷整理成一份检查清单，并表明此类缺陷可使测得的性能相对偏移高达 100%；我们的缺陷分类学是同一类证据，但针对的是单一动态协议，并带有针对触发时机相对于暴露时刻以及证据交付的协议专用检查。Kirgis 等人 （2026）论证仅凭结果的智能体评估不可信，并通过执行日志分析给出一份威胁分类学——这正是本文部分践行的论证，针对的是动态干预这一特定情形，其中需要认证的不只是裁决本身：干预本身、其相对于智能体自身观察的时机、以及证据的交付都需要认证。 相关的批评（Zhu et al., 2026；Patel et al., 2026）质疑单个排行榜数字究竟意味着什么。 我们的缺陷分类学（§ 9）是该论证的实证形式：11 个缺陷中有 7 个已经产生了带有模型裁决的记录行。

paragraphs.en: The testbed follows the task and scoring conventions of the computer-use, web-agent and tool-use benchmarks ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) ; the exact paired test is McNemar’s ( McNemar, 1947 ) and the intervals are Wilson’s ( Wilson, 1927 ) . Neither statistical choice is novel here; what is pre-registered is which single contrast they are applied to.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试平台遵循计算机使用、网络智能体和工具使用基准的任务与评分规范（Xie et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2024；Trivedi et al., 2024；Yao et al., 2025）；所用的精确配对检验是 McNemar 检验（McNemar, 1947），置信区间采用 Wilson 区间（Wilson, 1927）。 这两种统计选择本身并不新颖；预先注册的是它们应用于哪一个单一对比。

paragraphs.en: Block A2: 29 pinned repository paths, 2 container image ids, λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 , reward version 2, protocol version 2, manifest sha256 b66756ff . Block B: 29 pinned paths. A manifest pins the sha256 of every path it names, as hashed at freeze time; the rollout driver recomputes every one before each episode and refuses to start on any difference, which is what “the implementation did not change during the block” means here. The manifests are distributed as files; their path-by-path digest tables are not typeset.
paragraphs.zh: 区块 A2：29 个固定仓库路径，2 个容器镜像 id，λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5，奖励版本 2，协议版本 2，清单 sha256 b66756ff。 区块 B：29 个固定路径。 清单对其列出的每个路径都固定了冻结时刻计算出的 sha256； rollout 驱动器在每次回合开始前都会重新计算每一个，任何差异都会拒绝启动，这就是本文中“实现在区块期间未发生改变”的含义。 清单以文件形式分发；其逐路径的摘要表不进行排版展示。

paragraphs.en: Every block the pre-registrations name and what became of it (table below): completed (A2, B, BS; A2S and BF as the screens ADDENDUM 13 downsized them to), void or superseded (Block A attempt 1; the Block A restart), never started (D; P1MS), cancelled before any rollout (BR, BRS, by the consult decision ADDENDUM 9 deferred to; no addendum recorded it, as ADDENDUM 9 required), failed admission (BG, whose leak audit did not pass; P2S/P2SS, whose re-certification was rejected with P2-C 8; P2-L0 9; P2-L1 18 failed checks), and started but unevaluable (P1M). No outcome of any block that ran is omitted from this paper. The clean-control stop rule makes a stop a “harness finding” by rule, not by diagnosis: a valid clean task can fail by chance and would stop a block the same way. For Block A attempt 1, the one block it stopped, the attribution to the harness rests on ADDENDUM 2’s separate diagnosis (the policy had no working memory), not on the stop. Counts are read from the search logs; the category is the authors’ reading of the cited artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 各预注册区块的名称及其结局（见下表）：已完成（A2、B、BS；A2S 和 BF 为增编 13 缩减后的形态）、作废或被取代（区块 A 第 1 次尝试；区块 A 重启）、从未启动（D；P1MS）、在任何发布前被取消（BR、BRS，因咨询决定而改援引增编 9；按增编 9 的要求，无增编记录此取消）、准入失败（BG，其泄漏审计未通过；P2S/P2SS，其再认证因 P2-C 8；P2-L0 9；P2-L1 的 18 项检查未通过而被拒绝）、以及已启动但无法评估（P1M）。 凡实际运行的区块，其任何结局在本文中均无遗漏。 干净对照停止规则以规则而非诊断的方式将停止定义为「测试框架发现」：一个有效的干净任务可能因偶然而失败，也会以同样的方式使一个区块停止。 区块 A 第 1 次尝试是被该规则停止的唯一区块，其归因于测试框架的依据是增编 2 的独立诊断（策略没有可用的记忆），而非停止本身。 计数取自检索日志；类别划分则是作者对所引文献材料的解读。

paragraphs.en: What it checks. Every macro this paper uses is an entry of the ledger ( claims.json , written by claims.py ) that records its value, the artifacts it is derived from with their sha256, the statistical unit and the aggregation; python claims.py --verify re-derives every entry, fails on any drift of a pinned artifact and on any macro used but not defined, and checks the abstract’s generated clauses, the main text’s guarded wording and the interpretation templates’ seal. What is pinned. Frozen artifacts are read in place against their digests (the claims blocks’ evidence bundle against its digest list, 063b7ae44e11 ); a live artifact (a search log its block was still writing; the scorer source) is read through a dated snapshot under paper/snapshots/ , taken by the build, whose digest is the one pinned; an entry read with no snapshot has its drift reported, not failed, and the verification fails if the manuscript uses it, directly or inside another macro (in this build, no macro the manuscript uses is read from a live entry). How to reproduce. ./build.sh snapshots the live artifacts, regenerates the ledger, every table and every figure, compiles the paper and runs the verification; ./build.sh --stress builds a temporary copy with synthetic worst-case prospective results and checks its page limit. What is missing. Evidence that was never archived, or was overwritten, cannot be re-derived by any build; the next paragraph lists it. The per-macro ledger table (value, source artifact, digest prefix) is distributed with claims.json rather than typeset.
paragraphs.zh: 它检查什么。 本文使用的每个宏都是台账（claims.json，由 claims.py 生成）中的一个条目，该台账记录其取值、其所来源的工件及其 sha256、统计单元与聚合方式；python claims.py --verify 会重新推导每个条目，在任何被固定的工件发生漂移时失败，在任何被使用但未定义的宏处失败，并检查摘要中生成的条款、正文中受保护的措辞以及解释模板的封印。固定了什么。 冻结的工件在原位依据其摘要被读取（claims 块的证据包依据其摘要列表 063b7ae44e11）；活动工件（一个其块仍在写入的搜索日志；评分器源代码）通过 paper/snapshots/ 下由构建生成的带日期快照读取，其摘要即被固定的那一个；一个在没有快照的情况下被读取的条目会报告其漂移而非失败，如果手稿（直接或在另一个宏内）使用了它，则验证失败（在本次构建中，手稿使用的任何宏都不是从活动条目读取的）。 如何复现。./build.sh 会对活动工件做快照、重新生成台账、每个表格和每个图形、编译论文并运行验证；./build.sh --stress 会构建一个带有合成最坏情形前瞻结果的临时副本并检查其页数限制。缺少什么。 从未被归档或已被覆盖的证据无法通过任何构建重新推导；下一段列出这些内容。 逐宏的台账表（取值、源工件、摘要前缀）随 claims.json 一起分发，而不是排版进文中。
