paragraphs.en: Records: the frozen pre-registrations, the release manifests and the ledger ( claims.json ) of the paper build the package was made from ship as files in the supplement. The packaged supplement holds 24399 files (94.6 MB zipped). In one offline run of this package (no network, world or model), the claims target passed all 85 of its checks, every recomputed count, test, interval, reading and audit count equal to this ledger’s entry, and the challenge target all 31, the re-run comparison’s output identical to the shipped result; the packaged ledger’s verification re-derived all 2319 of its entries. Its prospective target passed all 174 of its checks: Table 6 ’s cells and Figure 3 ’s per-instance grids for the claims blocks and Block BC, Block BC’s paired tests, Holm adjustments, Newcombe intervals and audit counts, recomputed from the raw run directories, equal this ledger’s entries; for Block BCS, which stopped unfinished at its registered cutoff and reports no test, its independent scorer and validity re-derivation were re-run and equal their records, and its attempts, counted cells and per-instance table were recomputed. All 9 historical archive re-analysis re-derivations reproduced; every generated table (61 files) re-renders byte for byte from the shipped records. Its complete inventory—what is packaged, what exists but is not packaged and why, and what was not yet produced—is a generated supplementary file ( supp_provenance/ , Appendix U ). Permanently missing (never archived, or overwritten; no package can supply them, and only new rollouts can replace what they would have shown): Block BS’s first manifest ( 9aa433099a46 ), known by digest only; the two code versions pinned by the archived pre-image Block A manifest (the harness e4e215d1 and the task module 1eeaab16 ); the first outputs of Block A2’s mutation battery and leak audit, overwritten later that day; the first transfer run’s output; the scorer digest of the certification audit; the CLI’s built-in system prompt, tool definitions, decoding and reasoning defaults and token usage; the results of non- Read tool calls, including whether Sonnet’s 1591 other calls executed; per-step page titles and element lists, so the observation a policy received cannot be reconstructed exactly; server-side model identity; and slot occupancy at booking time and calendar compatibility in the historical blocks, so no historical success can be verified in full.
paragraphs.zh: 记录：冻结的预注册、发布清单，以及论文构建该包所依据的台账（claims.json），均以文件形式随补充材料一并发布。 打包后的补充材料包含 24399 个文件（压缩后 94.6 MB）。 在对该包的一次离线运行中（无网络、无世界、无模型），claims 目标通过了其全部 85 项检查，每个重新计算的计数、测试、区间、读数与审计计数均等于本台账中的条目，challenge 目标通过了全部 31 项检查，且重跑对比的输出与所发布的结果完全一致；打包台账的验证重新推导了其全部 2319 个条目。 其前瞻性目标通过了全部 174 项检查：从原始运行目录重新计算得出的表 6 各单元格与图 3 针对claims 各区块及 Block BC 的逐实例网格、Block BC 的配对检验、Holm 校正、Newcombe 区间与审计计数，均与本台账中的条目一致；对于 Block BCS（它在注册的截止点停止且未完成、不报告检验），其独立评分器与有效性重新推导被重新运行并与其记录一致，其尝试次数、计数单元格与逐实例表也被重新计算。 全部 9 项历史档案再分析的重新推导均得到复现；每个生成的表格（61 个文件）都能从所发布的记录逐字节重新渲染。 其完整清单——打包了什么、存在但未打包的内容及其原因、以及尚未产出的内容——是一个生成的补充文件（supp_provenance/，附录 U）。 永久缺失的内容（从未归档或已被覆盖；任何包都无法提供它们，只有新的 rollout 才能替代它们本应展示的东西）：Block BS 的第一份清单（9aa433099a46），仅以摘要形式已知；由已归档的预镜像 Block A 清单固定的两个代码版本（harness e4e215d1 与任务模块 1eeaab16）；Block A2 变异测试组与泄露审计的首次输出，在当天稍后被覆盖；首次迁移运行的输出；认证审计的评分器摘要；CLI 内置的系统提示词、工具定义、解码与推理默认设置及 token 用量；非 Read 工具调用的结果，包括 Sonnet 的 1591 次其他调用是否执行；每步的页面标题与元素列表，因此策略所接收到的观测无法被完全精确地重建；服务端的模型身份；以及历史区块中的预订时段占用情况与日历兼容性，因此没有任何历史成功可以被完整验证。

paragraphs.en: Videos are rendered from the archived frames of real episodes — no episode is re-run to make one — and each manifest records the frame digests and the source trajectory. The pairs that show the paper’s result directly are blockB_s20 and blockB_s21 : the same instance under FRX-OFF-A and FRX-ON-A, where Claude Opus 5 commits the superseded clinic in the first and, in the second, goes back to change its selection after the review step re-renders the live row. blockBS_s22 is the counterpart in which Sonnet 5 is not rescued. blockA2_s8 and blockA2_s14 show the announced arm, the second being the block’s single failure.
paragraphs.zh: 视频由真实回合的存档帧渲染而成——制作视频不会重新运行回合——并且每个清单（manifest）都记录了帧摘要和源轨迹。 直接展示论文结果的对是 blockB_s20 和 blockB_s21：同一实例分别在 FRX-OFF-A 和 FRX-ON-A 下运行，前者中 Claude Opus 5 提交了已被取代的诊所，后者中它在评审步骤重新渲染当前行之后返回修改了自己的选择。blockBS_s22 是对应的对照案例，其中 Sonnet 5 未能被挽救。blockA2_s8 和 blockA2_s14 展示了所公告的分支（arm），其中第二个是该区块中唯一的失败案例。

paragraphs.en: EnvOS also has exploratory evaluations covering additional authoritative-state phenomena in clinic, hotel and travel environments. They use a Claude Opus 5 configuration with a separate shell/GUI execution interface and a variant-level rather than a matched-instance statistical design. Their role in this manuscript is to document the reach of the phenomenon–perturbation abstraction, the bounded four-layer certification suite, and trajectory-level diagnostic examples. They are not extra cells in the prospective clinic and insurance review-disclosure experiments: no count from this appendix enters Table 6 , the registered paired tests, the twelve-test sensitivity family or the main evaluator-challenge totals. Some of these exploratory results were originally reported in ( Gopal et al., 2026 ) ; they are retained here with their separate provenance, statistical limitations and observed defects rather than silently reinterpreted as prospective replications.
paragraphs.zh: EnvOS 还包含覆盖临床、酒店与旅行环境中更多权威状态现象的探索性评估。 他们使用 Claude Opus 5 配置，配备独立的 shell/GUI 执行接口，并采用变体层面而非匹配实例层面的统计设计。 它们在本文中的作用是记录现象—扰动抽象的适用范围、有界的四层认证套件，以及轨迹层面的诊断示例。 它们不属于前瞻性临床与保险审查披露实验中的额外单元格：本附录中的任何计数都不会进入表 6、预注册的配对检验、十二项检验的敏感性族或主评估者挑战总数。 其中一些探索性结果最初报告于 ( Gopal et al., 2026 )；本文保留它们时保留了其独立的来源、统计局限和观察到的缺陷，而不是悄悄地将其重新解释为前瞻性重复实验。

paragraphs.en: The framework defines a phenomenon as an application-independent class of real change to authoritative world state for reasons other than the agent’s intended action. It calls an environment-specific implementation a perturbation ρ = ( δ , τ , c , g ) \rho=(\delta,\tau,c,g) : a state operator δ : 𝒮 → 𝒮 \delta:\mathcal{S}\to\mathcal{S} , a trigger predicate τ \tau over action history, a channel c c through which the changed information may be observed, and a one-shot guard g g . The agent acts in a partially observed environment E = ( 𝒮 , 𝒜 , 𝒪 , T , Ω , s 0 ) E=(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{O},T,\Omega,s_{0}) and sees rendered observations Ω ⁡ ( s ) \Omega(s) , not the complete authoritative state. When the trigger fires, the perturbation modifies that state; the observation-channel output is generated only after the update is recorded. This enforces the common principle state precedes channel .
paragraphs.zh: 该框架将现象定义为一种与应用无关的真实变更类别，这种变更作用于权威世界状态，且其原因并非智能体所预期的动作。 它将环境特定的实现称为扰动 ρ = ( δ , τ , c , g ) \rho=(\delta,\tau,c,g)：一个状态算子 δ : 𝒮 → 𝒮 \delta:\mathcal{S}\to\mathcal{S}、一个作用于动作历史的触发谓词 τ \tau、一个可借以观察被变更信息的信道 c c，以及一个一次性守卫 g g。 智能体在一个部分可观测的环境 E = ( 𝒮 , 𝒜 , 𝒪 , T , Ω , s 0 ) E=(\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{O},T,\Omega,s_{0}) 中行动，看到的是渲染后的观测 Ω ⁡ ( s ) \Omega(s)，而非完整的权威状态。 当触发器被激发时，扰动会修改该状态；观测信道的输出只有在更新被记录之后才会生成。 这就强制执行了“状态先于信道”这一共同原则。

paragraphs.en: For the supplementary environments, task construction uses a manifest binding the base task, application state, phenomenon, perturbation, observation channel, checker and reward. The base-task generator and discriminator, both implemented through Claude Code, iteratively construct a task setup, completion state and verifier, adapted from the CUA-Gym dual-sandbox procedure. A specified phenomenon is then introduced and evaluated with a reference policy π ⋆ \pi^{\star} and a deficient policy π − \pi^{-} . The former demonstrates a valid path, while the latter deliberately omits one recovery discipline. Human authors specify scenarios, invariants and policies; the generation procedure does not autonomously invent unrestricted new evaluation scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 对于补充环境，任务构建使用一个清单来绑定基础任务、应用状态、现象、扰动、观察通道、检查器和奖励。 基础任务生成器与判别器均通过 Claude Code 实现，二者迭代地构建任务设置、完成状态和验证器，改编自 CUA-Gym 的双沙盒流程。 随后引入一个指定的现象，并用参考策略 π ⋆ \pi^{\star} 和缺陷策略 π − \pi^{-} 进行评估。 前者展示一条有效路径，而后者刻意省略一项恢复纪律。 人类作者指定场景、不变量和策略；生成过程不会自主发明不受限制的全新评估场景。

paragraphs.en: The intended application state must change, and unlisted entities must remain unchanged. Checks compare serialized state outside the declared entity set, test the one-shot guard, verify the state-before-channel ordering, ensure monitoring probes do not trigger the change, and detect a contaminated starting world.
paragraphs.zh: 预期的应用状态必须发生变化，而未列出的实体必须保持不变。 检查项会比较声明实体集之外序列化后的状态，测试一次性防护，验证状态先于频道的顺序，确保监控探针不会触发该变更，并检测受污染的初始世界。

paragraphs.en: When multiple channels present the changed record, the certifier parses their emitted text into canonical facts and checks that the channels are consistent about the state. This prevents an alleged channel comparison from accidentally comparing different underlying facts. It is not the same as the present study’s proof that an individual model received a particular served frame.
paragraphs.zh: 当多个通道呈现已更改的记录时，认证方会将其输出的文本解析为规范化事实，并检查各通道对状态的说法是否一致。 这可以防止所谓的通道比较意外地比较了不同的底层事实。 这与本研究中证明单个模型接收到某个特定服务帧并不相同。

paragraphs.en: Checkpoints identify broad trajectory stages (acquisition, change, detection, attempted repair, terminal state), while failure signatures label recurring mechanisms. These signals distinguish, for example, an agent that never revisited a silently modified record from one that recognized a discrepancy but applied a forbidden repair. Dense reward is diagnostic, not evidence that partial completion is fully correct. The primary stale-world experiments retain state-based success invariants and descriptive trajectory signatures, but do not inherit the supplementary corpus’s dense scores or inferential sampling scheme.
paragraphs.zh: 检查点识别宽泛的轨迹阶段（获取、改变、检测、尝试修复、终态），而失败签名则标记反复出现的机制。 例如，这些信号可以区分从未重新查看被静默修改记录的智能体，与识别到差异但应用了被禁止修复的智能体。 稠密奖励是诊断性的，并非部分完成完全正确的证据。 主要的陈旧世界实验保留了基于状态的成功不变量和描述性轨迹签名，但并不继承补充语料库的稠密评分或推断采样方案。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory corpus evaluates a Claude Opus 5 configuration driven through Claude Code with shell and GUI interaction tools, in three multi-application environments. It reports 32 variants and 93 rollouts overall. The variant, not each rollout, is its primary statistical unit; repeated rollouts of one variant share the same initial state, perturbation and harness. The corpus includes both synthetic mocks and one independent third-party mail service. The certification process identified five nondiscriminative instances, six checker false-negatives and contamination of early clinic episodes by an uncleared Mailpit store.
paragraphs.zh: 该探索性语料库在三个多应用环境中评估了通过 Claude Code 驱动、配备 shell 和 GUI 交互工具的 Claude Opus 5 配置。 它总计报告了 32 个变体和 93 次 rollout。 其主要统计单位是变体而非每次 rollout；同一变体的重复 rollout 共享相同的初始状态、扰动与运行框架。 该语料库既包含合成的模拟环境，也包含一个独立的第三方邮件服务。 认证过程识别出五个无区分度的实例、六个检查器漏报，以及早期 clinic 回合中未清除的 Mailpit 存储所导致的污染。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory corpus reports 26 changed variants after excluding the leak-affected variant. Seventeen variants were handled successfully in 53 of 55 rollouts; the remaining nine variants form the four families in Table 42 , succeeding in three of 23 rollouts. Together these account for 78 changed rollouts. The aggregate unperturbed controls achieved 11/12 successes; cosmetic controls achieved 5/6. The four difficult families were selected from observed failures, so their comparison is descriptive rather than a preregistered confirmatory contrast. The exploratory corpus’s unselected variant-level test gives p = 0.137 p=0.137 , with no comparison rejecting at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . These values must not be added to the prospective stale-world instance counts or interpreted as replicated stale-world effect of review-time informations.
paragraphs.zh: 探索性语料库在排除受泄漏影响的变体后，报告了 26 个发生变化的变体。 十七个变体在 55 次滚动中的 53 次得到成功处理；其余九个变体构成表 42 中的四个变体族，在 23 次滚动中的 3 次获得成功。 两者合计共 78 次发生变化的滚动。 总体未扰动对照组取得 11/12 次成功；表面性对照组取得 5/6 次成功。 这四个困难变体族是从观测到的失败中选出的，因此它们的比较是描述性的，而非预先注册的验证性对照。 探索性语料库未经选择的变体级检验给出 p = 0.137，没有比较在 α = 0.05 下被拒绝。 这些数值不得加入前瞻性陈旧世界实例计数，也不得被解读为经过复现的评审时信息的陈旧世界效应。

paragraphs.en: Five nondiscriminative instances had allowed the deficient policy to succeed even after the change. Six checker false-negatives rejected correct behavior because literal string matching stood in for the intended semantic condition; the checkers were revised and archived rollouts re-scored. The mail service carried messages across 11 early clinic rollouts, including a particularly affected variant excluded from primary analysis. A clean-world assertion covered 82 subsequent rollouts. Sensitivity analyses for early contamination are reported; they do not establish that such contamination was harmless merely from unchanged aggregate directions. These observed failures illustrate what the certification layers caught during construction; the proportions do not measure sensitivity to unknown future defects.
paragraphs.zh: 五个无区分性的实例使得该有缺陷的策略在变更之后仍然能够成功。 六个检查器的漏报拒绝了正确的行为，因为字面字符串匹配代替了原本应有的语义条件；这些检查器已被修订，并重新对归档的 rollout 进行评分。 邮件服务在 11 个早期 clinic rollout 中传递消息，其中包括一个被排除在主要分析之外的受影响特别严重的变体。 一条干净世界断言覆盖了随后 82 个 rollout。 本文报告了针对早期污染的敏感性分析；仅凭总体方向未变，并不能证明此类污染是无害的。 这些观察到的失败示例说明了认证层在构建过程中捕获了什么；这些比例并不能衡量对未知未来缺陷的灵敏度。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory Ghost Commit case changes when an accepted write is altered. With the same underlying state operator and report channel, the alteration occurs either while a selection is still revisable or at submission when the interface no longer permits amendment. In the clinic realization, the agent re-reads and detects the altered value in all compared rollouts. It recovers successfully in 7/7 pre-commitment rollouts and 0/3 post-commitment rollouts; the cosmetic control succeeds in 3/3. In the post-commitment cases the agent attempts a prohibited delete-and-recreate repair while an allowed reporting/escalation route remains available. The difference localizes failure after detection , not at initial observation.
paragraphs.zh: 探索性的「幽灵提交」案例发生变化，即一个已被接受的写入被篡改。 在相同底层状态算子和报告通道下，篡改要么发生在选择仍可修订时，要么发生在提交时——此时接口已不再允许修改。 在临床实现中，智能体在所有对比的推演中都通过重读检测到了被篡改的值。 智能体在 7/7 个预提交推演中成功恢复，在 0/3 个后提交推演中成功恢复；表面性对照组则在 3/3 中成功。 在后提交案例中，智能体尝试了被禁止的「删除并重建」修复方式，而此时一条被允许的报告/上报路径仍然可用。 这一差异将失败定位于检测之后，而非初始观察阶段。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory analysis also reports a two-sided Fisher exact p = 0.008 p=0.008 on these rollout counts but marks it descriptive only : each timing condition is a single frozen variant, so the repeated runs cannot act as independent variant-level experimental units. The comparison changes which repair operations are available and includes a process-rule invariant; it is not a matched multi-variant confirmatory estimate. The hotel Ghost Commit realization reproduces the failure pattern on a different application but has no corresponding pre-commitment timing arm. The individual trajectory and screenshot evidence belongs to that exploratory dataset, not to the prospective disclosure sample.
paragraphs.zh: 探索性分析还对这些 rollout 计数报告了双侧 Fisher 精确检验 p = 0.008 p=0.008，但仅将其标注为描述性结果：每个时间条件都是一个单一的冻结变体，因此重复运行不能作为独立的变体级实验单位。 该比较改变了可用的修复操作，并包含一个流程规则不变量；它不是一个匹配的多变体验证性估计。 酒店 Ghost Commit 的实现复现在了另一个应用程序上的失败模式，但没有对应的预提交时间条件分支。 单个轨迹和截图证据属于该探索性数据集，而不属于前瞻性披露样本。

paragraphs.en: A valid perturbation and a sound reference/deficient-policy contrast do not certify that an agent was previously served the value being superseded. The supplementary rates concern episodes where an injected change fired, not necessarily episodes in which a model had demonstrably acquired an old belief. The primary stale-world experiments add the prior-serve anchor and separately archived delivered observations to target that narrower phenomenon. The main experiments additionally study the information supplied at review, whereas the supplementary failure-family analyses address broader recovery disciplines. The use of distinct model interfaces, tasks and statistical units prevents pooling the two result sets or treating the supplementary corpus as an independent validation of the current scorer. This is the evidence boundary between descriptive supplementary evaluations and the prospective disclosure results.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的扰动以及可靠的「参考/缺陷策略」对比并不能证明该智能体此前已被供给过正在被取代的那个值。 补充比率涉及的是注入变更被触发的事件，而不一定是模型已被证实习得旧信念的事件。 主要的陈旧世界实验加入了「先前已供给」锚点以及单独归档的已交付观测，以针对那个更窄的现象。 主实验还研究了评审时提供的信息，而补充的失败族分析则针对更广泛的恢复纪律。 使用不同的模型接口、任务和统计单元，使得这两个结果集无法被合并，也无法将补充语料视为当前评分器的独立验证。 这就是描述性补充评估与前瞻性披露结果之间的证据边界。

paragraphs.en: The serve and the delivered observation are intentionally different checks. An access log can show that a server returned v 0 v_{0} without proving that the agent was shown that response; delivery records can show a frame reached the policy without proving that the agent attended to it. Moreover, a later screenshot can display v 1 v_{1} while the database transaction never occurred if the review display logic is defective; the authoritative state transition must have its own record. These distinctions explain why EnvOS cannot be reduced to a screenshot-based scorer or a benchmark message injected into the conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 服务与所交付的观测是有意区分的两种检查。 访问日志可以显示服务器返回了 v 0 v_{0}，但并不能证明该智能体被展示了这一响应；交付记录可以显示某一帧到达了策略，但并不能证明该智能体注意到了它。 此外，如果审查展示逻辑存在缺陷，后续的截图可能显示 v 1 v_{1}，而数据库事务实际上并未发生；权威的状态转换必须有它自己的记录。 这些区别解释了为什么 EnvOS 不能被简化为基于截图的评分器，也不能被简化为注入对话中的基准消息。

paragraphs.en: Each policy invocation receives the declared task, a current browser observation and a bounded history of previous actions and self-authored memos; it returns one action. The harness executes that action, captures the next observation and records application events. The perturbation is integrated into the application request path rather than appended as a post-hoc model instruction. The following pseudocode is explanatory; the released source and archived event schema in the appendices define the implemented details.
paragraphs.zh: 每次策略调用都会接收已声明的任务、当前的浏览器观察结果，以及先前动作和自撰备忘录的有界历史记录，并返回一个动作。 测试框架执行该动作，捕获下一个观察结果并记录应用事件。 扰动被集成到应用请求路径中，而不是作为事后附加的模型指令追加。 以下伪代码仅作说明之用；附录中发布的源代码和归档的事件模式定义了实现细节。

paragraphs.en: The mutation is represented inside the application-side request handler, before the handler serves the triggered response; the client loop does not inject a changed value into a model prompt. This pseudocode describes event order and evidence responsibilities, not a verbatim implementation or a full specification of all eligible routes.
paragraphs.zh: 该变更在应用侧请求处理程序内部表示，位于处理程序返回触发的响应之前；客户端循环不会将更改后的值注入模型提示中。 这段伪代码描述的是事件顺序与证据职责，并非逐字的实现，也不是对所有符合条件的路由的完整规范。
